zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 在 Mac 上启动虚拟 iPhone 的命令行工具
zh.what: vphone-cli 是一个命令行工具，利用 Apple 的 Virtualization.framework 和 PCC 研究 VM 基础设施，在 Apple Silicon Mac 上启动虚拟 iPhone。它自动化了从下载固件、修补引导链、DFU 恢复、安装 CFW 到首次启动的完整流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Swift 编写的 CLI 主程序、跨编译的 guest 守护进程 vphoned、构建脚本和文档。提供 vm、fw、restore、cfw 等子命令，支持多种固件变体。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Swift，依赖 Python、aria2、wget、gnu-tar、openssl、ldid、sshpass、keystone、cmake、libusb、ipsw、zstd 等工具。需要 Apple Silicon 和 macOS 15+。
zh.hot: 在 macOS 上原生运行虚拟 iPhone 极具吸引力，加上一键创建 VM 的便利性，star 数接近 1 万，今日新增 361，登上日榜第三。
uses: iOS 安全研究人员：在隔离的虚拟环境中测试漏洞利用和越狱工具。
开发者：无需实体设备即可进行应用兼容性测试和 UI 自动化。
技术爱好者：探索 iOS 内部机制和固件修补，体验虚拟 iPhone。

en.tag: CLI tool to boot a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs
en.what: vphone-cli is a command-line tool that boots a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs using Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research VM infrastructure. It automates the entire pipeline from firmware download, boot chain patching, DFU restore, CFW installation, to first boot.
en.content: The repository contains a Swift-based CLI, a cross-compiled guest daemon (vphoned), build scripts, and documentation. It provides subcommands like vm, fw, restore, cfw, and supports multiple firmware variants.
en.stack: Primarily Swift, with dependencies on Python, aria2, wget, gnu-tar, openssl, ldid, sshpass, keystone, cmake, libusb, ipsw, zstd. Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15+.
en.hot: Running a virtual iPhone natively on macOS is highly appealing, and the one-command VM creation adds convenience. With nearly 10k stars and +361 today, it ranks #3 on the daily trending list.
uses: iOS security researchers: test exploits and jailbreak tools in an isolated virtual environment.
Developers: perform app compatibility testing and UI automation without physical devices.
Tech enthusiasts: explore iOS internals and firmware patching, experience a virtual iPhone.

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: 为 LLM 打造的开源网络爬虫与抓取工具
zh.what: Crawl4AI 是一个开源网络爬虫和抓取工具，专为大型语言模型设计。它能将网页转换为干净、结构化的 Markdown 格式，方便用于 RAG、AI 代理和数据管道。该工具强调速度、可控性和易用性，并拥有超过 50k 星标的社区支持。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 库、Docker API 服务器、Playwright 集成、内存自适应调度器、GPU 支持，以及详细的文档和示例。最新版本 v0.9.2 修复了内存泄漏和 Docker 认证问题。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Playwright 进行浏览器自动化，支持 Docker 部署，并集成 GPU 加速。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用对高质量数据的需求激增，Crawl4AI 提供了专门为 LLM 优化的爬虫解决方案，star 数已超 8 万，今日新增 221，跻身 GitHub 趋势榜第 6。
uses: AI 开发者：为 RAG 系统或 AI 代理抓取网页并转换为干净的 Markdown 数据。
数据工程师：构建数据管道，从网站提取结构化内容用于分析和训练。
研究人员：快速收集和整理网页信息，用于学术研究或市场调研。

en.tag: Open-source LLM-friendly web crawler & scraper for clean Markdown
en.what: Crawl4AI is an open-source web crawler and scraper designed specifically for large language models. It converts web pages into clean, structured Markdown, making it easy to use for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines. It emphasizes speed, controllability, and ease of use, backed by a community of over 50k stars.
en.content: The repository includes a Python library, Docker API server, Playwright integration, memory-adaptive dispatcher, GPU support, and extensive documentation and examples. The latest v0.9.2 fixes memory leaks and Docker authentication issues.
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging Playwright for browser automation, Docker for deployment, and optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: With the surge in demand for high-quality data for LLM applications, Crawl4AI offers a crawler solution specifically optimized for LLMs, amassing over 80k stars and 221 new stars today, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI developers: crawl web pages and convert to clean Markdown for RAG systems or AI agents.
Data engineers: build data pipelines to extract structured content from websites for analysis and training.
Researchers: quickly collect and organize web information for academic research or market analysis.

zh.tag: AI 代理搜索引擎，聚合多平台真实用户信号生成摘要
zh.what: 这是一个 AI 代理技能，能够并行搜索 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 等平台，根据点赞、投票和真实资金等信号对结果进行评分，并由 AI 代理法官综合成一份简洁的摘要。它旨在提供比传统搜索引擎更贴近真实用户关注点的信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义文件（SKILL.md）、安装脚本、多语言 README 以及演示媒体资源。核心是 SKILL.md，它定义了命令和设置行为，支持通过插件市场或 npx 安装到多种 AI 代理宿主。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖各平台的 API 和浏览器会话，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 50 多种代理宿主。零配置即可使用 Reddit、HN、Polymarket 和 GitHub，通过设置向导可解锁更多平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 6 万+ 星标和日增 230 星，它解决了信息过载问题，提供跨平台真实用户信号的综合摘要，这种能力是单一 AI 或搜索引擎无法提供的，因此迅速成为开发者关注的焦点。
uses: 需要快速了解某话题在多个社交平台真实热度的市场研究员或记者
希望获取竞争对手或行业人物最新动态的产品经理和创业者
对 AI 代理技术感兴趣，想体验跨平台搜索能力的开发者

en.tag: AI agent-led search engine that aggregates real user signals across platforms
en.what: This is an AI agent skill that searches Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web in parallel, scores results by upvotes, likes, and real-money signals, and synthesizes a concise brief via an AI agent judge. It aims to surface what real people actually engage with, unlike traditional search engines.
en.content: The repo contains the skill definition (SKILL.md), installation scripts, multilingual READMEs, and demo media. The core is SKILL.md, which defines the command and setup behavior, and it can be installed via plugin marketplace or npx into various AI agent hosts.
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging platform APIs and browser sessions, compatible with 50+ agent hosts like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. Zero-config for Reddit, HN, Polymarket, GitHub; setup wizard unlocks more platforms.
en.hot: With 60K+ stars and +230 daily, it addresses information overload by synthesizing cross-platform real-user signals, a capability no single AI or search engine offers, making it a trending developer favorite.
uses: Market researchers or journalists needing quick cross-platform sentiment on a topic
Product managers and entrepreneurs tracking competitors or industry figures
Developers interested in AI agent technology and cross-platform search capabilities

zh.tag: 命令行下载 App Store 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用，并下载其 ipa 文件。它支持认证、搜索、购买和列出已购应用等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具源码，提供 auth、search、purchase、list-purchases 等子命令，支持文本和 JSON 输出格式，并附带演示 GIF 和详细文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store 的 API，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该工具为开发者和安全研究人员提供了便捷的 ipa 下载方式，在 GitHub 上获得 1 万+ star，今日新增 58 个，登上日榜第 8 名。
uses: iOS 开发者需要获取 ipa 包进行测试或分析
安全研究人员分析应用包内容
需要备份或归档 App Store 应用的用户

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download ipa packages from App Store
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa files. It supports authentication, searching, purchasing, and listing purchased apps.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-purchases, supporting text and JSON output formats, along with a demo GIF and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it relies on the App Store API and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, installable via Homebrew.
en.hot: This tool provides a convenient way for developers and security researchers to download ipa files, gaining over 10k stars on GitHub with 58 new stars today, ranking 8th on the daily trending list.
uses: iOS developers needing ipa packages for testing or analysis
Security researchers analyzing app package contents
Users who want to back up or archive App Store apps

zh.tag: MCP 服务器精选清单，AI 工具扩展一站式导航
zh.what: 这是一个精选的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器列表，旨在帮助 AI 模型通过标准化接口安全地访问本地和远程资源。它涵盖了文件访问、数据库连接、API 集成等多种功能，是 AI 工具生态的重要参考。
zh.content: 仓库包含服务器实现、客户端、教程、社区链接等，并按编程语言、部署范围（本地/云）和操作系统分类，附有图例说明。
zh.stack: 主要基于 MCP 协议，涉及多种编程语言（如 Python、TypeScript、Go、Rust 等），依赖 GitHub 和 Glama 等平台进行维护。
zh.hot: 随着 MCP 协议在 AI 领域的普及，开发者需要快速找到可用的服务器，该列表成为重要入口。93k+ 星标反映了其高关注度，今日新增 96 星，持续火热。
uses: AI 应用开发者：快速集成 MCP 服务器，扩展 AI 模型能力，如文件访问和数据库操作。
技术选型者：评估和比较不同 MCP 服务器的功能、语言和部署方式，选择最适合的方案。
学习研究者：了解 MCP 协议生态，通过教程和社区资源深入理解其工作原理和应用场景。

en.tag: A curated list of MCP servers, one-stop navigation for extending AI tools
en.what: This is a curated list of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, designed to help AI models securely access local and remote resources through standardized interfaces. It covers file access, database connections, API integrations, and more, serving as a key reference in the AI tool ecosystem.
en.content: The repository includes server implementations, clients, tutorials, community links, and is categorized by programming language, deployment scope (local/cloud), and operating system, with a legend for reference.
en.stack: Primarily based on the MCP protocol, involving multiple programming languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust), and maintained via platforms like GitHub and Glama.
en.hot: With the growing adoption of the MCP protocol in AI, developers need a quick way to find usable servers, making this list a vital resource. The 93k+ stars reflect its high popularity, with 96 new stars today, indicating sustained interest.
uses: AI application developers: Quickly integrate MCP servers to extend AI model capabilities, such as file access and database operations.
Technology evaluators: Assess and compare different MCP servers by features, language, and deployment to choose the best fit.
Learners and researchers: Understand the MCP ecosystem through tutorials and community resources to grasp its workings and use cases.

zh.tag: Java 代码规范检查工具，支持 Google/Sun 标准
zh.what: Checkstyle 是一款开发工具，帮助程序员编写符合编码标准的 Java 代码。默认支持 Google Java Style Guide 和 Sun Code Conventions，并且高度可配置。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Checkstyle 的源代码、文档、配置示例和构建脚本。提供命令行工具和 ANT 任务，支持通过 XML 配置自定义检查规则。
zh.stack: 基于 Java 开发，使用 Maven 构建，依赖 Ant 等工具。支持多种 CI 集成，如 AppVeyor、CircleCI 等。
zh.hot: 今日新增 115 星，总星数 9203，登上 GitHub 日榜。作为长期维护的经典工具，持续获得开发者关注。
uses: Java 开发者：在编码时自动检查代码风格，确保符合团队或行业标准。
项目维护者：集成到 CI 流程中，自动执行代码规范检查，提升代码质量。
教育场景：用于教学 Java 编码规范，帮助学生养成良好编码习惯。

en.tag: Java code style checker supporting Google/Sun standards
en.what: Checkstyle is a development tool that helps programmers write Java code adhering to a coding standard. It supports Google Java Style Guide and Sun Code Conventions by default, and is highly configurable.
en.content: The repository contains Checkstyle's source code, documentation, configuration examples, and build scripts. It provides command-line tools and ANT tasks, with customizable check rules via XML configuration.
en.stack: Developed in Java, built with Maven, and integrates with Ant. Supports various CI systems like AppVeyor, CircleCI, etc.
en.hot: Gained 115 stars today, total 9203, trending on GitHub daily. As a long-maintained classic tool, it continues to attract developers.
uses: Java developers: automatically check code style during coding to ensure compliance with team or industry standards.
Project maintainers: integrate into CI pipelines to enforce code standards and improve code quality.
Educational settings: teach Java coding conventions and help students develop good coding habits.

zh.tag: NSA 开源的软件逆向工程框架
zh.what: Ghidra 是一个由美国国家安全局（NSA）开发的软件逆向工程（SRE）框架，提供反汇编、反编译、图形化分析和脚本等功能。它支持多种处理器指令集和可执行文件格式，可在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ghidra 的完整源代码，包括核心分析引擎、图形用户界面、反编译器、脚本 API 以及各种处理器模块。还提供了构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Java 编写，依赖 JDK 21（运行）和 JDK 25（构建），使用 Gradle 构建。支持通过 Python（PyGhidra）和 Java 进行扩展。
zh.hot: 作为 NSA 开源的顶级逆向工程工具，Ghidra 在安全研究社区中广受欢迎。今日新增 198 个 star，总 star 数达 73,901，持续保持高热度。
uses: 安全分析师和恶意软件研究人员用于分析恶意代码和漏洞研究。
逆向工程师用于理解闭源软件的二进制代码和协议。
学术研究人员和学生在教学和研究中探索软件逆向工程。
开发人员利用其 API 和脚本自动化分析任务。

en.tag: NSA's open-source software reverse engineering framework
en.what: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework developed by the NSA, offering disassembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting capabilities. It supports a wide variety of processor instruction sets and executable formats, and runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Ghidra, including the core analysis engine, GUI, decompiler, scripting API, and various processor modules. Build scripts and documentation are also included.
en.stack: Primarily written in Java, requires JDK 21 for running and JDK 25 for building, with Gradle as the build tool. Extensible via Python (PyGhidra) and Java.
en.hot: As a top-tier reverse engineering tool open-sourced by the NSA, Ghidra is highly popular in the security research community. With 198 new stars today and a total of 73,901, it maintains high momentum.
uses: Security analysts and malware researchers use it to analyze malicious code and vulnerability research.
Reverse engineers use it to understand binary code and protocols of closed-source software.
Academic researchers and students explore software reverse engineering in teaching and research.
Developers leverage its API and scripting to automate analysis tasks.

zh.tag: 微型双足机器人 Microduck 的强化学习训练环境
zh.what: 该项目为约 800 克、25 厘米高的双足机器人 Microduck 提供强化学习训练环境，基于 MuJoCo Warp 和 PPO 算法，在 50 Hz 频率下训练策略，并导出为 ONNX 格式部署到真实机器人上。它完整实现了 sim2real 流程，包括执行器物理、域随机化和奖励设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含多种训练任务（如行走、跌倒恢复、站立等），提供训练、播放、导出和推理脚本，以及 Hugging Face Jobs 远程训练支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 MuJoCo Warp（需要 CUDA GPU）、PPO 算法、uv 包管理器，以及 ONNX 导出。
zh.hot: 今日新增 168 星，总星数 796，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 12 名。其 sim2real 方法和真实机器人演示视频吸引了大量关注。
uses: 机器人研究人员：用于双足机器人强化学习训练和 sim2real 迁移研究
强化学习开发者：学习如何为真实机器人设计奖励函数和训练环境
对微型机器人感兴趣的爱好者：可观看真实机器人演示并尝试训练策略

en.tag: RL training environments for the Microduck bipedal robot
en.what: This project provides RL training environments for Microduck, an ~800g, ~25cm tall bipedal robot, built on MuJoCo Warp with PPO. Policies are trained at 50 Hz, exported to ONNX, and deployed on the real robot. It encodes the full sim2real recipe, including actuator physics, domain randomization, and reward design.
en.content: The repo includes multiple training tasks (e.g., walking, fall recovery, standing), scripts for training, playing, exporting, and inference, plus support for remote training via Hugging Face Jobs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, relying on MuJoCo Warp (requires CUDA GPU), PPO algorithm, uv package manager, and ONNX export.
en.hot: Gained 168 stars today, total 796, ranking #12 on GitHub Trending. Its sim2real approach and real-robot demo videos attract significant attention.
uses: Robotics researchers: for RL training and sim2real transfer on bipedal robots
RL developers: to learn reward design and training environments for real robots
Hobbyists interested in miniature robots: to watch real demos and try training policies

zh.tag: 中国专利智能助手：挖掘专利点、编写交底书、通俗解读
zh.what: 这是一个面向中国专利的 Agent 技能，帮助研发人员从项目材料中挖掘可申请的专利点，编写发明、实用新型、外观设计的交底书，并支持多轮迭代修改。它还能将公开专利解读成通俗笔记和知识图谱，沉淀为个人专利知识库，并辅助审查答复和政策嗅探。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义（SKILL.md）、安装说明（INSTALL.md）、设计文档、示例输出（如交底书、Mermaid 图、线稿图）以及相关代码。核心功能模块包括专利点挖掘、交底书生成与迭代、专利通俗解读（输出到 Obsidian）、审查答复辅助等。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.9+，使用 Playwright 与 CNIPA（中国国家知识产权局）交互，遵循 AgentSkills 标准，集成 Obsidian CLI 和 Bases 生态，支持 Mermaid 图表生成。
zh.hot: 5.6k stars 且日增 62，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 13，因为精准解决了研发人员写专利交底书的痛点，将专利解读与知识库结合，实用性强且演示效果直观。
uses: 研发工程师：从项目代码和方案中快速挖掘专利点，生成规范交底书
专利代理人/IPR：辅助审查答复、多轮修订交底书，并跟踪政策动向
技术管理者：将公开专利解读为通俗笔记，构建团队私有专利知识库
创新爱好者：学习专利撰写技巧，理解复杂专利的技术细节

en.tag: China patent skill: mine patent points, draft disclosures, plain-language analysis
en.what: This is an Agent skill for Chinese patents, helping R&D personnel mine patentable points from project materials, draft invention, utility model, and design patent disclosures, with multi-round iteration support. It also interprets public patents into plain-language notes and knowledge graphs, building a personal patent knowledge base, and assists with office action responses and policy tracking.
en.content: The repo includes skill definition (SKILL.md), installation guide (INSTALL.md), design docs, sample outputs (disclosures, Mermaid diagrams, line drawings), and code. Core modules cover patent point mining, disclosure generation and iteration, plain-language interpretation (into Obsidian), and office action assistance.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.9+, uses Playwright for CNIPA interaction, follows AgentSkills standard, integrates Obsidian CLI and Bases ecosystem, and supports Mermaid diagram generation.
en.hot: With 5.6k stars and +62 today, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending daily, it addresses the pain point of drafting patent disclosures for engineers, combining interpretation with knowledge base, highly practical with clear demos.
uses: R&D engineers: quickly mine patent points from code and designs, generate standard disclosures
Patent attorneys/IPR: assist with office actions, multi-round revisions, and policy tracking
Tech managers: interpret public patents into plain notes, build team patent knowledge base
Innovation enthusiasts: learn patent drafting skills and understand complex patent details

zh.tag: 统一应用集成平台，一套语法连接所有 API
zh.what: Corsair 是一个功能完备的产品集成平台，提供无缝的开发者体验。它允许你构建从跨所有集成的代理到多租户仪表盘的任何东西，让用户连接任何应用。与仅支持 MCP 的工具不同，Corsair 基于 REST API，因此同一集成层适用于代理、后端服务和客户仪表盘。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、文档、工具以及各种集成插件。提供自托管选项或使用 Hub 服务来处理 OAuth 刷新和 webhooks。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 REST API 作为集成层，并维护适配器以提供统一的语法。
zh.hot: Corsair 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 126 星，总星数达 10954，位列日榜第 14。它解决了 MCP 工具的局限性，提供更通用的集成方案，并强调开源和数据自主性。
uses: 开发者需要为 AI 代理集成多个第三方 API，希望减少胶水代码。
团队构建多租户 SaaS 产品，需要让用户连接自己的应用。
企业希望自托管集成平台，确保用户数据留在自己的基础设施中。

en.tag: Unified app integration platform with one syntax for all APIs
en.what: Corsair is a fully-featured product integration platform with a seamless DX. It lets you build anything from an agent working across all your integrations to a multi-tenant dashboard for your users to connect to anything. Unlike MCP-only tools, Corsair is built on a REST API, so the same integration layer works for agents, backend services, and customer dashboards.
en.content: The repository contains the core library, docs, tooling, and integration plugins. It offers self-hosting or Hub service for OAuth refresh and webhooks.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses REST API as the integration layer, and maintains adapters for a unified syntax.
en.hot: Corsair is gaining traction on GitHub with 126 stars today and 10,954 total, ranking #14 on the daily trending list. It addresses MCP-only limitations with a more versatile integration approach and emphasizes open source and data ownership.
uses: Developers integrating multiple third-party APIs for AI agents and wanting to reduce glue code.
Teams building multi-tenant SaaS products that need to let users connect their own apps.
Enterprises seeking a self-hosted integration platform to keep user data on their own infrastructure.

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: TypeScript 优先的 schema 校验与类型推断库
zh.what: Zod 是一个 TypeScript 优先的校验库，通过定义 schema 来解析数据，并返回强类型、经过验证的结果。它支持静态类型推断，让开发者无需重复定义类型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Zod 库的源代码、文档、测试以及示例。核心功能包括 schema 定义、解析、类型推断、JSON Schema 转换等。
zh.stack: TypeScript 编写，零外部依赖，支持 Node.js 和现代浏览器，核心包 gzipped 后仅 2kb。
zh.hot: Zod 在 TypeScript 生态中广受欢迎，因其简洁的 API 和强大的类型推断能力，star 数已达 43k，今日新增 31，持续在 GitHub 趋势榜上。
uses: 适用于 TypeScript 项目中的表单验证、API 请求/响应校验等场景。
适合需要运行时数据校验和静态类型安全的前端开发者。
可用于构建数据管道、配置解析等需要严格类型保证的后端服务。

en.tag: TypeScript-first schema validation with static type inference
en.what: Zod is a TypeScript-first validation library that lets you define schemas and parse data, returning strongly-typed, validated results. It provides static type inference, eliminating the need for duplicate type definitions.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, tests, and examples for the Zod library. Core features include schema definition, parsing, type inference, and JSON Schema conversion.
en.stack: Written in TypeScript, zero external dependencies, works in Node.js and all modern browsers, core bundle is 2kb gzipped.
en.hot: Zod is widely popular in the TypeScript ecosystem for its concise API and powerful type inference, with 43k stars and 31 new stars today, consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Ideal for form validation, API request/response validation in TypeScript projects.
Suitable for frontend developers needing runtime data validation and static type safety.
Useful for building data pipelines, config parsing, and backend services requiring strict type guarantees.

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: 实时语音 AI 代理开发框架
zh.what: LiveKit Agents 是一个用于构建实时、可编程参与者的框架，这些参与者运行在服务器上，能够进行对话、多模态交互，并具备视觉和听觉能力。它提供了灵活的集成方式，支持多种 STT、LLM、TTS 和 Realtime API，以及任务调度、WebRTC 客户端、电话集成等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Agents 库、插件（如 OpenAI、Deepgram、Cartesia 等）、示例代码、文档和测试框架。还提供了与 AgentsJS 的链接，以及用于构建客户端应用的 SDK 生态。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 LiveKit 的 WebRTC 基础设施，支持多种模型提供商插件，并集成了 MCP（模型上下文协议）和语义轮次检测（基于 transformer 模型）。
zh.hot: 随着实时语音 AI 应用的兴起，该框架提供了全面的解决方案，star 数达 13k+，今日新增 22，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 20 名，受到开发者社区的广泛关注。
uses: 开发者构建实时语音助手、客服机器人等应用
需要集成多种语音识别、语言模型和语音合成服务的场景
希望利用 WebRTC 实现低延迟音视频交互的团队
研究多模态 AI 代理和语义理解的研究人员

en.tag: Framework for building realtime voice AI agents
en.what: LiveKit Agents is a framework for building realtime, programmable participants that run on servers, enabling conversational, multi-modal voice agents that can see, hear, and understand. It offers flexible integrations with various STT, LLM, TTS, and Realtime APIs, along with job scheduling, WebRTC clients, telephony, and more.
en.content: The repository includes the core Agents library, plugins for popular model providers, examples, documentation, and a built-in test framework. It also links to AgentsJS for JS/TS and provides SDKs for building client applications.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on LiveKit's WebRTC infrastructure, with plugins for various model providers, MCP support, and semantic turn detection using transformer models.
en.hot: With the rise of realtime voice AI applications, this framework provides a comprehensive solution, boasting over 13k stars and 22 new stars today, ranking #20 on GitHub Trending daily, gaining significant attention from the developer community.
uses: Developers building realtime voice assistants, customer service bots, etc.
Scenarios requiring integration of multiple STT, LLM, and TTS services.
Teams leveraging WebRTC for low-latency audio/video interaction.
Researchers studying multimodal AI agents and semantic understanding.

zh.tag: 浏览器内零服务器代码知识图谱与Graph RAG代理
zh.what: GitNexus是一个完全在浏览器中运行的客户端知识图谱引擎，可导入Git仓库或ZIP文件，生成交互式知识图谱，并内置Graph RAG代理，用于代码探索。它索引代码库的依赖、调用链、集群和执行流，并通过MCP工具暴露给AI代理，使代理获得架构级上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含CLI工具（npx gitnexus analyze/setup）、Web UI（浏览器聊天界面）、MCP配置生成器，以及自动生成的AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md上下文文件。
zh.stack: 基于TypeScript，依赖npm包分发，使用MCP协议集成AI代理，支持GitHub/GitLab/Azure/本地仓库。
zh.hot: GitNexus在GitHub Trending日榜排名第5，今日新增202星，总星数达46k。其零服务器架构和深度代码分析能力吸引了开发者，被视为DeepWiki的进阶版。
uses: 开发者快速理解陌生代码库的架构和依赖关系
AI编码代理（如Cursor、Claude Code）获取完整代码上下文，减少错误编辑
技术团队在浏览器中协作探索代码，无需配置服务器
教育场景中用于可视化代码结构和调用链

en.tag: Zero-server code knowledge graph with Graph RAG agent in browser
en.what: GitNexus is a client-side knowledge graph engine that runs entirely in the browser. Drop in a Git repo or ZIP file to get an interactive knowledge graph with a built-in Graph RAG agent for code exploration. It indexes dependencies, call chains, clusters, and execution flows, exposing them via MCP tools so AI agents gain architectural context.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI (npx gitnexus analyze/setup), a Web UI for browser chat, MCP config generator, and auto-generated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md context files.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, distributed via npm, uses MCP protocol for AI agent integration, supports GitHub/GitLab/Azure/local repos.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending daily with +202 stars today, reaching 46k total. Its zero-server architecture and deep code analysis appeal to developers, seen as a deeper alternative to DeepWiki.
uses: Developers quickly understand architecture and dependencies of unfamiliar codebases
AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code) get full code context to reduce blind edits
Teams explore code collaboratively in the browser without server setup
Educational use to visualize code structure and call chains

en.tag: Free & open-source, self-hosted machine translation API, no Google/Azure dependency
en.what: LibreTranslate is a fully self-hosted, free and open-source machine translation API powered by the open-source Argos Translate library, avoiding reliance on proprietary services like Google or Azure. It supports offline deployment, is easy to set up, and offers an online demo and comprehensive API docs.
en.content: The repo contains a Python-based API service, Docker image, CLI tools, web UI, and CI/CD configurations for testing and publishing.
en.stack: Built with Python, uses Argos Translate as the translation engine, provides a REST API, supports Docker deployment, and is distributed via PyPI.
en.hot: With 16k+ stars and 72 new stars today, LibreTranslate remains popular for offering a truly open-source, self-hosted, privacy-friendly translation alternative, especially appealing to developers and enterprises with data privacy concerns.
uses: Developers who want to integrate translation without relying on paid third-party APIs, self-hosting to reduce costs and protect data privacy.
Organizations needing translation in isolated or offline environments to meet compliance or security requirements.
Open-source enthusiasts or researchers wanting to study and customize the translation engine based on Argos Translate.

zh.tag: 消费级GPU上的LoRA训练、修复与混搭工作台
zh.what: Fizgig 是一个专为 Flux 2 Klein 9B、Krea 2 和 MiniMax H3 设计的 LoRA 训练与探索工作台。它支持在低至 16GB 显存的消费级显卡上微调基础模型，无需重新训练即可修复损坏的 LoRA，并能在几秒内将任意 LoRA 混搭出新变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练流水线、数据准备与标注工具、工作台界面（用于修复和混搭 LoRA）、以及 Checkpoint 转 LoRA 等实用工具。提供详细的安装指南、视频教程和 RunPod 一键部署模板。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，支持 NVIDIA GPU（最低 16GB 显存），并集成 RunPod 云部署。
zh.hot: 今日新增 33 星，登上 GitHub Python 趋势榜第 18 名。其亮点在于能在消费级显卡上全参微调最新模型，并首创 LoRA 修复与秒级混搭功能，吸引了大量 AI 创作者。
uses: AI 艺术家和创作者：在本地或租用 GPU 上训练、修复和混搭 LoRA，无需高端硬件。
模型微调爱好者：探索 Krea 2、MiniMax H3 等新模型的全参微调，突破适配器限制。
内容生产者：利用照片、视频、声音和语音数据快速生成个性化模型变体。

en.tag: Train, repair & remix LoRAs for Krea 2, MiniMax & Klein 9B on consumer GPUs
en.what: Fizgig is a workbench for training, fine-tuning, repairing, and exploring LoRAs for Flux 2 Klein 9B, Krea 2, and MiniMax H3. It enables fine-tuning base models on consumer GPUs with as little as 16GB VRAM, fixes broken LoRAs without retraining, and remixes any LoRA into new variations in seconds.
en.content: The repo includes a full training pipeline, data prep and captioning tools, a workbench UI for repairing and remixing LoRAs, and utilities like Checkpoint-to-LoRA. It offers detailed install guides, video tutorials, and a one-click RunPod deployment template.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch and other deep learning frameworks, supporting NVIDIA GPUs (min 16GB VRAM) with RunPod cloud deployment integration.
en.hot: Gained 33 stars today, ranking #18 on GitHub Trending for Python. Its ability to full fine-tune latest models on consumer GPUs and unique LoRA repair/remix features attract many AI creators.
uses: AI artists and creators: train, repair, and remix LoRAs locally or on rented GPUs without high-end hardware.
Fine-tuning enthusiasts: explore full fine-tuning of new models like Krea 2 and MiniMax H3, breaking adapter limits.
Content producers: quickly generate personalized model variations using photos, video, sound, and voice data.

zh.tag: 邮箱与用户名 OSINT 深度情报套件
zh.what: 这是一个二合一的开源情报（OSINT）工具，只需一个邮箱或用户名，就能在 455+ 个扫描向量（175+ 邮箱站点、280+ 用户名平台）中深度提取数据，用于安全研究、调查和数字足迹分析。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 工具，支持跨平台（Termux、Windows、Linux），提供丰富的元数据抓取（头像、简介等），并有 Discord 社区和赞助商支持。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python，依赖 requests、beautifulsoup4 等常用库，支持 pip 安装，并针对 Termux 和桌面系统进行了测试。
zh.hot: 凭借 455+ 扫描向量和深度 OSINT 能力，在 GitHub 上获得 3565 星，今日新增 39 星，位列日榜第 17，吸引安全研究人员和调查人员关注。
uses: 安全研究人员用于漏洞评估和渗透测试中的信息收集。
调查记者或执法机构用于追踪数字足迹和验证账户注册。
个人用户用于检查自己的在线隐私暴露情况。

en.tag: 2-in-1 Email & Username OSINT suite for deep digital footprint analysis
en.what: A 2-in-1 OSINT suite that extracts deep data from a single email or username across 455+ scan vectors (175+ email sites, 280+ username platforms) for security research, investigations, and digital footprinting.
en.content: The repo contains a full Python tool with cross-platform support (Termux, Windows, Linux), rich metadata scraping (avatars, bios, etc.), and a Discord community plus sponsor backing.
en.stack: Built on Python with common libraries like requests and beautifulsoup4, installable via pip, tested on Termux, Windows, and Linux.
en.hot: With 455+ scan vectors and deep OSINT capabilities, it has gained 3565 stars (39 today) and ranks #17 on the daily trending list, attracting security researchers and investigators.
uses: Security researchers use it for information gathering in vulnerability assessments and penetration testing.
Investigative journalists or law enforcement use it to trace digital footprints and verify account registrations.
Individuals use it to check their own online privacy exposure.

zh.tag: 一键部署本地 AI 服务器，集成推理、聊天、语音、RAG 与生图
zh.what: ODS 是一个部署系统，能将普通电脑变成私有 AI 服务器，自动安装并整合 Ollama、Open WebUI、n8n、ComfyUI 等工具。它提供本地模型推理、浏览器聊天界面、控制仪表盘、语音代理工作流、RAG 检索和图像生成，无需云服务或订阅。
zh.content: 仓库根目录包含 README、安装器、安全策略和 GitHub Actions；`ods/` 目录包含产品运行时，包括服务、安装阶段、compose 覆盖、仪表盘、CLI、测试和运维文档。当前稳定版为 v2.6.0，`main` 分支用于开发。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Docker Compose 编排多个开源服务（如 Ollama、Open WebUI、n8n、ComfyUI），并包含自定义 CLI 和仪表盘。
zh.hot: 凭借近 5000 星和日增 35 星登上趋势榜，因为它解决了本地 AI 部署的痛点——无需手动拼装多工具，一键安装并统一管理，同时强调隐私和数据自主。
uses: 希望完全掌控数据、避免云端依赖的个人开发者或隐私爱好者
需要快速搭建本地 AI 实验环境的研究人员或学生
希望在自有硬件上运行 AI 服务的小型团队或企业
对 AI 工具链感兴趣但不想花时间配置的爱好者

en.tag: Turn your PC/Mac/Linux into a private AI server with LLM, chat, voice, agents, RAG, and image gen
en.what: ODS is a deployment system that turns a regular computer into a private AI server, automatically installing and wiring together tools like Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, and ComfyUI. It offers local model inference, a browser-based chat UI, a control dashboard, voice agents and workflows, RAG retrieval, and image generation—no cloud or subscriptions required.
en.content: The repo root holds the README, installers, security policy, and GitHub workflows; the `ods/` directory contains the product runtime: services, installer phases, compose overlays, dashboard, CLI, tests, and operator docs. Stable release is v2.6.0, with `main` for active development.
en.stack: Python-based, orchestrates multiple open-source services (Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, ComfyUI) via Docker Compose, with a custom CLI and dashboard.
en.hot: With nearly 5k stars and +35 today, it's trending because it solves the pain of local AI setup—no manual assembly of tools, one-command install with unified management, and a strong privacy/data-ownership pitch.
uses: Individual developers or privacy enthusiasts who want full data control without cloud dependency
Researchers or students needing a quick local AI experimentation environment
Small teams or enterprises wanting to run AI services on their own hardware
Hobbyists interested in AI toolchains but unwilling to spend time on configuration

zh.tag: 给 AI 代理一个完整的 Linux 电脑
zh.what: Agent Zero 是一个开源代理框架，旨在处理超出简单聊天的任务。它提供了一个 Docker 化的 Linux 桌面环境，代理可以在其中操作 GUI 软件、终端和文件，并具备浏览器 DOM 注释、实时文档协作、项目管理、插件系统和主机桥接等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心代码、文档、示例和资源，如 A0 Launcher 桌面应用、插件中心、项目与记忆管理、多代理协作等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 Docker 提供隔离环境，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows），并集成浏览器 DOM 注释、实时文档协作等能力。
zh.hot: 凭借 19k+ 星标和今日新增 20 星，Agent Zero 在 GitHub 趋势榜上持续升温，其独特的“完整 Linux 桌面”概念和丰富的功能吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者希望为 AI 代理提供真实桌面环境，以执行复杂 GUI 操作和自动化任务。
团队需要代理在隔离的 Docker 容器中协作处理文档、代码和项目，同时保持与宿主机桥接。
研究人员和爱好者探索多代理协作、插件扩展和透明内部机制，以定制自己的 AI 工作流。

en.tag: Give your AI agent a full Linux computer
en.what: Agent Zero is an open-source agent framework designed for tasks beyond simple chat. It provides a Dockerized Linux desktop environment where agents can operate GUI software, terminals, and files, with features like browser DOM annotation, live document collaboration, project management, plugin system, and host-machine bridge.
en.content: The repository contains the framework core code, documentation, examples, and resources, including the A0 Launcher desktop app, plugin hub, project and memory management, multi-agent cooperation, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, relies on Docker for isolated environments, supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows), and integrates browser DOM annotation, live document collaboration, and more.
en.hot: With 19k+ stars and 20 new stars today, Agent Zero is gaining momentum on GitHub Trending, attracting developers with its unique 'full Linux desktop' concept and rich feature set.
uses: Developers who want to give AI agents a real desktop environment for complex GUI operations and automation tasks.
Teams needing agents to collaborate on documents, code, and projects in isolated Docker containers while bridging back to the host machine.
Researchers and enthusiasts exploring multi-agent cooperation, plugin extensions, and transparent internals to customize their AI workflows.

zh.tag: 让AI编码代理控制Chrome浏览器的MCP服务器
zh.what: chrome-devtools-mcp 是一个 MCP 服务器，使 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor、Copilot）能够控制并检查实时 Chrome 浏览器。它提供性能洞察、高级调试和可靠自动化，并附带 CLI 供非 MCP 场景使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器实现、CLI 工具、文档（工具参考、故障排除、设计原则）和示例。核心功能包括性能追踪、网络分析、截图和 console 消息检查。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 puppeteer 进行浏览器自动化，依赖 Chrome DevTools 前端，通过 MCP 协议与代理通信。
zh.hot: 近5万星，因为它是官方 Chrome DevTools 团队出品，为 AI 代理提供强大的浏览器控制能力，填补了 AI 编码工具在真实浏览器调试上的空白。
uses: AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor、Copilot）需要调试前端应用时，可实时控制浏览器并获取性能数据。
开发者希望自动化浏览器测试或进行性能分析，可通过 MCP 或 CLI 集成到工作流中。
对 AI 代理安全性敏感的用户，需注意浏览器内容暴露风险，并可通过标志禁用遥测。

en.tag: MCP server that lets coding agents control and inspect Chrome
en.what: chrome-devtools-mcp is an MCP server that enables AI coding agents (like Claude, Cursor, Copilot) to control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It provides performance insights, advanced debugging, and reliable automation, with a CLI for non-MCP use.
en.content: The repo includes the MCP server implementation, CLI tool, docs (tool reference, troubleshooting, design principles), and examples. Key features include performance tracing, network analysis, screenshots, and console message inspection.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses puppeteer for browser automation, leverages Chrome DevTools frontend, and communicates via MCP protocol.
en.hot: With ~50k stars, it's hot because it's official from the Chrome DevTools team, giving AI agents powerful browser control and filling a gap in real-browser debugging for AI coding tools.
uses: AI coding agents (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot) debugging frontend apps by controlling a live browser and fetching performance data.
Developers automating browser tests or performance analysis, integrating via MCP or CLI into their workflows.
Users concerned about AI agent security, who should be aware of browser content exposure and can disable telemetry via flags.

zh.tag: 跨运行时 WebGPU 库，浏览器/Node/测试同 API
zh.what: vgpu 是一个 TypeScript 编写的 WebGPU 库，提供类型化的 WGSL 导入、极简的 GPU 优先 API，并支持在浏览器、无头 Node 和测试环境中运行相同的代码。它旨在简化 shader 管理、3D 场景、GPU 张量、神经网络和数学可视化的开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码、示例画廊、文档和 CLI 工具（如 `npx vgpu docs`、`npx vgpu examples`、`npx vgpu check`），以及用于 LLM 消费的 agents.md 和 llms.txt 文件。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 WebGPU，依赖 @webgpu/types，支持 Dawn 后端（Node）和确定性 mock（测试）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 203 星，总星数达 940，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（TypeScript）第 16 名。其跨运行时特性和对 AI 代理友好的设计吸引了开发者。
uses: WebGPU 开发者：需要跨浏览器、Node 和测试环境统一 API 的图形或计算项目。
AI/ML 工程师：用于 GPU 张量运算和神经网络推理，简化 shader 集成。
工具链构建者：利用 CLI 和 LLM 文档，构建自动化或智能代理工作流。

en.tag: Cross-runtime WebGPU library with one API for browser, Node, and tests
en.what: vgpu is a TypeScript library for WebGPU that offers typed WGSL imports, a tiny GPU-first API, and runs the same code in the browser, headless Node, and test suites. It simplifies development of shaders, 3D scenes, GPU tensors, neural networks, and math visualizations.
en.content: The repository contains core library source, an example gallery, documentation, and CLI tools (like `npx vgpu docs`, `npx vgpu examples`, `npx vgpu check`), plus agents.md and llms.txt for LLM consumption.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript and WebGPU, depends on @webgpu/types, supports Dawn backend (Node) and deterministic mock (tests).
en.hot: Gained 203 stars today, reaching 940 total, and ranked #16 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its cross-runtime capability and agent-friendly design attract developers.
uses: WebGPU developers: for graphics or compute projects needing a unified API across browser, Node, and tests.
AI/ML engineers: for GPU tensor operations and neural network inference, simplifying shader integration.
Toolchain builders: leveraging CLI and LLM docs to build automated or agentic workflows.

zh.tag: 自动构建个人知识库的跨平台桌面应用
zh.what: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，能自动将文档转化为结构化的、相互关联的知识库。它不同于传统 RAG 每次从头检索，而是让 LLM 增量构建并维护一个持久化的 wiki。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，涵盖前端界面、Rust 后端代理、文档解析、知识图谱、向量搜索、深度研究等功能模块，并附有详细文档和多语言 README。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 Rust 构建，使用 LanceDB 进行向量检索，支持多种 LLM 提供商，集成 MinerU 等 PDF 解析工具。
zh.hot: 凭借自动构建知识库的创新理念和丰富的功能，在 GitHub 上获得 17k+ 星标，今日新增 66 星，位列 TypeScript 趋势榜第 9。
uses: 研究人员和学者：自动整理文献和笔记，构建可追溯的知识网络。
知识工作者：将散落文档转化为结构化 wiki，提升信息检索效率。
开发者：利用深度研究和知识图谱功能，快速探索技术主题。

en.tag: Cross-platform desktop app that auto-builds a personal knowledge base
en.what: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that automatically turns documents into a structured, interlinked knowledge base. Unlike traditional RAG, it incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources.
en.content: The repo contains full desktop app source code, covering frontend UI, Rust backend agent, document parsing, knowledge graph, vector search, deep research, and more, with detailed docs and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Rust, uses LanceDB for vector retrieval, supports multiple LLM providers, integrates MinerU for PDF parsing.
en.hot: With its innovative auto-building knowledge base concept and rich features, it has gained 17k+ stars, +66 today, ranking #9 on TypeScript trending.
uses: Researchers and academics: automatically organize literature and notes into a traceable knowledge network.
Knowledge workers: transform scattered documents into a structured wiki for efficient retrieval.
Developers: leverage deep research and knowledge graph features to quickly explore technical topics.

zh.tag: 给 ChatGPT 等 AI 装上 Codex 式本地编码工作流
zh.what: DevSpace 是一个自托管的 MCP 服务器，让 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 助手能安全地读取、编辑、搜索和运行你本地项目中的代码。它通过你控制的隧道暴露服务，并用密码授权连接，确保文件不经过第三方。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具（通过 npm 安装）、初始化向导、MCP 服务器实现，以及文档和示例配置。支持 ChatGPT 和多种编码代理（如 Claude、Hermes、Grok Bot、OpenClaw）。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，要求 Node.js >=22.19 <27。依赖 MCP 协议，可与 Cloudflare Tunnel、ngrok 等反向代理配合使用。
zh.hot: 上线即登 GitHub Trending 日榜（TypeScript 第 10 名），24 小时新增 108 星，总星数达 4303。它让普通用户也能轻松拥有 Codex 级编码体验，且完全掌控数据安全。
uses: 希望用 ChatGPT 等 AI 辅助编码但不想上传代码到云端的开发者
需要为多个 AI 代理提供统一本地代码访问入口的团队
追求 Codex 式工作流但预算有限、无法使用官方服务的个人开发者

en.tag: Bring Codex-style coding workflow to ChatGPT and other agents
en.what: DevSpace is a self-hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude secure access to read, edit, search, and run code in your local projects. It exposes the service via a tunnel you control and requires password approval, keeping your files private.
en.content: The repo includes a CLI tool (installed via npm), an initialization wizard, the MCP server implementation, plus documentation and example configs. It supports ChatGPT and various coding agents like Claude, Hermes, Grok Bot, and OpenClaw.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.19 <27. It leverages the MCP protocol and works with reverse proxies like Cloudflare Tunnel and ngrok.
en.hot: It hit #10 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) with 108 stars added in a day, reaching 4,303 total. It democratizes Codex-level coding for everyday users while giving them full control over data security.
uses: Developers who want AI-assisted coding with ChatGPT but prefer not to upload code to the cloud
Teams needing a unified local code access point for multiple AI agents
Individual developers seeking a Codex-like workflow without the cost of official services

zh.tag: 全球公开 IPTV 频道播放列表合集
zh.what: 这是一个收集全球公开可用的 IPTV 频道播放列表的仓库，用户可以直接将播放列表链接粘贴到支持直播的播放器中观看。项目还提供 EPG 电子节目指南、频道数据库和 API 等配套资源。

zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 GitHub Actions 自动更新播放列表，数据来源于 iptv-org/database 仓库。
zh.hot: 拥有 13.7 万 star，因其免费、开放、持续更新且覆盖全球频道而广受欢迎，是 IPTV 领域的知名项目。
uses: 想免费观看全球电视直播的用户，可直接使用播放列表。
开发者可基于其 API 和数据库构建 IPTV 相关应用。
需要 EPG 节目指南的爱好者或研究者。

en.tag: Curated collection of public IPTV channel playlists worldwide
en.what: This repository aggregates publicly available IPTV channel playlists from around the world. Users can paste the playlist link into any live-streaming-capable player to watch. It also provides EPG, a channel database, and an API.
en.content: The repo includes a main playlist (index.m3u) and various categorized playlists, along with EPG utilities, a database, API docs, and resource links.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses GitHub Actions for automated playlist updates, and sources data from the iptv-org/database repository.
en.hot: With 137k stars, it's popular for being free, open, continuously updated, and covering global channels, making it a well-known project in the IPTV space.

Developers can build IPTV apps using its API and database.
Enthusiasts or researchers needing EPG program guides.

zh.tag: 为AI代理提供网页搜索、抓取与交互的API
zh.what: Firecrawl是一个开源的网页上下文API，用于大规模搜索、抓取网页，并将内容转换为干净的Markdown或结构化数据，供AI代理使用。它提供搜索、抓取、映射、提取等核心端点，并支持处理JavaScript渲染的页面、PDF等媒体文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含Firecrawl的完整源代码，包括API服务、SDK（Python、Node等）、文档和示例。项目采用TypeScript编写，提供REST API和多种客户端库，支持自托管或使用托管服务。
zh.stack: 基于TypeScript构建，使用Node.js、Playwright（用于浏览器自动化）、FastAPI（Python SDK）等。依赖包括代理管理、速率限制、内容提取等库，支持MCP协议。
zh.hot: Firecrawl在GitHub上拥有17.4万星标，今日新增436星，位列TypeScript日榜第12名。其高可靠性（覆盖96%网页）和LLM友好输出使其成为AI代理数据获取的热门选择。
uses: AI代理开发者：需要为LLM提供干净的网页数据，用于训练或实时推理。
数据抓取工程师：需要大规模抓取动态网页，并处理反爬虫机制。
企业用户：希望自托管或使用托管服务，构建基于网页数据的应用。

en.tag: API for AI agents to search, scrape, and interact with the web
en.what: Firecrawl is an open-source web context API for searching, scraping, and interacting with the web at scale, converting content into clean Markdown or structured data for AI agents. It offers core endpoints like search, scrape, map, and extract, handling JavaScript-heavy pages and media files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Firecrawl, including the API service, SDKs (Python, Node, etc.), documentation, and examples. Written in TypeScript, it provides a REST API and multiple client libraries, supporting self-hosting or the hosted service.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, leveraging Node.js, Playwright for browser automation, and FastAPI for the Python SDK. Dependencies include proxy management, rate limiting, content extraction libraries, and MCP support.
en.hot: With 174k stars and 436 new stars today, Firecrawl ranks #12 on the TypeScript daily trending list. Its high reliability (96% web coverage) and LLM-ready output make it a popular choice for AI agents.
uses: AI agent developers needing clean web data for LLM training or real-time inference.
Data scraping engineers who need to scrape dynamic pages at scale and bypass anti-bot measures.
Enterprises looking to self-host or use a hosted service for web-data-driven applications.

zh.tag: 跨平台现代电子书阅读器，重塑沉浸式阅读体验
zh.what: Readest 是一款开源电子书阅读器，支持 EPUB、PDF、MOBI 等多种格式，提供滚动/分页阅读模式、全文搜索、标注高亮、词典查询、并行阅读等功能。它基于 Next.js 16 和 Tauri v2 构建，覆盖 macOS、Windows、Linux、Android、iOS 和 Web 平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端（Tauri）、移动端和 Web 应用代码，以及文档、截图和本地化资源。核心应用位于 apps/readest-app，使用 TypeScript 编写，并包含 Tauri 图标等资源。
zh.stack: 主要技术栈为 TypeScript、Next.js 16 和 Tauri v2，支持多平台打包。依赖包括 React、Tauri 插件以及可能的本地词典导入功能。
zh.hot: Readest 作为 Foliate 的现代重写，凭借丰富的功能和跨平台支持，在 GitHub 上获得 23.9k 星标，今日新增 39 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 13 名，受到 avid readers 的青睐。
uses: 喜欢深度阅读的电子书爱好者，需要跨设备同步阅读进度和笔记。
需要阅读多种格式（如 PDF、MOBI）并希望有统一界面的用户。
开发者可基于其开源代码定制或贡献功能，如并行阅读和词典导入。

en.tag: A modern cross-platform ebook reader for immersive reading experiences
en.what: Readest is an open-source ebook reader supporting multiple formats like EPUB, PDF, MOBI, and more. It offers scroll/page view modes, full-text search, annotations, dictionary lookup, and parallel reading. Built with Next.js 16 and Tauri v2, it runs on macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and the Web.
en.content: The repository contains code for desktop (Tauri), mobile, and web apps, along with documentation, screenshots, and localization resources. The core app is in apps/readest-app, written in TypeScript, with Tauri icons and assets.
en.stack: Main tech stack is TypeScript, Next.js 16, and Tauri v2 for cross-platform builds. Dependencies include React, Tauri plugins, and support for local dictionary imports.
en.hot: As a modern rewrite of Foliate, Readest has gained 23.9k stars on GitHub with 39 new stars today, ranking 13th on the TypeScript daily trending list, appealing to avid readers with its rich features and cross-platform support.
uses: E-book enthusiasts who enjoy deep reading and need cross-device sync of progress and notes.
Users who need to read multiple formats (e.g., PDF, MOBI) with a unified interface.
Developers can customize or contribute features like parallel reading and dictionary import based on the open-source code.

zh.tag: 全网广告拦截 DNS 服务器，隐私保护中心
zh.what: AdGuard Home 是一款全网广告与追踪器拦截软件，通过充当 DNS 服务器将追踪域名重定向到“黑洞”，从而阻止设备连接。它无需在每台设备上安装客户端，即可覆盖家中所有设备。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、安装脚本、文档（Wiki 链接）、API 说明、构建指南和贡献指南。提供多种安装方式，包括自动化脚本和 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端部分使用 TypeScript。依赖包括 DNS 库、Web 界面框架等，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 该项目拥有超过 3.6 万星标，今日新增 52 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 14。其开源免费、功能强大，是 Pi-hole 的有力替代品，受到隐私保护爱好者的广泛关注。
uses: 家庭用户：希望在路由器层面拦截广告和追踪器，保护所有联网设备。
隐私倡导者：注重在线隐私，希望阻止设备与追踪服务器通信。
小型网络管理员：需要集中管理网络广告拦截，无需逐台配置设备。

en.tag: Network-wide ad & tracker blocking DNS server for privacy
en.what: AdGuard Home is a network-wide software for blocking ads and tracking. It operates as a DNS server that reroutes tracking domains to a 'black hole', preventing devices from connecting to those servers. It covers all home devices without needing client-side software.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, installation scripts, documentation (Wiki links), API references, build guides, and contribution guidelines. Multiple installation methods are provided, including automated scripts and Docker images.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with frontend components in TypeScript. Dependencies include DNS libraries and web UI frameworks, with Docker deployment support.
en.hot: With over 36k stars and 52 new stars today, ranking #14 on the TypeScript daily trending, this open-source project is a powerful Pi-hole alternative, gaining popularity among privacy enthusiasts.
uses: Home users who want to block ads and trackers at the router level to protect all connected devices.
Privacy advocates who care about online privacy and want to prevent devices from communicating with tracking servers.
Small network administrators who need centralized ad blocking without configuring each device individually.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理操控手机，跨 iOS/Android 的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: Mobile Next 是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，使 AI 代理和 LLM 能够通过统一接口自动化 iOS 和 Android 设备。它支持模拟器、仿真器和真实设备，无需分别掌握 iOS 或 Android 知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器源码、TypeScript 实现、安装脚本、文档和示例。提供结构化可访问性快照或基于截图的坐标点击，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等客户端。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 MCP SDK，通过 npm 分发。支持本地设备或 Mobile Next Cloud 云设备。
zh.hot: 星标数达 6244，今日新增 72，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜。它填补了 AI 代理移动端自动化的空白，兼容主流 AI 客户端，且无需平台特定知识。
uses: 移动应用测试人员：自动化 iOS/Android 原生应用的测试流程，无需手动操作设备。
AI 代理开发者：为基于 LLM 的代理框架添加移动设备交互能力，实现多步骤用户旅程。
数据录入与爬虫：通过脚本化流程自动填写表单或抓取移动应用数据，提高效率。
跨平台开发团队：统一 iOS 和 Android 自动化接口，降低学习成本，加速交付。

en.tag: MCP server for AI agents to control iOS/Android devices, simulators, and emulators
en.what: Mobile Next is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI agents and LLMs to automate iOS and Android devices through a unified interface. It works on simulators, emulators, and real devices, eliminating the need for separate iOS or Android expertise.
en.content: The repository contains the MCP server source code, TypeScript implementation, installation scripts, documentation, and examples. It offers structured accessibility snapshots or coordinate-based taps from screenshots, compatible with clients like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses the MCP SDK, distributed via npm. Supports local devices or Mobile Next Cloud for cloud-based real devices.
en.hot: With 6,244 stars and 72 added today, it's trending on the TypeScript daily list. It fills a gap in AI-driven mobile automation, works with major AI clients, and requires no platform-specific knowledge.
uses: Mobile app testers: automate native iOS/Android app testing without manual device control.
AI agent developers: add mobile device interaction to LLM-based frameworks for multi-step user journeys.
Data entry and scraping: script form filling or data extraction from mobile apps to boost efficiency.
Cross-platform teams: unify iOS and Android automation interfaces to reduce learning curve and speed up delivery.

zh.tag: 跨平台 Clash Meta GUI 客户端，基于 Tauri 2
zh.what: clash-verge-rev 是 Clash Verge 的延续项目，基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust 开发，提供 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上的图形化代理客户端。它内置 Clash.Meta (mihomo) 内核，支持系统代理、TUN 模式、配置管理等功能，旨在提供定制化的代理体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Tauri 应用源码，包括前端界面（TypeScript/React）、Rust 后端、内置 mihomo 内核集成，以及多语言文档（中英西俄日韩波斯）。提供稳定版、Alpha 和自动构建版本，支持自定义主题、CSS 注入、WebDAV 备份等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 和 Rust，基于 Tauri 2 框架，内置 Clash.Meta (mihomo) 内核。前端可能涉及 React 或类似框架，依赖系统代理和 TUN 等网络功能。
zh.hot: 拥有 14.1 万星标，今日新增 191，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 16。作为 Clash Verge 的活跃延续，它持续更新并支持多平台，吸引大量代理用户。
uses: 需要跨平台图形化代理客户端的用户，特别是 Clash 生态的现有用户。
希望利用 TUN 模式实现全局代理，或需要自定义主题和 CSS 注入的高级用户。
开发者可参考其 Tauri 2 与 Rust 集成实践，或参与贡献多语言文档。

en.tag: Cross-platform Clash Meta GUI client built with Tauri 2
en.what: clash-verge-rev is a continuation of Clash Verge, built with Tauri 2 and Rust, offering a graphical proxy client for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It embeds the Clash.Meta (mihomo) core, supports system proxy, TUN mode, and config management, aiming for a tailored proxy experience.
en.content: The repo contains full Tauri app source: frontend (TypeScript/React), Rust backend, mihomo core integration, and multi-language docs (Chinese, English, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Persian). Offers stable, alpha, and autobuild releases, with custom themes, CSS injection, WebDAV backup.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript and Rust, built on Tauri 2, embedding Clash.Meta (mihomo) core. Frontend likely uses React or similar, with system proxy and TUN networking features.
en.hot: With 141k stars and +191 today, ranking #16 on TypeScript daily trending. As an active continuation of Clash Verge, it receives frequent updates and multi-platform support, drawing many proxy users.
uses: Users needing a cross-platform GUI proxy client, especially existing Clash ecosystem users.
Advanced users wanting TUN mode for global proxying, or custom themes and CSS injection.
Developers can reference its Tauri 2 + Rust integration, or contribute to multi-language docs.

zh.tag: 自托管开发者控制中心，统一调度多款编码代理
zh.what: OpenHands Agent Canvas 是一个自托管的开发者控制中心，用于运行和管理编码代理及自动化任务。它支持本地、远程和云端多种后端，可连接 OpenHands、Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等 ACP 兼容代理，并内置自动化功能，如生成报告并发布到 Slack、自动分解 GitHub issue 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Agent Canvas 的核心代码、文档、自托管指南、自动化示例和截图，以及 npm 包 @openhands/agent-canvas。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 npm 分发，支持 Docker、VM 和云基础设施作为代理后端，遵循 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）。
zh.hot: 作为开源项目，它提供了统一管理多种 AI 编码代理的解决方案，满足开发者对自托管和自动化的需求，star 数已超 8.5 万，今日新增 97。
uses: 开发者希望自托管 AI 编码代理，避免依赖云服务。
团队需要自动化日常开发任务，如自动生成报告或分解 issue。
技术负责人想统一管理多种代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）的后端。

en.tag: Self-hosted developer control center for coding agents and automations
en.what: OpenHands Agent Canvas is a self-hosted developer control center for running and managing coding agents and automations. It supports local, remote, and cloud backends, connecting ACP-compatible agents like OpenHands, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini, with built-in automations such as generating reports to Slack or decomposing GitHub issues.
en.content: The repository contains Agent Canvas core code, docs, self-hosting guide, automation examples, screenshots, and the npm package @openhands/agent-canvas.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, distributed via npm, supports Docker, VMs, and cloud infrastructure as agent backends, following ACP (Agent Client Protocol).
en.hot: As an open-source project, it offers a unified solution for managing multiple AI coding agents, addressing developers' needs for self-hosting and automation, with over 85k stars and 97 new today.
uses: Developers who want to self-host AI coding agents to avoid cloud dependencies.
Teams needing to automate daily dev tasks like report generation or issue decomposition.
Tech leads wanting to manage multiple agent backends (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) in one place.

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与精选插件集
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方发布的插件仓库，包含插件规范（manifest 格式）和一系列官方/第三方插件，覆盖代码审查、文档可视化、CLI 设计、Gmail/Drive 集成等场景。每个插件独立成目录，通过 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 声明。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件一个文件夹，如 continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、pr-review-canvas、orchestrate 等，另有 third_party 目录存放 Gmail、Google Drive 等第三方集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Cursor SDK（@cursor/sdk），插件通过 plugin.json 清单定义，可能涉及 MCP、CLI 工具等。
zh.hot: Cursor 作为 AI 编辑器热度极高，官方插件仓库是生态扩展的关键入口，今日新增 27 星，总星数 2645，登上 TypeScript 日榜第 7 名，开发者关注如何用插件增强 AI 代理工作流。
uses: Cursor 用户：安装官方插件提升代码审查、文档浏览等效率
插件开发者：参考规范与示例创建自己的 Cursor 插件
团队协作：利用 Team Kit、Orchestrate 等插件优化 CI/CD 和并行任务处理

en.tag: Official Cursor plugin spec and curated plugins
en.what: This is the official Cursor plugin repository, containing the plugin specification (manifest format) and a collection of first-party and third-party plugins for code review, docs visualization, CLI design, Gmail/Drive integration, and more. Each plugin lives in its own directory with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest.
en.content: Each plugin is a standalone folder at the repo root, e.g., continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, pr-review-canvas, orchestrate, plus a third_party directory for Gmail, Google Drive, etc.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on the Cursor SDK (@cursor/sdk), plugins defined via plugin.json manifests, may involve MCP, CLI tools, etc.
en.hot: Cursor is a hot AI editor, and this official plugin repo is a key entry point for ecosystem expansion. With +27 stars today and 2,645 total, it ranks #7 on the TypeScript daily trending list, drawing developers interested in enhancing AI agent workflows via plugins.
uses: Cursor users: install official plugins to boost code review and docs navigation
Plugin developers: reference the spec and examples to create your own plugins
Teams: leverage Team Kit, Orchestrate, etc. to streamline CI/CD and parallel task handling

zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器
zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的Web应用源码，包括3D地球渲染、实时数据图层、语音控制AI代理、以及清晰的标注（如模拟与实时区分）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript，可能涉及Three.js或类似3D库、WebSocket实时数据、语音识别API等。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜排名第一，今日新增近2000星，因其独特的'真实数据间谍卫星'概念和病毒式传播的YouTube系列而迅速走红。
uses: 对开源情报、地理空间数据可视化感兴趣的开发者或研究者。
希望体验实时全球动态（航班、船舶、卫星等）的科技爱好者。
教育场景中用于演示实时数据源和3D可视化技术。

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely using Three.js or similar 3D libraries, WebSocket for real-time data, and speech recognition APIs.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending daily with ~2,000 stars added today, it went viral due to its unique 'real-data spy satellite' concept and the popular YouTube series behind it.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in open-source intelligence and geospatial data visualization.
Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: 用属性在HTML中直接实现AJAX、CSS过渡、WebSocket和SSE的轻量库
zh.what: htmx 是一个轻量级、无依赖的 JavaScript 库，允许你直接在 HTML 中使用属性（如 hx-post、hx-swap）来发起 AJAX 请求、应用 CSS 过渡、使用 WebSocket 和服务器发送事件。它旨在通过扩展 HTML 的超文本能力，简化现代用户界面的构建，让你无需编写大量 JavaScript 代码即可实现动态交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含 htmx 的源代码、文档网站、示例、扩展（如 ws、sse）以及贡献指南。核心是一个约 14k min.gz'd 的 JavaScript 文件，可通过 CDN 或 npm 安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，无外部依赖。开发依赖包括 Node.js 和 npm，用于本地开发和测试。
zh.hot: htmx 因其极简的编程模型而广受欢迎，让开发者无需编写复杂 JavaScript 即可实现现代交互。尽管今日新增 star 不多（32），但总星数已接近 5 万，反映出其在开发者社区中的持续热度。
uses: 后端开发者希望用简单方式增强 HTML 页面交互，而不想写大量前端 JS
全栈开发者寻求轻量级替代 React/Vue 的方案，用于快速原型或小型项目
喜欢 HATEOAS 和超媒体理念的开发者，希望构建符合 REST 架构的 Web 应用

en.tag: A lightweight library that lets you use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML with attributes
en.what: htmx is a lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript library that allows you to use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML using attributes like hx-post and hx-swap. It aims to simplify building modern user interfaces by extending HTML's hypertext capabilities, enabling dynamic interactions without writing much JavaScript.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of htmx, documentation website, examples, extensions (like ws, sse), and contribution guidelines. The core is a ~14k min.gz'd JavaScript file that can be installed via CDN or npm.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript with no external dependencies. Development dependencies include Node.js and npm for local development and testing.
en.hot: htmx is popular for its minimalist programming model, allowing developers to implement modern interactions without writing complex JavaScript. Although today's new stars are modest (32), the total star count is approaching 50k, reflecting its sustained popularity in the developer community.
uses: Backend developers who want to enhance HTML page interactions in a simple way without writing lots of frontend JS
Full-stack developers seeking a lightweight alternative to React/Vue for quick prototypes or small projects
Developers who embrace HATEOAS and hypermedia principles to build RESTful web applications

zh.tag: 让 AI 写作更像人：检测并改写 AI 腔的智能体技能
zh.what: 这是一个可移植的 AI 代理技能，用于审计和重写内容，去除常见的 AI 写作模式（如“Certainly!”、空洞的修饰语等）。它支持重写、检测和原地编辑三种模式，并可选语音风格（casual/professional 等），兼容 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex 等主流代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 skill 定义（SKILL.md）、检测引擎（JavaScript 实现）、演示 GIF 和文档。核心是一个规则驱动的检测器，可标记 13 类 AI 写作模式，并执行多轮重写以彻底清除残留。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，采用规则/模式匹配而非机器学习，轻量且可嵌入任何 agentskills.io 兼容的代理。无外部依赖，MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 3,598 星且单日新增 133，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第 8。AI 生成内容泛滥，开发者急需让输出“去 AI 味”的工具，而它恰好以 agent skill 形式即插即用。
uses: 内容创作者：用 Claude Code 等代理批量改写文章，去除 AI 腔，提升可读性。
开发者：在 CI 或本地用 Detect 模式审计 AI 生成的文档/提交信息，避免机械感。
团队：统一内容风格，通过 voice profile 定制专业、轻松或温暖等语气。
AI 代理开发者：集成此 skill 到自定义代理，增强文本后处理能力。

en.tag: Audit & rewrite AI-sounding text into natural prose, as a portable agent skill
en.what: A portable skill for AI agents that audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns ('AI-isms'). It offers three modes—rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place—plus optional voice profiles, and works with agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Codex.
en.content: The repo contains a portable skill definition (SKILL.md), a JavaScript-based detection engine, a demo GIF, and docs. The core is a rule-driven detector that flags 13 categories of AI patterns and performs multi-pass rewriting to catch leftovers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, using rule/pattern matching rather than ML, so it's lightweight and embeddable in any agentskills.io-compatible agent. No external dependencies, MIT licensed.
en.hot: With 3,598 stars and +133 today, it hit #8 on the JavaScript trending list. As AI-generated content floods the web, developers crave tools to make output sound human, and this skill plugs directly into their favorite agents.
uses: Content creators: use with Claude Code to rewrite articles in bulk, removing AI-isms for better readability.
Developers: run Detect mode in CI or locally to audit AI-generated docs/commit messages for robotic tone.
Teams: standardize content tone via voice profiles (casual, professional, warm, etc.).
Agent builders: integrate this skill into custom agents to enhance text post-processing.
