zh.content: 仓库包含一个 worker 后端项目，采用模块化结构，涵盖 API 层、数据访问层、邮件处理、安全认证等。前端使用 Vue3 和 Element Plus 构建响应式界面，并配有在线演示和部署文档。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Cloudflare Workers、Hono 框架、Drizzle ORM、Vue3、Element Plus、Resend、Cloudflare KV/D1/R2 以及 Workers AI。
zh.hot: 以低成本、易部署的方式提供完整邮箱服务，吸引了大量希望自建邮箱的用户。13.8k 星标表明其需求旺盛，且今日新增 31 星，持续受到关注。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队希望低成本搭建自己的邮箱服务，避免依赖第三方邮箱平台。
需要批量生成用户、通过 API 管理邮件的场景，如企业内部的邮件系统。
对邮件推送有需求，希望将邮件转发到 Telegram 或其他邮箱的用户。

en.tag: A lightweight email service built on Cloudflare Workers
en.what: Cloud Mail is an email service built on Cloudflare Workers, allowing you to create multiple mailboxes with just one domain. It supports sending emails, attachments, push notifications, and provides an admin panel and open API.
en.content: The repository contains a worker backend project with a modular structure covering API layer, data access, email processing, and security. The frontend is built with Vue3 and Element Plus for a responsive UI, with online demo and deployment docs.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Cloudflare Workers, Hono framework, Drizzle ORM, Vue3, Element Plus, Resend, Cloudflare KV/D1/R2, and Workers AI.
en.hot: It offers a full-featured email service at low cost and easy deployment, attracting many users who want to self-host email. With 13.8k stars and 31 new stars today, it remains highly popular.
uses: For individual developers or small teams who want to self-host email at low cost, avoiding reliance on third-party email platforms.
For scenarios requiring batch user creation and API-based email management, such as enterprise internal mail systems.
For users who need email push notifications, forwarding emails to Telegram or other mailboxes.

zh.tag: 互联网最流行的开源图标库与工具包
zh.what: Font Awesome 是互联网上最流行的图标库，提供可缩放的矢量图标、字体和 CSS 工具包。它被数百万设计师、开发者和内容创作者使用，用于在网页和桌面应用中快速添加高质量图标。
zh.content: 仓库包含图标字体文件（如 woff/woff2）、SVG 文件、CSS/SCSS 样式，以及用于集成 Font Awesome 的 JavaScript 文件。此外还有文档、升级指南和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 和 CSS，图标以 SVG 和字体格式提供，支持 Web 和桌面应用。依赖较少，易于集成到各种前端项目。
zh.hot: 尽管今日新增 star 不多，但总星数高达 76,894，反映了其作为长期维护的经典项目的稳定地位。近期发布 v7 版本，将 v6 标记为 LTS，引发社区关注。
uses: Web 开发者：在网站中快速添加图标，提升 UI 设计质量。
设计师：使用 SVG 图标进行原型设计和视觉稿制作。
内容创作者：在博客或文档中插入图标，增强可读性。
桌面应用开发者：通过字体或 SVG 在桌面应用中使用图标。

en.tag: The Internet's most popular open-source icon library and toolkit
en.what: Font Awesome is the Internet's most popular icon library, offering scalable vector icons, fonts, and CSS toolkit. Used by millions of designers, developers, and content creators to quickly add high-quality icons to web and desktop applications.
en.content: The repository contains icon font files (e.g., woff/woff2), SVG files, CSS/SCSS styles, and JavaScript files for integrating Font Awesome. It also includes documentation, upgrade guides, and contributing guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript and CSS, with icons provided in SVG and font formats, supporting web and desktop applications. Minimal dependencies, easy to integrate into various front-end projects.
en.hot: Despite modest daily stars, the total star count of 76,894 reflects its stable status as a long-maintained classic project. The recent release of v7, marking v6 as LTS, has drawn community attention.
uses: Web developers: quickly add icons to websites to enhance UI design quality.
Designers: use SVG icons for prototyping and visual mockups.
Content creators: insert icons into blogs or docs to improve readability.
Desktop app developers: use icons in desktop applications via fonts or SVG.

zh.tag: Rust 编写的高性能模态编辑器，融合 Kakoune 与 Neovim 优点
zh.what: Helix 是一个用 Rust 编写的模态文本编辑器，受 Kakoune 和 Neovim 启发，采用 Kakoune 的编辑模型。它提供类似 Vim 的模态编辑、多光标选择、内置语言服务器支持，以及基于 tree-sitter 的智能增量语法高亮。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的编辑器源码、文档（docs/）、运行时查询（runtime/queries/）用于语法高亮和缩进，以及截图和 logo 等资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 tree-sitter 进行语法分析，通过语言服务器协议（LSP）提供代码智能，并计划使用 wgpu 实现自定义渲染器。
zh.hot: 凭借 46k+ 星标和今日新增 28 星，Helix 在 Rust 趋势榜登顶，因其现代设计、高性能和活跃社区而备受关注。
uses: 喜欢 Vim 但追求更现代、开箱即用体验的开发者
需要高效多光标编辑和内置 LSP 支持的终端用户
对 Rust 编辑器实现或 tree-sitter 集成感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A post-modern modal text editor in Rust, blending Kakoune and Neovim ideas
en.what: Helix is a modal text editor written in Rust, inspired by Kakoune and Neovim, with an editing model heavily based on Kakoune. It offers Vim-like modal editing, multiple selections, built-in language server support, and smart incremental syntax highlighting via tree-sitter.
en.content: The repository contains the full editor source code, documentation (docs/), runtime queries (runtime/queries/) for syntax highlighting and indentation, plus screenshots and logo assets.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging tree-sitter for syntax parsing, LSP for language intelligence, and planning a custom renderer using wgpu.
en.hot: With 46k+ stars and 28 new today, Helix tops the Rust trending list, gaining attention for its modern design, high performance, and active community.
uses: Developers who like Vim but want a more modern, out-of-the-box experience
Terminal users needing efficient multi-cursor editing and built-in LSP support
Developers interested in Rust editor implementation or tree-sitter integration

zh.tag: 可嵌入的 Rust 高性能 SQL 查询引擎
zh.what: Apache DataFusion 是一个用 Rust 编写的可扩展 SQL 查询引擎，支持分布式查询、数据源连接和复杂分析。它提供内存计算、列式执行和优化器，可嵌入到其他应用中。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎库（datafusion）、命令行工具（datafusion-cli）、文档和示例，以及用于集成测试的基准测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，依赖 Arrow 列式内存格式、Parquet 文件格式，并支持多种数据源（如 CSV、JSON、S3）。
zh.hot: 作为 Apache 顶级项目，DataFusion 在 Rust 生态中备受关注，今日新增 7 星，日榜第 2，因其高性能和可嵌入性被广泛用于构建数据平台。
uses: 数据平台开发者：用于构建自定义查询引擎或数据仓库，如 InfluxDB 和 Ballista。
数据分析师：利用 datafusion-cli 快速查询本地文件或远程数据源。
基础设施工程师：作为库嵌入到服务中，提供 SQL 接口和分布式查询能力。

en.tag: Embeddable high-performance SQL query engine in Rust
en.what: Apache DataFusion is an extensible SQL query engine written in Rust, supporting distributed queries, data source connections, and complex analytics. It offers in-memory computation, columnar execution, and an optimizer, and can be embedded into other applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core engine library (datafusion), a command-line tool (datafusion-cli), documentation, examples, and benchmarks for integration testing.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, leveraging Arrow columnar memory format, Parquet file format, and supporting various data sources (e.g., CSV, JSON, S3).
en.hot: As an Apache top-level project, DataFusion is highly regarded in the Rust ecosystem, gaining 7 stars today and ranking #2 on the daily trending list, due to its high performance and embeddability for building data platforms.
uses: Data platform developers: build custom query engines or data warehouses, e.g., InfluxDB and Ballista.
Data analysts: use datafusion-cli to quickly query local files or remote data sources.
Infrastructure engineers: embed as a library to add SQL interface and distributed query capabilities to services.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的 Flash Player 模拟器，让旧动画在网页与桌面复活
zh.what: Ruffle 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Adobe Flash Player 模拟器，支持 ActionScript 1/2/3，可在桌面端和 Web 端（通过 WebAssembly）运行。它旨在安全地重现 Flash 内容，无需官方插件。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心模拟器、桌面应用、浏览器扩展（Chrome/Firefox）、Web 组件、Android 版、SWF 扫描器和导出工具，以及完整的构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，Web 端通过 WebAssembly 编译，桌面端使用 egui 等 GUI 框架，支持多种平台（Windows/macOS/Linux/Android）。
zh.hot: Flash 已死但经典内容仍在，Ruffle 提供安全兼容的替代方案，持续活跃开发，star 数达 18k+，在 Rust 日榜排名第三。
uses: 怀旧玩家：在浏览器或桌面重温 Flash 游戏和动画
网站开发者：嵌入 Ruffle 以保留旧 Flash 交互内容
教育研究者：分析 Flash 文件格式和 ActionScript 虚拟机

en.tag: A Flash Player emulator in Rust, reviving legacy SWF on web and desktop
en.what: Ruffle is an Adobe Flash Player emulator written in Rust, supporting ActionScript 1/2/3 and running on desktop and web via WebAssembly. It aims to safely replay Flash content without the official plugin.
en.content: The repo contains the core emulator, desktop app, browser extensions (Chrome/Firefox), web component, Android build, SWF scanner and exporter, along with build scripts and docs.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, compiled to WebAssembly for web, desktop uses egui GUI framework, supports Windows/macOS/Linux/Android.
en.hot: Flash is dead but classic content remains; Ruffle offers a safe and compatible alternative, actively developed with 18k+ stars, ranking #3 on Rust daily trending.
uses: Nostalgic users: replay Flash games and animations in browser or desktop
Web developers: embed Ruffle to preserve legacy Flash interactive content
Researchers: analyze Flash file format and ActionScript virtual machine

zh.tag: 开源 Spotify 客户端库，支持 Connect 接收器
zh.what: librespot 是一个开源的 Spotify 客户端库，允许应用控制并播放 Spotify 音乐，并可作为 Spotify Connect 接收器。它是官方已弃用的 libspotify 的替代品，并提供额外功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心库、命令行工具、文档（docs 文件夹）、编译指南和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言，依赖 crates.io 生态，支持多种音频后端。
zh.hot: 作为 Spotify 官方库的替代品，librespot 持续获得关注，目前拥有近 7000 星，今日新增 6 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第四。
uses: 开发自定义 Spotify 客户端或音乐播放器，利用其库功能
构建 Spotify Connect 接收器，如智能音箱或树莓派项目
学习 Rust 网络编程和音频流处理的开发者

en.tag: Open-source Spotify client library with Connect receiver support
en.what: librespot is an open-source Spotify client library that enables applications to control and play music from Spotify, and to act as a Spotify Connect receiver. It is an alternative to the deprecated official libspotify, with extra features.
en.content: The repository contains the core library written in Rust, a CLI tool, documentation in the docs folder, compilation guide, and contributing guidelines.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leverages the crates.io ecosystem, supports multiple audio backends.
en.hot: As a replacement for the official Spotify library, librespot maintains steady popularity with nearly 7k stars, gaining 6 today and ranking 4th on the Rust trending list.
uses: Develop custom Spotify clients or music players using its library features
Build Spotify Connect receivers for smart speakers or Raspberry Pi projects
Developers learning Rust networking and audio streaming

zh.tag: 超高速消息流平台，Rust 实现，Apache 顶级项目
zh.what: Apache Iggy 是一个用 Rust 编写的持久化消息流平台，旨在提供极致的吞吐量和低延迟。它支持流、主题、分区和消费者组，适用于实时数据管道和事件驱动架构。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心服务端、命令行客户端、多种语言的 SDK（如 Rust、JavaScript、Python、Java、.NET），以及 Docker 部署配置和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 异步运行时（如 Tokio），使用 Apache 2.0 许可证。提供多种客户端库，支持 TCP 和 HTTP 协议。
zh.hot: 凭借 Rust 的高性能和 Apache 背书，Iggy 在 GitHub 上获得 4621 星，今日新增 15 星，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 5，吸引了对高性能消息队列感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 需要低延迟、高吞吐消息流的后端服务开发者
构建实时数据管道或事件驱动微服务的团队
希望用 Rust 替代 Kafka 等传统消息队列的架构师

en.tag: Hyper-efficient message streaming platform in Rust, Apache top-level project
en.what: Apache Iggy is a persistent message streaming platform written in Rust, designed for extreme throughput and low latency. It supports streams, topics, partitions, and consumer groups, suitable for real-time data pipelines and event-driven architectures.
en.content: The repository includes the Rust core server, CLI client, SDKs for multiple languages (Rust, JavaScript, Python, Java, .NET), Docker deployment configs, and documentation.
en.stack: Built on Rust async runtime (e.g., Tokio), licensed under Apache 2.0. Provides client libraries for multiple languages, supporting TCP and HTTP protocols.
en.hot: With Rust's high performance and Apache backing, Iggy has gained 4,621 stars, +15 today, ranking #5 on the Rust trending list, attracting developers interested in high-performance message queues.
uses: Backend developers needing low-latency, high-throughput message streaming
Teams building real-time data pipelines or event-driven microservices
Architects looking to replace traditional message queues like Kafka with Rust

zh.tag: 自托管分布式 Durable Objects 守护进程
zh.what: celld 是一个开源守护进程，让你在自己的机器上运行 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects。每个对象都是一个 cell，即一个带有独立 SQLite 数据库的命名服务器，长期状态存储在你自己拥有的对象存储桶中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 celld 守护进程的 Rust 源码、安装脚本、Docker 镜像配置、文档（包括 guarantees.md）以及示例部署。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，内嵌 V8 引擎执行 Wrangler bundles，依赖 SQLite 和 LTX 事务格式，支持 S3、GCS、Azure Blob 存储。
zh.hot: 自托管 Durable Objects 填补了边缘计算空白，无需控制平面和共识服务，成本极低，上线即登 GitHub Trending 日榜。
uses: 希望摆脱云厂商锁定、在自有服务器上运行 Cloudflare Workers 的开发者
需要低成本、高可用分布式状态存储的团队，尤其是边缘计算场景
对 Durable Objects 架构感兴趣，想深入理解其实现原理的技术爱好者

en.tag: Self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects daemon
en.what: celld is an open-source daemon that runs Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects on your own machines. Each object is a cell: a named server with its own SQLite database, and long-term state is stored in a bucket you own.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for the celld daemon, an install script, Docker image configuration, documentation (including guarantees.md), and example deployments.
en.stack: Written in Rust, embeds V8 to execute Wrangler bundles, relies on SQLite and LTX transaction format, supports S3, GCS, Azure Blob Storage.
en.hot: Self-hosting Durable Objects fills a gap in edge computing, requiring no control plane or consensus service, with near-zero cost for idle cells, quickly hitting GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers who want to run Cloudflare Workers on their own servers and avoid vendor lock-in
Teams needing low-cost, highly available distributed state storage, especially for edge computing
Tech enthusiasts interested in Durable Objects architecture and its implementation details

zh.tag: 终端起家的智能开发环境，内置 AI 代理与协作工作流
zh.what: Warp 是一个从终端演化而来的智能开发环境，内置编码代理，也支持接入 Claude Code、Codex 等外部 CLI 代理。它通过 AI 代理自动处理问题分类、编写规格、实现变更和审查 PR，让开源维护更高效。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Warp 客户端的完整开源代码，分为 UI 框架（warpui_core 和 warpui）与其余部分，采用 MIT 与 AGPL v3 双许可。还提供 build.warp.dev 仪表盘，可查看数千个 Oz 代理的工作状态。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，UI 框架部分采用 MIT 许可，其余为 AGPL v3。依赖 GPT 模型驱动代理管理工作流，并支持多种外部 CLI 代理集成。
zh.hot: Warp 以 6.4 万星持续霸榜，今日新增 37 星。其将终端升级为智能开发环境，并开源核心代码，吸引大量开发者关注 AI 驱动的开发流程。
uses: 开发者希望用 AI 代理自动化日常编码任务，如问题分类和 PR 审查。
开源维护者想借助 Oz for OSS 合作计划，提升社区管理效率。
对终端工具感兴趣，想体验下一代智能终端与开发环境融合。

en.tag: Agentic development environment born from the terminal, with built-in AI agents and collaborative workflows
en.what: Warp is an agentic development environment that evolved from the terminal, featuring a built-in coding agent and support for external CLI agents like Claude Code and Codex. It uses AI agents to automate issue triage, spec writing, implementation, and PR review, making open-source maintenance more efficient.
en.content: The repository contains the full open-source client codebase, split into UI framework crates (warpui_core, warpui) and the rest, dual-licensed under MIT and AGPL v3. It also offers a build.warp.dev dashboard to watch thousands of Oz agents in action.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with the UI framework under MIT license and the rest under AGPL v3. It relies on GPT models for agentic management workflows and supports integration with various external CLI agents.
en.hot: Warp maintains a strong presence with 64.6k stars and 37 new stars today. By open-sourcing its core and transforming the terminal into an agentic development environment, it attracts developers interested in AI-driven workflows.
uses: Developers seeking to automate routine coding tasks with AI agents, such as issue triage and PR review.
Open-source maintainers wanting to leverage the Oz for OSS partner program to improve community management efficiency.
Terminal enthusiasts interested in experiencing the next-generation intelligent terminal integrated with development environment.

zh.tag: 为 git 等命令提供语法高亮的分页器
zh.what: delta 是一个命令行工具，作为 git、diff、grep 等命令的分页器，提供语法高亮和增强的差异显示。它支持词级差异高亮、并排视图、行号等功能，让代码审查更直观。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、安装脚本和配置文件。核心是一个可执行文件 delta，通过配置集成到 git 中。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 bat 的语法高亮主题，利用 Levenshtein 编辑推断算法实现词级差异。
zh.hot: 拥有 3.2 万 star，因其显著提升 git 输出可读性而广受欢迎，是开发者日常工具链的必备品。
uses: 开发者日常使用 git 命令行时，希望获得更清晰、高亮的 diff 输出。
需要高效审查大型代码变更，利用并排视图和导航键快速浏览。
喜欢自定义终端配色和样式，追求个性化开发环境的用户。

en.tag: A syntax-highlighting pager for git, diff, grep, and more
en.what: Delta is a command-line tool that acts as a pager for git, diff, grep, and other commands, providing syntax highlighting and enhanced diff display. It supports word-level diff highlighting, side-by-side view, line numbers, and more, making code review more intuitive.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, installation scripts, and configuration files. The core is an executable named delta, integrated into git via configuration.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it uses bat's syntax highlighting themes and a Levenshtein edit inference algorithm for word-level diffs.
en.hot: With 31,977 stars, it's popular for dramatically improving git output readability, making it a must-have in developers' daily toolchains.
uses: Developers who use git CLI daily and want clearer, syntax-highlighted diff output.
Those reviewing large code changes efficiently with side-by-side view and navigation keys.
Users who enjoy customizing terminal colors and styles for a personalized dev environment.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的 GNU coreutils，跨平台替代品
zh.what: uutils coreutils 是一个用 Rust 重新实现的 GNU coreutils 工具集，目标是成为 GNU 工具的即插即用替代品。它支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 等多种平台，并尽可能与 GNU 行为保持一致。
zh.content: 仓库包含所有核心工具的实现，如 ls、cat、cp 等，并提供预编译二进制、man 手册和 shell 补全。文档包括用户手册和开发者文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 上的库，支持多种操作系统，包括 Linux、macOS、BSD、Windows 和 WASI。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态中备受关注的项目，拥有 24k+ star，因其跨平台特性和对 GNU 兼容性的追求而受欢迎，且已被 Ubuntu 默认集成。
uses: 系统管理员和开发者需要在不同操作系统上使用一致的命令行工具
Rust 爱好者希望研究或贡献一个大型 Rust 项目
需要更安全、更现代的工具替代传统 GNU 工具的用户

en.tag: Cross-platform Rust rewrite of GNU coreutils as a drop-in replacement
en.what: uutils coreutils is a Rust reimplementation of the GNU coreutils, aiming to be a drop-in replacement. It supports multiple platforms like Linux, macOS, and Windows, and strives for exact compatibility with GNU behavior.
en.content: The repository contains implementations of all core utilities like ls, cat, cp, etc., along with prebuilt binaries, manpages, and shell completions. Documentation includes user and developer manuals.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging crates.io libraries, supporting multiple OSes including Linux, macOS, BSD, Windows, and WASI.
en.hot: With over 24k stars, it's a popular Rust project, valued for cross-platform support and GNU compatibility, and is now shipped by default on Ubuntu.
uses: System administrators and developers needing consistent CLI tools across different OSes
Rust enthusiasts interested in studying or contributing to a large Rust project
Users seeking safer, more modern alternatives to traditional GNU tools

zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing

zh.tag: 智能友好的命令行 shell，开箱即用
zh.what: fish 是一个为 macOS、Linux 等系统设计的智能且用户友好的命令行 shell。它提供语法高亮、输入自动建议和智能的标签补全等功能，无需任何配置即可使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 fish shell 的完整源代码、构建脚本、文档和测试。主要目录包括 src（Rust 实现）、doc_src（文档源文件）和 tests（测试套件）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，同时包含 C++ 组件（用于历史记录和补全等）。依赖 POSIX 工具和 CMake 构建系统。
zh.hot: fish 因其对用户友好的设计而长期受欢迎，star 数已超过 3.4 万。今日新增 12 个 star，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 11 名，持续吸引新用户。
uses: 日常使用命令行但希望更高效、更易用的开发者或系统管理员。
希望无需配置即可获得语法高亮和自动建议的 shell 用户。
对 Rust 实现 shell 感兴趣，想学习或贡献的开发者。

en.tag: A smart and user-friendly command line shell for macOS, Linux, and more
en.what: fish is a smart and user-friendly command line shell for macOS, Linux, and the rest of the family. It includes features like syntax highlighting, autosuggest-as-you-type, and fancy tab completions that just work, with no configuration required.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build scripts, documentation, and tests for the fish shell. Key directories include src (Rust implementation), doc_src (documentation sources), and tests (test suite).
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with some C++ components for history and completion. Depends on POSIX utilities and uses CMake for building.
en.hot: fish has long been popular for its user-friendly design, with over 34k stars. Gaining 12 stars today and ranking 11th on the Rust trending list, it continues to attract new users.
uses: Developers or system administrators who use the command line daily and want a more efficient, user-friendly experience.
Shell users who want syntax highlighting and autosuggestions without any configuration.
Developers interested in a Rust-implemented shell, for learning or contributing.

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it uses Silero VAD for voice-activity detection and supports local Whisper (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large) and Parakeet V3 models with optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Amid rising privacy concerns and cloud-service costs, Handy's 'fully open-source and fully offline' positioning has resonated strongly with developers, adding nearly 3,000 stars this month to reach 26.7K+ and ranking 17th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — writers and professionals who need local voice input without cloud uploads.
Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: Rust 编程语言官方仓库：编译器、标准库与文档
zh.what: Rust 是一门系统编程语言，强调性能、可靠性和生产力。该仓库是 Rust 的主源码仓库，包含编译器、标准库和文档。
zh.content: 仓库包含 rustc 编译器、标准库、文档以及相关工具链的源码，并提供了贡献指南和架构说明。
zh.stack: Rust 语言本身编写，使用 Cargo 构建，依赖 LLVM 作为后端，并包含 rustfmt、Clippy 等工具。
zh.hot: Rust 持续受到开发者青睐，今日新增 319 星，总星数达 11.6 万，稳居趋势榜前列。
uses: 系统编程开发者：构建高性能、内存安全的底层应用。
WebAssembly 和嵌入式开发者：利用 Rust 的安全性和性能。
希望学习现代编程语言的学生和爱好者：通过官方文档和示例入门。

en.tag: Official repository for Rust: compiler, standard library, and docs
en.what: Rust is a systems programming language focused on performance, reliability, and productivity. This repository is the main source code repository for Rust, containing the compiler, standard library, and documentation.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for the rustc compiler, standard library, documentation, and related tooling, along with contribution guidelines and architecture descriptions.
en.stack: Written in Rust, built with Cargo, uses LLVM as backend, and includes tools like rustfmt and Clippy.
en.hot: Rust continues to gain popularity, with 319 stars today and a total of 116,668, consistently ranking high on trending lists.
uses: Systems programmers building high-performance, memory-safe low-level applications.
WebAssembly and embedded developers leveraging Rust's safety and performance.
Students and enthusiasts learning modern programming languages via official docs and examples.

zh.tag: 离线隐私优先的 Rust 英语语法检查器
zh.what: Harper 是一个开源的英语语法检查工具，强调快速、隐私和轻量。它完全离线运行，不发送用户数据到服务器，适合注重隐私的用户。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心语法检查引擎、命令行工具、语言服务器（harper-ls）、WebAssembly 版本以及多种编辑器集成（如 Obsidian 插件）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，支持 WebAssembly 编译，可嵌入网页。依赖较少，内存占用低。
zh.hot: 凭借离线隐私、毫秒级速度和极低内存占用，在 GitHub 上获得 14.8k 星，成为 Rust 趋势榜常客。
uses: 注重隐私的写作者，希望语法检查完全离线进行
开发者和技术写作者，需要快速、轻量的语法检查工具
Obsidian 用户，通过插件无缝集成语法检查功能

en.tag: Offline, privacy-first English grammar checker powered by Rust
en.what: Harper is an open-source English grammar checker that prioritizes speed, privacy, and low resource usage. It runs entirely offline, ensuring user data never leaves the device.
en.content: The repository includes the core grammar checking engine, a CLI, a language server (harper-ls), a WebAssembly build, and integrations for editors like Obsidian.
en.stack: Written in Rust, compiles to WebAssembly for web use, with minimal dependencies and low memory footprint.
en.hot: With offline privacy, millisecond linting, and tiny memory usage, it has gained 14.8k stars and frequently appears on the Rust trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious writers who want grammar checking entirely offline
Developers and technical writers needing a fast, lightweight grammar checker
Obsidian users who want seamless grammar checking via plugin

zh.tag: 桌面 AI 代理，把每个任务变成可打开的 App
zh.what: BitFun 是一个桌面 AI 代理，结合了 Rust 编写的高性能代理运行时和精美的桌面应用。它既能像代码代理一样深入处理软件开发任务，又具备开放、通用的能力，适用于软件开发之外的各种工作。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码、Rust 代理运行时、Mini Apps 框架、自托管设备同步服务器，以及文档、脚本和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写核心运行时，桌面应用支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，模型无关，支持 MCP、Skills、Hooks 等扩展。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的 Agentic Mini Apps 概念（为每个任务创建专属界面）和卓越性能（KV 缓存命中率 98.67%，搜索快 36 倍），在 GitHub 上迅速获得 1873 颗星，并登上 Rust 趋势榜。
uses: 开发者：在真实 Git 仓库中进行规划、编辑、测试和提交，支持长周期任务。
办公人员：用于研究、写作、演示文稿、会议记录和报告生成。
高级用户：通过自定义代理、MCP、Skills 和 Mini Apps 深度定制工作流。
多设备用户：自托管同步服务器，实现跨设备会话同步和设备间控制。

en.tag: A desktop AI agent that turns every task into an app you can open
en.what: BitFun is a desktop AI agent that combines a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust with a polished desktop application. It pairs the depth of a Code Agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development.
en.content: The repository contains the desktop app source, Rust agent runtime, Mini Apps framework, self-hosted device-sync server, along with docs, scripts, and examples.
en.stack: Core runtime is written in Rust; desktop app supports Windows, macOS, Linux; model-agnostic with MCP, Skills, Hooks extensions.
en.hot: With its innovative Agentic Mini Apps concept (giving each task its own interface) and impressive performance (98.67% KV cache hit rate, 36x faster search), it quickly gained 1,873 stars and hit the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers: plan, edit, test, and commit in real Git repos with long-horizon tasks.
Office workers: research, writing, presentations, meeting notes, and reports.
Power users: deeply customize workflows via custom agents, MCP, Skills, and Mini Apps.
Multi-device users: self-host sync server for cross-device session sync and control.

zh.tag: 闪电般快速的搜索引擎 API，内置 AI 混合搜索
zh.what: Meilisearch 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能搜索引擎，提供开箱即用的搜索体验，支持 AI 驱动的混合搜索（语义+关键词）。它旨在轻松集成到任何应用或网站中，帮助开发者快速构建出色的搜索功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的搜索引擎实现，包括核心搜索库、REST API、管理界面（如演示应用）、文档和示例。主要目录有 `meilisearch`（核心）、`crates`（模块化组件）、`assets`（图片和演示）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖包括 Actix Web（HTTP 服务器）、Tantivy（全文搜索引擎）、serde（序列化）等。支持多种平台，可通过 Docker 或二进制文件部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 59k+ 的 star 和持续的热度，Meilisearch 因其易用性、高性能和 AI 混合搜索功能而备受青睐。今日新增 16 个 star，在 Rust 趋势榜上排名第 16，显示出稳定的社区关注。
uses: 开发者需要在应用中快速集成搜索功能，如电商网站、博客或文档站点。
团队希望从 Elasticsearch 等复杂方案迁移到更轻量、易维护的搜索服务。
需要支持语义搜索和关键词搜索混合的场景，如知识库、内容平台。
对搜索性能要求高，且希望部署简单、资源占用低的中小型项目。

en.tag: Lightning-fast search engine API with built-in AI hybrid search
en.what: Meilisearch is a high-performance search engine written in Rust, offering out-of-the-box search experience with AI-powered hybrid search (semantic + keyword). It is designed to integrate easily into any app or website, helping developers build great search features quickly.
en.content: The repository contains the full search engine implementation, including core search library, REST API, admin UI (like demo apps), documentation, and examples. Main directories include `meilisearch` (core), `crates` (modular components), `assets` (images and demos), etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with dependencies like Actix Web (HTTP server), Tantivy (full-text search engine), serde (serialization), etc. Supports multiple platforms and can be deployed via Docker or binaries.
en.hot: With 59k+ stars and sustained popularity, Meilisearch is favored for its ease of use, high performance, and AI hybrid search. Gaining 16 stars today and ranking #16 on Rust trending, it shows steady community interest.
uses: Developers needing to quickly integrate search into apps like e-commerce, blogs, or documentation sites.
Teams looking to migrate from complex solutions like Elasticsearch to a lighter, more maintainable search service.
Scenarios requiring hybrid semantic and keyword search, such as knowledge bases or content platforms.
Small to medium projects with high search performance requirements and simple, low-resource deployment.

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编程代理会话搜索与分析工具
zh.what: AgentsView 是一个本地优先的工具，用于浏览、搜索和跟踪所有 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等 20 多种）的会话记录和成本。它无需账户，所有数据都存储在本地，提供 Web UI 和命令行接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 编写的二进制文件，提供 serve、daemon、session、usage 等子命令，支持 SQLite 存储、S3 集成、Docker 部署，以及桌面应用（macOS/Windows）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 SQLite 数据库，支持 S3 兼容对象存储，提供 Docker 镜像和 Homebrew 安装方式。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程代理的普及，开发者需要统一管理多个代理的会话和成本，AgentsView 提供了本地优先的解决方案，因此在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 142 星。
uses: 使用多个 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）的开发者，希望集中查看会话历史和 token 消耗。
需要监控 AI 编程成本并生成使用报告的个人或团队。
对数据隐私敏感，希望所有会话数据保留在本地的用户。
希望通过 S3 同步或 Docker 部署实现跨设备会话管理的用户。

en.tag: Local-first session search, analytics, and token usage stats for AI coding agents
en.what: AgentsView is a local-first tool for browsing, searching, and tracking sessions and costs across all your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and 20+ others). No accounts required; all data stays local, with a web UI and CLI.
en.content: The repo contains a Go binary with subcommands like serve, daemon, session, usage; supports SQLite storage, S3 integration, Docker deployment, and a desktop app (macOS/Windows).
en.stack: Primarily Go, with SQLite database, S3-compatible object storage support, Docker image, and Homebrew cask.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers need a unified way to manage sessions and costs across multiple agents; AgentsView offers a local-first solution, gaining rapid traction with 142 stars today.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) who want a unified view of session history and token usage.
Individuals or teams needing to monitor AI coding costs and generate usage reports.
Privacy-conscious users who want all session data to remain local.
Users who want cross-device session management via S3 sync or Docker deployment.

zh.tag: 一键追溯进程、端口、容器或文件的启动来源，CLI + TUI
zh.what: witr 是一个命令行工具，用于回答“为什么这个在运行？”的问题。它能追溯任何进程、端口、容器或文件的启动来源，并显示完整的启动链，如 systemd → PM2 → node。它提供 CLI 和交互式 TUI 两种模式，支持输出机器可读的 JSON。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 和 TUI 二进制，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 和 FreeBSD。提供浏览器模拟沙盒用于教程和自由练习，还有详细的文档和示例输出。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖系统工具如 ps、lsof、ss、systemctl 和 docker ps 来收集信息，并可能使用 Bubble Tea 等库构建 TUI。
zh.hot: 解决了开发者和运维人员排查问题的痛点，将多个命令的输出关联成因果链，节省时间。在 GitHub 上获得 2.1 万星标，日增 71，登上 Go 趋势榜第三。
uses: 系统管理员排查服务异常启动或端口占用问题，快速定位根源。
开发者在容器或微服务环境中追踪进程的启动链，理解依赖关系。
安全分析师调查可疑进程或文件，追溯其来源以评估风险。
DevOps 工程师在 CI/CD 流水线中集成 witr，自动化诊断运行环境。

en.tag: Trace any process, port, container, or file back to its origin with CLI and TUI
en.what: witr is a CLI tool that answers 'Why is this running?' by tracing any process, port, container, or file back to its exact startup chain, such as systemd → PM2 → node. It offers both a CLI and an interactive TUI, with machine-readable JSON output.
en.content: The repo contains Go-built CLI and TUI binaries for Linux, macOS, Windows, and FreeBSD. It includes a browser-based sandbox for tutorials and free play, plus detailed docs and example outputs.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging system utilities like ps, lsof, ss, systemctl, and docker ps for data collection, and likely using libraries like Bubble Tea for the TUI.
en.hot: It addresses a common pain point for developers and sysadmins by correlating outputs from multiple commands into a causal chain, saving time. With 21.9k stars and 71 daily additions, it ranks #3 on GitHub Trending for Go.
uses: System administrators troubleshooting unexpected service starts or port conflicts to quickly identify the root cause.
Developers tracing process startup chains in containerized or microservice environments to understand dependencies.
Security analysts investigating suspicious processes or files to trace their origin and assess risk.
DevOps engineers integrating witr into CI/CD pipelines for automated environment diagnostics.

zh.tag: 无需控制面的点对点加密网络工具
zh.what: Tailcat 是 Tailscale 开源组件的重混，类似 netcat，但通过 Tailscale 数据面（magicsock）实现点对点 WireGuard 加密隧道，使用 DERP 作为 NAT 穿透辅助和中继。它不需要 Tailscale 账户或 root 权限，所有连接元数据通过带外方式交换。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 库（可导入为 github.com/tailscale/tailcat）和命令行工具 cmd/tailcat，以及一个实验性的 WebAssembly 浏览器演示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Tailscale 的 magicsock 数据面、WireGuard 加密、DERP 中继，支持 Nix flakes 安装。
zh.hot: 今日新增 965 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名。它提供了一种无需 Tailscale 控制面的轻量级安全连接方式，吸引了开发者的关注。
uses: 需要临时在两台机器间安全传输数据或管道的开发者，无需配置复杂 VPN。
希望在没有 Tailscale 账户或 root 权限的情况下建立加密点对点连接的用户。
对 Tailscale 内部数据面机制感兴趣，想研究或复用其开源组件的技术人员。
需要快速暴露本地端口或进行端口转发的场景，但希望避免传统 netcat 的不安全性。

en.tag: P2P encrypted networking tool without control plane
en.what: Tailcat is a remix of Tailscale open source pieces to act like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane (magicsock) for point-to-point WireGuard-encrypted tunnels, with DERP as NAT-hole-punching side channel and relay. It requires no Tailscale account or root access, and all connection metadata is exchanged out of band.
en.content: The repo contains a Go library (importable as github.com/tailscale/tailcat) and a CLI tool cmd/tailcat, plus an experimental WebAssembly browser demo.
en.stack: Primarily Go, leveraging Tailscale's magicsock data plane, WireGuard encryption, DERP relay, with Nix flakes support.
en.hot: Gained 965 stars today, ranking #11 on GitHub Trending. It offers a lightweight secure connection method without Tailscale's control plane, attracting developers.
uses: Developers needing secure data transfer or piping between two machines without complex VPN setup.
Users who want encrypted P2P connections without a Tailscale account or root access.
Tech enthusiasts interested in Tailscale's internal data plane mechanisms for research or reuse.
Scenarios requiring quick local port exposure or forwarding with better security than traditional netcat.

en.tag: Millisecond model router for agentic systems; cut costs 40-70% with just an endpoint change.

Teams needing to switch or optimize model calls without changing business code.
High-concurrency scenarios sensitive to routing latency, requiring millisecond-level responses.

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的零配置安全组网工具
zh.what: Tailscale 是一个基于 WireGuard 的现代 VPN 服务，让用户能在任何地方安全地访问自己的设备。它简化了 WireGuard 的配置，并集成了双因素认证（2FA），提供最简便、最安全的组网方案。

自托管爱好者：将家庭服务器、NAS 等设备组成私有网络，随时随地访问。
开发者：快速搭建跨地域的开发环境，或用于测试分布式应用。

en.tag: Zero-config secure networking built on WireGuard

Self-hosters: connect home servers, NAS, and other devices into a private network accessible from anywhere.

zh.what: Kubernetes 是一个开源系统，用于跨多主机管理容器化应用，提供部署、维护和扩展应用的基本机制。它基于 Google 大规模运行生产工作负载的 Borg 系统经验，并结合社区最佳实践。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kubernetes 的完整源代码、文档、构建脚本和组件，如 kube-apiserver、kube-controller-manager、kube-scheduler 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 etcd 存储、Docker/containerd 等容器运行时，支持多种云平台。
zh.hot: 作为云原生计算基金会（CNCF）的旗舰项目，Kubernetes 已成为容器编排的事实标准，拥有庞大的社区和生态，star 数持续增长。
uses: 开发者和运维人员：用于部署和管理微服务应用，实现自动化伸缩和滚动更新。
云原生架构师：设计和实施容器化基础设施，构建多云或混合云平台。
平台工程师：基于 Kubernetes 构建内部开发者平台（IDP）或 PaaS 服务。

en.tag: Production-grade container orchestration and scheduling system
en.what: Kubernetes is an open-source system for managing containerized applications across multiple hosts, providing basic mechanisms for deployment, maintenance, and scaling. It builds on Google's Borg system experience and community best practices.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, build scripts, and components of Kubernetes, such as kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relies on etcd for storage, container runtimes like Docker/containerd, and supports multiple cloud platforms.
en.hot: As the flagship project of CNCF, Kubernetes has become the de facto standard for container orchestration, with a massive community and ecosystem, and its star count continues to grow.
uses: Developers and operators: deploy and manage microservices applications, enabling auto-scaling and rolling updates.
Cloud-native architects: design and implement containerized infrastructure, building multi-cloud or hybrid cloud platforms.
Platform engineers: build internal developer platforms (IDP) or PaaS services on top of Kubernetes.

zh.tag: Cloudflare 官方隧道客户端，安全内网穿透工具
zh.what: cloudflared 是 Cloudflare Tunnel 的命令行客户端，它作为一个守护进程，将来自 Cloudflare 网络的流量代理到你的源站（如 Web 服务器）。它允许你在不开放防火墙端口的情况下，将内部服务安全地暴露到公网。
zh.content: 仓库包含 cloudflared 的源代码、构建脚本和文档。它支持通过命令行进行隧道管理，并提供多种安装方式，包括二进制、Docker 镜像、Debian/RPM 包和 Homebrew。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Cloudflare 的 API 和 QUIC 协议。支持跨平台，包括 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare 官方工具，它提供了零配置的内网穿透方案，无需公网 IP 和复杂防火墙设置，因此受到开发者和运维人员的广泛欢迎。今日新增 14 星，持续保持热度。
uses: 开发者需要将本地 Web 服务安全暴露到公网进行测试或演示。
运维人员希望在不开放防火墙端口的情况下，将内部应用（如 SSH、RDP）提供给外部访问。
个人用户想要通过自有域名访问家庭网络中的服务，如 NAS 或智能家居。

en.tag: Official Cloudflare Tunnel client for secure, firewall-free origin connectivity
en.what: cloudflared is the command-line client for Cloudflare Tunnel, a daemon that proxies traffic from the Cloudflare network to your origins. It enables secure public exposure of internal services without opening firewall ports.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build scripts, and documentation for cloudflared. It supports tunnel management via CLI and offers multiple installation methods including binaries, Docker, Debian/RPM packages, and Homebrew.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging Cloudflare's API and QUIC protocol. Cross-platform support for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: As an official Cloudflare tool, it offers a zero-configuration tunnel solution without requiring public IPs or complex firewall setups, making it popular among developers and DevOps. Gaining 14 stars today, it remains consistently popular.
uses: Developers needing to securely expose local web services to the public for testing or demos.
DevOps professionals wanting to provide external access to internal apps (e.g., SSH, RDP) without opening firewall ports.
Individuals wanting to access home network services like NAS or smart home devices via their own domain.

zh.tag: 自托管待办事项管理应用，强调数据自主可控
zh.what: Vikunja 是一款开源、自托管的待办事项管理应用，支持多用户、多项目、任务分配、标签、优先级、看板视图等。它强调用户对数据的完全所有权，提供 Web、桌面和移动端界面，并支持多种集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的后端（Go）、前端（Vue.js）、桌面应用（Electron）以及移动端（Flutter）的源代码，还有 Docker 部署配置、API 文档和自动化测试。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，前端基于 Vue.js，桌面端用 Electron，移动端用 Flutter。数据库支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 和 MySQL，通过 Docker 可轻松部署。
zh.hot: 随着用户对数据隐私和自主控制的关注增加，自托管应用需求上升。Vikunja 提供功能丰富且美观的界面，同时保持开源和自由，吸引了大量用户。
uses: 个人用户希望完全掌控自己的待办事项数据，避免云服务商锁定。
团队或企业需要内部部署的任务管理工具，确保数据不出内网。
开发者希望定制或扩展任务管理功能，利用其 API 和开源代码。

en.tag: Self-hosted task manager that puts you in control of your data
en.what: Vikunja is an open-source, self-hosted to-do list and task management application. It supports multi-user, multi-project, task assignment, labels, priorities, kanban boards, and more. It emphasizes complete user ownership of data, offering web, desktop, and mobile interfaces with various integrations.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for the backend (Go), frontend (Vue.js), desktop app (Electron), and mobile app (Flutter), along with Docker deployment configs, API docs, and automated tests.
en.stack: Backend is written in Go, frontend uses Vue.js, desktop app is built with Electron, and mobile app uses Flutter. It supports SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL databases, and can be easily deployed via Docker.
en.hot: With growing concerns about data privacy and ownership, self-hosted apps are in demand. Vikunja offers a feature-rich and beautiful interface while remaining open-source and free, attracting many users.
uses: Individuals who want full control over their task data and avoid vendor lock-in.
Teams or companies needing an on-premise task management tool to keep data within their network.
Developers who want to customize or extend task management features using its API and open-source code.

zh.tag: 容器安全隔离的应用内核，用 Go 实现 Linux 用户态内核
zh.what: gVisor 是一个应用内核，为运行中的应用程序与宿主机操作系统之间提供强大的隔离层。它实现了 Linux 接口，但用内存安全的 Go 语言编写并在用户态运行，旨在提供类似虚拟机的安全优势，同时保持较低的资源占用和快速启动。
zh.content: 仓库包含 gVisor 的核心源码，包括用户态内核、OCI 运行时 runsc，以及集成 Docker 和 Kubernetes 的组件。还包含文档、构建配置和测试。
zh.stack: 主要用 Go 编写，支持 x86_64 和 ARM64 架构。依赖 Linux 内核功能，但运行在用户态，不依赖特定硬件。
zh.hot: gVisor 是容器安全领域的知名项目，由 Google 维护，star 数接近 2 万，持续获得关注。它提供了独特的容器沙箱方案，在安全性和性能之间取得平衡。
uses: 运行不受信任或潜在恶意代码的容器，防止容器逃逸
在多租户环境中隔离工作负载，增强云原生安全
需要比传统容器更强隔离但不想使用完整虚拟机的场景
安全研究人员和开发者学习用户态内核实现

en.tag: Application kernel for containers, providing strong isolation via a userspace Linux-like kernel in Go
en.what: gVisor is an application kernel that provides a strong layer of isolation between running applications and the host OS. It implements a Linux-like interface but is written in memory-safe Go and runs in userspace, offering many security benefits of VMs while maintaining low resource footprint and fast startup.
en.content: The repository contains the core source code of gVisor, including the userspace kernel, the OCI runtime runsc, and components for integrating with Docker and Kubernetes. It also includes documentation, build configurations, and tests.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, supporting x86_64 and ARM64 architectures. It leverages existing host kernel functionality but runs as a normal userspace process, without requiring fixed physical resources.
en.hot: gVisor is a well-known project in container security, maintained by Google, with nearly 20k stars and continuous attention. It offers a unique container sandboxing approach balancing security and performance.
uses: Running containers with untrusted or potentially malicious code to prevent container escape
Isolating workloads in multi-tenant environments to enhance cloud-native security
Scenarios requiring stronger isolation than traditional containers but without full VMs
Security researchers and developers learning userspace kernel implementation

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，支持多协议与多平台
zh.what: sing-box 是一个通用代理平台，提供高性能的网络代理功能，支持多种代理协议（如 Shadowsocks、VMess、Trojan 等）和平台（包括 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 等）。它旨在为用户提供灵活、可配置的代理解决方案，适用于各种网络环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 sing-box 的源代码、构建脚本、文档（位于 sing-box.sagernet.org）以及许可证信息。项目使用 Go 语言编写，提供命令行工具，可通过配置文件进行定制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖多种网络库，支持多平台编译。
zh.hot: sing-box 因其强大的功能和灵活性在 GitHub 上获得 37k+ 星标，今日新增 30 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 19 名，持续受到网络代理用户的关注。
uses: 适合需要科学上网或绕过网络限制的个人用户，提供稳定高效的代理服务。
适用于开发者或系统管理员，用于搭建自定义代理服务器或集成到现有网络架构中。
适合对隐私和安全性有较高要求的用户，通过代理加密流量保护数据。

en.tag: Universal proxy platform supporting multiple protocols and platforms
en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform that provides high-performance network proxying capabilities, supporting multiple proxy protocols (such as Shadowsocks, VMess, Trojan, etc.) and platforms (including Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, etc.). It aims to offer flexible and configurable proxy solutions for various network environments.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build scripts, documentation (hosted at sing-box.sagernet.org), and license information. The project is written in Go and provides a command-line tool that can be customized via configuration files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, leveraging various networking libraries, and supports cross-platform compilation.
en.hot: sing-box has gained 37k+ stars on GitHub due to its powerful features and flexibility, with 30 new stars today, ranking 19th on the Go trending list, continuing to attract attention from proxy users.
uses: Ideal for individual users needing to bypass network restrictions or access blocked content, providing stable and efficient proxy services.
Suitable for developers or system administrators to set up custom proxy servers or integrate into existing network infrastructure.
Great for users with high privacy and security requirements, encrypting traffic to protect data.

zh.tag: 像 Prometheus 一样，但面向日志的聚合系统
zh.what: Loki 是一个水平可扩展、高可用、多租户的日志聚合系统，受 Prometheus 启发。它不索引日志内容，而是索引每个日志流的标签，因此成本低、易于操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Loki 主服务代码，以及文档、Helm chart 等。日志采集由 Alloy（原 Promtail）负责，查询和展示由 Grafana 完成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Grafana 生态，支持 Kubernetes 环境。
zh.hot: Loki 是 Grafana 官方日志方案，与 Prometheus 标签体系无缝集成，深受云原生用户欢迎。虽然今日新增 star 不多，但累计 2.8 万 star 证明其长期热度。
uses: Kubernetes 集群日志收集与查询，利用 Pod 标签自动索引
需要低成本、高扩展性日志存储的云原生应用
Grafana 用户希望统一监控与日志查询场景

en.tag: Like Prometheus, but for logs: a log aggregation system
en.what: Loki is a horizontally-scalable, highly-available, multi-tenant log aggregation system inspired by Prometheus. It does not index the contents of logs, but rather a set of labels for each log stream, making it cost-effective and easy to operate.
en.content: The repository contains the main Loki service code, along with documentation and Helm charts. Log collection is handled by Alloy (formerly Promtail), and querying/display is done via Grafana.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, integrates with the Grafana ecosystem, and supports Kubernetes environments.
en.hot: Loki is Grafana's official logging solution, seamlessly integrating with Prometheus labels, making it popular among cloud-native users. Despite modest daily stars, its 28.8k cumulative stars reflect sustained popularity.
uses: Collecting and querying Kubernetes cluster logs with automatic Pod label indexing
Cloud-native applications needing cost-effective, scalable log storage
Grafana users who want unified metrics and log querying

zh.tag: 网络侦察与中间人攻击的多功能瑞士军刀
zh.what: bettercap 是一个用 Go 编写的强大、易扩展且可移植的框架，旨在为安全研究人员、红队和逆向工程师提供一站式解决方案，用于 WiFi、蓝牙低功耗、CAN 总线、无线 HID 设备和以太网网络的侦察与攻击。它支持多种协议，包括 802.11、BLE、HID、CAN-bus、IPv4 和 IPv6。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 bettercap 源代码、模块化架构、交互式 UI、REST API 以及详细的文档。它提供 WiFi 扫描、去认证攻击、BLE 设备扫描、CAN-bus 注入、HID 键盘模拟等功能，并支持跨平台运行（Linux、macOS、Windows）和 Docker 部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 libpcap 进行数据包捕获，支持多种网络协议。项目还集成了 Web UI 和 REST API，便于远程控制。
zh.hot: 拥有近 2 万星标，今日新增 22 星，在 Go 语言趋势榜排名第 21。作为一款功能全面的网络攻击工具，它持续受到安全社区关注，且近期更新活跃。
uses: 安全研究人员用于网络漏洞评估和渗透测试，例如 WiFi 安全审计。
红队成员在授权测试中执行中间人攻击和网络侦察。
逆向工程师分析蓝牙低功耗设备或 CAN 总线通信。
教育用途，用于学习网络协议和攻击原理。

en.tag: Swiss Army knife for network recon and MITM attacks
en.what: bettercap is a powerful, easily extensible and portable framework written in Go that aims to offer security researchers, red teamers and reverse engineers an easy-to-use, all-in-one solution for reconnaissance and attacking WiFi networks, Bluetooth Low Energy devices, CAN-bus, wireless HID devices and Ethernet networks. It supports multiple protocols including 802.11, BLE, HID, CAN-bus, IPv4 and IPv6.
en.content: The repository contains the full bettercap source code, modular architecture, interactive UI, REST API, and extensive documentation. It offers WiFi scanning, deauthentication attacks, BLE device scanning, CAN-bus injection, HID keyboard emulation, and more, with cross-platform support (Linux, macOS, Windows) and Docker deployment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it relies on libpcap for packet capture and supports various network protocols. The project also integrates a Web UI and REST API for remote control.
en.hot: With nearly 20k stars and 22 new stars today, it ranks #21 on the Go trending list. As a comprehensive network attack tool, it remains popular in the security community with active recent updates.
uses: Security researchers use it for network vulnerability assessment and penetration testing, such as WiFi security audits.
Red team members perform MITM attacks and network reconnaissance during authorized tests.
Reverse engineers analyze BLE devices or CAN-bus communications.
Educational purposes for learning network protocols and attack principles.

zh.tag: 用 Markdown 定义 AI 代理工作流，安全运行于 GitHub Actions
zh.what: gh-aw 是 GitHub 官方的 CLI 扩展，让开发者用 Markdown 加 YAML frontmatter 定义 AI 代理工作流，并编译为标准的 GitHub Actions 工作流。它用于需要推理或解释的任务，如问题分类、PR 审查、CI 失败调查等，补充而非替代传统 CI/CD。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 扩展源码、文档（快速开始、工作原理、安全指南）、示例工作流以及社区贡献。核心是编译命令 `gh aw compile`，将 Markdown 源文件转换为 GitHub Actions 执行的 `.lock.yml` 工作流。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，作为 GitHub CLI 扩展构建。内置 AI 引擎支持 GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Google Gemini 和 Pi，依赖 GitHub Actions 执行。
zh.hot: GitHub 官方出品，将 AI 代理与 Actions 安全结合，引发关注。本周新增 56 星，总星数近 5000，位列 Go 周榜第 19，反映开发者对 AI 自动化工作流的需求。
uses: 开发者希望用 AI 自动化仓库维护任务，如 issue 分类、PR 审查、CI 失败调查。
团队需要在现有 CI/CD 流程中安全引入 AI 代理，且不牺牲安全性和可控性。
对 GitHub Actions 熟悉，想探索 AI 代理工作流最佳实践的技术负责人。

en.tag: Define AI agent workflows in Markdown, run securely on GitHub Actions
en.what: gh-aw is an official GitHub CLI extension that lets developers define AI-powered repository automation in Markdown with YAML frontmatter, compiling each workflow into a standard GitHub Actions workflow. It handles tasks requiring reasoning or interpretation, such as issue triage, PR review, CI failure investigation, complementing rather than replacing traditional CI/CD.
en.content: The repository contains the CLI extension source, documentation (quick start, how it works, security), sample workflows, and community contributions. The core is the `gh aw compile` command that transforms Markdown source into `.lock.yml` workflows executed by GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built as a GitHub CLI extension. Built-in AI engines include GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, and Pi, relying on GitHub Actions for execution.
en.hot: Official GitHub project combining AI agents with Actions securely, gaining traction. With 56 new stars this week and nearly 5k total, ranking #19 on Go weekly trending, it reflects developer demand for AI-driven automation workflows.
uses: Developers looking to automate repo maintenance tasks like issue triage, PR review, and CI failure investigation with AI.
Teams wanting to safely integrate AI agents into existing CI/CD pipelines without compromising security and control.
Tech leads familiar with GitHub Actions who want to explore best practices for AI agent workflows.

zh.tag: 原生集成 AI 代理的 Windows Terminal 分支
zh.what: Intelligent Terminal 是 Windows Terminal 的实验性分支，原生集成了 AI 代理功能。它支持任何符合 Agent Client Protocol (ACP) 的代理 CLI，默认配置 GitHub Copilot CLI，让用户在命令行中直接与 AI 交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的终端应用源码、文档、安装指南和构建脚本。主要组件包括代理状态栏、代理面板、代理管理、错误检测和命令面板等功能模块。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖 Windows Terminal 的代码库，支持 WinGet 和 Microsoft Store 分发。需要 Windows 10 2004 或更高版本，以及 ACP 兼容的代理 CLI。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，它把 AI 代理直接集成到终端，吸引了大量开发者关注。上线不久即获得近 2000 星，日增 66 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 开发者希望在命令行中直接使用 AI 辅助编程，如代码生成、错误排查。
Windows 用户想要一个原生支持 AI 代理的终端，替代传统终端。
对 ACP 协议感兴趣，希望尝试不同 AI 代理 CLI 的开发者。

en.tag: A Windows Terminal fork with native AI agent integration
en.what: Intelligent Terminal is an experimental fork of Windows Terminal with native agent integration. It works with any ACP-compatible agent CLI, defaulting to GitHub Copilot CLI, enabling direct AI interaction in the command line.
en.content: The repository contains the full terminal application source code, documentation, installation guides, and build scripts. Key components include agent status bar, agent pane, agent management, error detection, and command palette.
en.stack: Developed in C++, based on the Windows Terminal codebase, distributed via WinGet and Microsoft Store. Requires Windows 10 2004 or later and an ACP-compatible agent CLI.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, it integrates AI agents directly into the terminal, attracting significant developer attention. It gained nearly 2000 stars shortly after launch, with 66 stars added daily, trending on GitHub.
uses: Developers who want AI-assisted coding directly in the command line, such as code generation and error debugging.
Windows users seeking a terminal with native AI agent support, replacing traditional terminals.
Developers interested in the ACP protocol and trying different AI agent CLIs.

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试
学习 xUnit 测试框架设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: C++ 即时模式 GUI 库，轻量无依赖
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个面向 C++ 的轻量级图形用户界面库，采用即时模式设计，输出优化后的顶点缓冲区，可在 3D 渲染管线中随时绘制。它旨在快速迭代，帮助程序员创建内容创作工具、可视化工具和调试工具，而非面向终端用户的传统 UI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Dear ImGui 的完整源代码、示例（如示例窗口和演示）、文档（README、Wiki 链接）以及构建配置。核心代码集中在 imgui.cpp、imgui.h 等文件中，并支持多种渲染后端和平台集成。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖，支持 OpenGL、DirectX、Vulkan 等渲染后端，以及 GLFW、SDL 等平台层。
zh.hot: 拥有 75,965 颗星，长期活跃且被广泛使用，是游戏开发、工具开发领域的事实标准。今日新增 23 星，仍保持热度。
uses: 游戏开发中用于调试工具和编辑器界面，快速迭代 UI。
工具开发者创建可视化、内容创作或内部工具。
需要轻量、可嵌入 GUI 的 C++ 项目，如模拟器、渲染器。

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++ that outputs optimized vertex buffers for rendering in 3D-pipeline-enabled applications. It is designed to enable fast iterations and empower programmers to create content creation tools, visualization/debug tools, rather than UI for end-users.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Dear ImGui, including examples (e.g., example windows and demo), documentation (README, Wiki links), and build configurations. Core code is in files like imgui.cpp and imgui.h, with support for multiple rendering backends and platform integrations.
en.stack: Implemented in pure C++ with no external dependencies, supporting rendering backends like OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, and platform layers like GLFW and SDL.
en.hot: With 75,965 stars, it is a long-standing, widely-used standard in game development and tooling. Gaining 23 stars today, it remains popular.
uses: Game developers use it for debug tools and editor UIs, enabling rapid iteration.
Tool developers create visualization, content creation, or internal tools.
C++ projects needing a lightweight, embeddable GUI, such as emulators and renderers.

zh.tag: 开源跨平台 2D/3D 游戏引擎，社区驱动
zh.what: Godot 是一个功能全面的跨平台游戏引擎，提供统一的界面来创建 2D 和 3D 游戏。它内置了丰富的常用工具，用户无需重复造轮子，可以专注于游戏开发。游戏可一键导出到多个平台，包括桌面、移动、网页和主机。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎的完整源代码、编辑器、文档和示例项目。主要目录包括核心引擎代码（C++）、场景系统、渲染器、脚本语言（GDScript）、编辑器界面以及导出模板。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种脚本语言（如 GDScript、C#、VisualScript）。依赖包括 OpenGL/Vulkan 渲染、音频库等，并支持跨平台构建。
zh.hot: Godot 因其完全免费、开源且无版税的特点而广受欢迎，社区活跃，持续更新。本月新增 1876 星，总星数达 116k，在 C++ 趋势榜中排名第 17，显示出其强大的吸引力和用户基础。
uses: 独立游戏开发者：利用 Godot 的免费开源特性，低成本开发并发布跨平台游戏。
教育场景：作为教学工具，学习游戏开发、编程和引擎架构。
游戏工作室：用于原型设计和快速迭代，支持从 2D 到 3D 的多样化项目。
开源贡献者：参与引擎开发，通过社区协作改进功能和修复问题。

en.tag: Free & open-source cross-platform 2D/3D game engine, community-driven
en.what: Godot is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, allowing users to focus on making games without reinventing the wheel. Games can be exported with one click to multiple platforms, including desktop, mobile, web, and consoles.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source code, editor, documentation, and demos. Key directories include core engine code (C++), scene system, renderers, scripting language (GDScript), editor UI, and export templates.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with support for multiple scripting languages (e.g., GDScript, C#, VisualScript). Dependencies include OpenGL/Vulkan rendering, audio libraries, and cross-platform build support.
en.hot: Godot is popular for being completely free, open-source, and royalty-free, with an active community and continuous updates. With 1,876 new stars this month and 116k total, ranking #17 on the C++ trending list, it demonstrates strong appeal and a solid user base.
uses: Indie game developers: Leverage Godot's free and open-source nature to develop and publish cross-platform games at low cost.
Educational settings: Use as a teaching tool to learn game development, programming, and engine architecture.
Game studios: For prototyping and rapid iteration, supporting diverse projects from 2D to 3D.
Open-source contributors: Participate in engine development, improving features and fixing issues through community collaboration.

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架
zh.what: WinUI 是微软推出的现代 UI 框架，提供丰富的控件和样式，用于构建高性能的 Windows 应用程序。当前版本 WinUI 3 作为 Windows App SDK 的一部分发布，支持 Fluent Design，并可通过 .NET 或 C++ 开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WinUI 的源代码、文档、示例和 WinUI 3 Gallery 交互式演示，涵盖控件库、样式、工具和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，基于 Windows App SDK，支持 C#/.NET 和 C++ 开发，面向 x86、x64 和 ARM 架构。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方 UI 框架，WinUI 是 Windows 应用开发的核心，本月新增 140 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 5，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Windows 桌面应用开发者，希望使用现代 Fluent Design 构建应用
需要跨版本兼容（Windows 10 1809+）的 Win32 或 UWP 开发者
学习微软官方 UI 框架和 Windows App SDK 的学生或爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.
en.content: The repo contains the source code, documentation, samples, and the WinUI 3 Gallery interactive demo, covering control libraries, styles, tools, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, built on the Windows App SDK, supporting C#/.NET and C++ development for x86, x64, and ARM architectures.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official UI framework, WinUI is central to Windows app development, gaining 140 stars this month and ranking 5th in the C++ monthly trending, showing sustained developer interest.
uses: Windows desktop app developers wanting modern Fluent Design
Win32 or UWP developers needing cross-version compatibility (Windows 10 1809+)
Students or enthusiasts learning Microsoft's official UI framework and Windows App SDK

zh.tag: 比特币核心客户端与全节点实现
zh.what: Bitcoin Core 是比特币的官方参考客户端，连接比特币点对点网络，下载并完全验证区块和交易。它包含钱包和图形界面（可选构建），是比特币网络运行的基础软件。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源码、文档（doc 文件夹）、测试（单元测试和 Python 集成测试）以及构建脚本。master 分支持续构建和测试，但稳定性不保证，稳定版本通过标签发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Boost、Qt（GUI）、libevent 等库。测试使用 Python 和 ctest，CI 覆盖 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: 作为比特币的官方实现，拥有超 9 万 star，是加密货币领域最受关注的项目之一。今日新增 15 star，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 比特币用户：运行全节点以增强网络去中心化，保障交易验证的自主性。
开发者：参与比特币核心开发，贡献代码或测试，理解区块链底层原理。
研究者：分析比特币协议实现，进行安全审计或学术研究。

en.tag: Bitcoin Core full node client and reference implementation
en.what: Bitcoin Core is the official reference client for Bitcoin, connecting to the peer-to-peer network to download and fully validate blocks and transactions. It includes an optional wallet and GUI, serving as the foundational software for the Bitcoin network.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, documentation (doc folder), tests (unit and Python integration tests), and build scripts. The master branch is continuously built and tested but not guaranteed stable; stable releases are tagged.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on Boost, Qt (GUI), libevent, etc. Testing uses Python and ctest, with CI covering Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: As the official Bitcoin implementation, it has over 90k stars, making it one of the most watched projects in crypto. With 15 new stars today, it continues to attract developer attention.
uses: Bitcoin users: run a full node to strengthen network decentralization and verify transactions independently.
Developers: contribute to Bitcoin Core development, test pull requests, and understand blockchain internals.
Researchers: analyze the protocol implementation for security audits or academic study.

zh.tag: 单文件分发运行大模型的跨平台工具
zh.what: llamafile 将 llama.cpp 与 Cosmopolitan Libc 结合，把大语言模型打包成单个可执行文件，用户无需安装即可在多数操作系统和 CPU 架构上本地运行。它还包含 whisperfile，实现单文件的语音转文字功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 llamafile 的源码、构建系统、文档以及预构建的 llamafile 可执行文件示例。它基于 llama.cpp 和 whisper.cpp，并支持多种模型格式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Cosmopolitan Libc 实现跨平台可执行性，并集成 llama.cpp 和 whisper.cpp。
zh.hot: 凭借单文件运行大模型的极简体验，llamafile 获得近 2.6 万星标，今日新增 48，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 8，深受开发者喜爱。
uses: 开发者：快速分发和测试 LLM 应用，无需配置复杂环境。
终端用户：在个人电脑上轻松运行聊天或语音转文字模型。
教育场景：演示 LLM 能力，降低学习门槛。

en.tag: Distribute and run LLMs as a single cross-platform executable
en.what: llamafile combines llama.cpp with Cosmopolitan Libc to package LLMs into a single executable that runs locally on most OSes and CPU architectures without installation. It also includes whisperfile, a single-file speech-to-text tool.
en.content: The repo contains source code, build system, docs, and pre-built llamafile executables. It's based on llama.cpp and whisper.cpp, supporting multiple model formats.
en.stack: Primarily C++, leveraging Cosmopolitan Libc for cross-platform executables, integrating llama.cpp and whisper.cpp.
en.hot: With its minimalist single-file LLM execution, llamafile has gained ~26k stars, +48 today, ranking #8 on C++ trending, beloved by developers.
uses: Developers: quickly distribute and test LLM apps without complex setup.
End users: easily run chat or speech-to-text models on personal computers.
Educational: demonstrate LLM capabilities with low barrier to entry.

zh.tag: 高效、灵活、可移植的分布式梯度提升库
zh.what: XGBoost 是一个优化的分布式梯度提升库，旨在高效、灵活且可移植地实现机器学习算法。它提供并行树提升（GBDT、GBM），能够快速准确地解决许多数据科学问题，支持处理数十亿样本。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 实现、多语言接口（Python、R、Java、Scala、C 等）、分布式环境支持（Kubernetes、Hadoop、Spark、Dask、Flink 等），以及文档、示例和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、R、Java、Scala 等语言的 API，依赖分布式计算框架如 Spark、Dask 和 Flink，并支持 GPU 加速。
zh.hot: XGBoost 是机器学习竞赛和工业界的经典工具，拥有 28.7k 星标，因其卓越的性能和广泛的适用性而持续受到关注。
uses: 数据科学家和机器学习工程师在 Kaggle 竞赛中构建高精度模型
金融、电商等领域进行风险预测、用户行为分析等任务
需要处理大规模数据集并利用分布式计算资源的场景
学术研究和教学，作为梯度提升算法的基准实现

en.tag: Optimized distributed gradient boosting library for efficient, flexible and portable ML
en.what: XGBoost is an optimized distributed gradient boosting library designed to be highly efficient, flexible and portable. It implements machine learning algorithms under the Gradient Boosting framework, providing parallel tree boosting that solves data science problems fast and accurately, scaling to billions of examples.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ implementation, multi-language interfaces (Python, R, Java, Scala, C, etc.), support for distributed environments (Kubernetes, Hadoop, Spark, Dask, Flink, etc.), along with documentation, examples, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with APIs for Python, R, Java, Scala, etc. It integrates with distributed computing frameworks like Spark, Dask, and Flink, and supports GPU acceleration.
en.hot: XGBoost is a classic tool in ML competitions and industry, with 28.7k stars, remaining popular due to its outstanding performance and broad applicability.
uses: Data scientists and ML engineers building high-accuracy models in Kaggle competitions
Risk prediction, user behavior analysis in finance, e-commerce, and other domains
Scenarios requiring large-scale data processing with distributed computing resources
Academic research and teaching as a benchmark implementation of gradient boosting

zh.tag: 基于MCP的AI语音聊天机器人，支持多终端控制
zh.what: 小智AI聊天机器人是一个基于MCP协议的语音交互入口，利用Qwen/DeepSeek等大模型的AI能力，通过MCP协议实现多终端控制。它支持离线语音唤醒、全双工对话、多种网络连接方式，并可在多种ESP32芯片上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的固件源码、文档（如MCP架构图、ESP-IDF 6迁移指南）、以及自定义资源生成器（用于定制唤醒词、字体、表情等）。支持Wi-Fi、以太网、4G等多种网络，以及WebSocket和MQTT+UDP两种通信传输。
zh.stack: 主要使用C++，基于ESP-IDF框架，依赖ESP-SR（语音识别）、ESP-ADF（音频处理）、以及MCP协议库。支持多种ESP32芯片平台，并集成了Qwen/DeepSeek等大模型API。
zh.hot: 凭借MCP协议实现设备控制与云端扩展，加上丰富的功能（如全双工对话、自定义唤醒词）和活跃的社区，在GitHub上获得近3万星标，今日新增50星，位列C++趋势榜第8。
uses: 硬件爱好者：DIY一个AI语音助手，体验从零搭建智能音箱的乐趣。
开发者：学习如何将大模型与嵌入式设备结合，实现语音交互和MCP协议应用。
智能家居用户：通过语音控制家中设备，享受便捷的智能生活。
教育场景：作为教学项目，展示AI、语音识别和物联网的集成实践。

en.tag: MCP-based AI voice chatbot enabling multi-terminal control
en.what: XiaoZhi AI chatbot is a voice interaction entry leveraging MCP protocol, utilizing AI capabilities of large models like Qwen/DeepSeek, and enabling multi-terminal control via MCP. It supports offline voice wake-up, full-duplex conversation, multiple network connections, and runs on various ESP32 chips.
en.content: The repository contains complete firmware source code, documentation (e.g., MCP architecture diagram, ESP-IDF 6 migration guide), and a custom assets generator for personalizing wake words, fonts, emojis, etc. It supports multiple networks like Wi-Fi, Ethernet, 4G, and two communication transports: WebSocket and MQTT+UDP.
en.stack: Primarily C++, built on ESP-IDF framework, with dependencies on ESP-SR for speech recognition, ESP-ADF for audio processing, and MCP protocol libraries. Supports multiple ESP32 chip platforms and integrates large model APIs like Qwen/DeepSeek.
en.hot: With MCP protocol enabling device control and cloud extension, plus rich features like full-duplex conversation and customizable wake words, it has gained nearly 30k stars on GitHub, with 50 new stars today, ranking #8 on C++ trending.
uses: Hardware enthusiasts: DIY an AI voice assistant and enjoy building a smart speaker from scratch.
Developers: Learn how to integrate large models with embedded devices for voice interaction and MCP protocol applications.
Smart home users: Control home devices via voice for a convenient smart lifestyle.
Educational settings: Use as a teaching project to demonstrate integration of AI, speech recognition, and IoT.

zh.tag: 网格优化库，让3D模型更小更快渲染
zh.what: meshoptimizer 是一个用于优化三角形网格的库，通过算法减少网格的复杂度和存储开销，同时提升 GPU 渲染管线的效率。它提供 C/C++ 接口，并支持通过 FFI 从其他语言调用，如 Rust 和 JavaScript。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码（src/）、命令行工具 gltfpack（gltf/）、单头文件 LOD 库（demo/clusterlod.h）以及测试和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 C 和 C++ API，支持 CMake 构建，并有 Rust crate 和 JavaScript 绑定。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 图形领域的经典库，star 数达 8284，今日新增 3，持续受到游戏开发和实时渲染社区的关注。
uses: 游戏开发者和实时渲染工程师，用于优化模型资源，提升渲染性能。
3D 内容制作工具链，如 glTF 文件的自动优化，通过 gltfpack 命令行工具。
需要跨语言调用的场景，如 Rust 或 JavaScript 项目，通过 FFI 或绑定使用。

en.tag: Mesh optimization library that makes meshes smaller and faster to render
en.what: meshoptimizer is a library for optimizing triangle meshes, using algorithms to reduce mesh complexity and storage overhead while improving GPU pipeline efficiency. It provides C/C++ interfaces and supports calling from other languages via FFI, such as Rust and JavaScript.
en.content: The repository contains core library source (src/), command-line tool gltfpack (gltf/), single-header LOD library (demo/clusterlod.h), and tests and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, provides C and C++ APIs, supports CMake build, and has Rust crate and JavaScript bindings.
en.hot: As a classic library in 3D graphics, it has 8284 stars, with 3 new today, continuously gaining attention from game development and real-time rendering communities.
uses: Game developers and real-time rendering engineers, to optimize model assets and improve rendering performance.
3D content production pipelines, such as automatic optimization of glTF files via gltfpack command-line tool.
Scenarios requiring cross-language calls, such as Rust or JavaScript projects, via FFI or bindings.

zh.tag: 免费开源的 PlayStation 2 模拟器
zh.what: PCSX2 是一个免费开源的 PS2 模拟器，通过模拟 PS2 硬件，让玩家在 PC 上运行 PS2 游戏。它结合了 MIPS CPU 解释器、动态重编译器和虚拟机来管理硬件状态和系统内存。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码、构建配置（支持 Windows/Linux/Mac）、文档、兼容性列表链接，以及用于翻译的 Crowdin 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并利用 wxWidgets 或 Qt 等 GUI 框架（具体取决于版本）。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 20 年历史，兼容性列表已测试 2500+ 游戏，近期在 GitHub Trending 上热度上升，日增 10 星。
uses: 怀旧玩家：在 PC 上重温 PS2 经典游戏，如《最终幻想 X》和《鬼泣 3》。
游戏开发者：测试游戏兼容性或研究主机模拟技术。
技术爱好者：学习模拟器开发、MIPS 架构和动态重编译。

en.tag: Free and open-source PlayStation 2 emulator
en.what: PCSX2 is a free and open-source PS2 emulator that emulates PS2 hardware to let you play PS2 games on your PC. It uses a combination of MIPS CPU interpreters, recompilers, and a virtual machine to manage hardware states and system memory.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build configurations for Windows/Linux/Mac, documentation, compatibility list links, and Crowdin integration for translations.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, uses CMake build system, and relies on GUI frameworks like wxWidgets or Qt depending on the version.
en.hot: With over 20 years of development and 2500+ tested games, it's gaining traction on GitHub Trending with 10 stars added today.
uses: Retro gamers: replay classic PS2 titles like Final Fantasy X and Devil May Cry 3 on PC.
Game developers: test game compatibility or study console emulation techniques.
Tech enthusiasts: learn about emulator development, MIPS architecture, and dynamic recompilation.

zh.tag: UE4/5 游戏注入式 Lua 脚本与调试工具集
zh.what: RE-UE4SS 是一个针对虚幻引擎 4/5 游戏的注入式 Lua 脚本系统，支持 C++ 模组 API、SDK 生成器、蓝图模组加载和实时属性编辑器。它允许玩家和模组开发者在不修改游戏文件的情况下编写和加载模组，并提供调试工具来查看和修改运行时对象属性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 UE4SS 源码、预编译的发布版本（含开发版 zDEV）、详细的文档（Lua API、C++ 模组指南、功能概览）以及示例模组。主要组件包括 Lua 脚本引擎、蓝图模组加载器、属性查看器/编辑器、UHT 转储器、C++ 头文件生成器、USMap 转储器和 UMAP 重建转储器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Unreal Engine 的反射系统和 Lua 脚本语言。构建系统支持 CMake，并针对不同 UE 版本（4.7 至 5.8）提供适配。
zh.hot: GitHub 日榜（C++）第 13 名，拥有 2845 颗星，今日新增 2 颗。作为 UE4/5 游戏模组开发的核心工具，它解决了模组加载和调试的痛点，持续吸引模组社区关注。
uses: 游戏模组开发者：利用 Lua 或 C++ API 为 UE4/5 游戏编写和加载模组，无需修改游戏文件。
逆向工程与游戏调试：使用实时属性编辑器查看和修改运行时对象属性，辅助分析游戏机制。
游戏爱好者：通过蓝图模组加载器轻松安装和运行社区模组，增强游戏体验。
UE 开发者：借助 SDK 生成器和头文件转储器快速生成游戏项目镜像，用于学习或工具开发。

en.tag: Injectable Lua scripting, SDK generator & live property editor for UE4/5 games
en.what: RE-UE4SS is an injectable Lua scripting system for Unreal Engine 4/5 games, featuring a C++ modding API, SDK generator, blueprint mod loader, and live property editor. It enables players and modders to create and load mods without altering game files, and offers debugging utilities to inspect and modify object properties at runtime.
en.content: The repository contains the full UE4SS source code, precompiled releases (including dev zDEV builds), extensive documentation (Lua API, C++ mod guides, feature overviews), and example mods. Key components include the Lua scripting engine, blueprint mod loader, live property viewer/editor, UHT dumper, C++ header generator, USMap dumper, and UMAP recreation dumper.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Unreal Engine's reflection system and Lua scripting. The build system uses CMake, with support for UE versions from 4.7 to 5.8.
en.hot: Ranked #13 on GitHub Trending (C++) with 2,845 stars and 2 new stars today. As a core tool for UE4/5 modding, it addresses pain points in mod loading and debugging, continuously drawing attention from the modding community.
uses: Game mod developers: Use Lua or C++ APIs to write and load mods for UE4/5 games without modifying game files.
Reverse engineers and debuggers: Use the live property editor to inspect and modify runtime object properties, aiding in game mechanics analysis.
Game enthusiasts: Easily install and run community mods via the blueprint mod loader to enhance gameplay.
UE developers: Leverage SDK generators and header dumpers to quickly create mirror game projects for learning or tool development.

zh.tag: 跨平台 PSP 模拟器，C++ 编写，支持多平台
zh.what: PPSSPP 是一款快速且可移植的 PSP 模拟器，无需 BIOS 文件即可运行游戏。它采用 HLE 模拟方式，默认设置兼顾兼容性与速度，支持多平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码，包括核心模拟逻辑、图形渲染器、UI 界面、Ad-hoc 多人联机功能以及文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖图形 API（如 OpenGL、Vulkan）、音频库等，支持多平台构建。
zh.hot: 作为长期维护的知名 PSP 模拟器，拥有 14k+ 星标，近期更新频繁，新增多人联机与纹理放大等特性，吸引大量玩家和开发者关注。
uses: PSP 游戏玩家：在手机或电脑上重温 PSP 经典游戏，无需实体主机。
模拟器开发者：研究 HLE 模拟、图形渲染和跨平台移植的参考实现。
游戏测试人员：利用社区兼容性反馈报告，协助测试和报告游戏问题。

en.tag: Cross-platform PSP emulator written in C++ for Android, Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS
en.what: PPSSPP is a fast and portable PSP emulator that runs games without requiring a BIOS file. It uses HLE emulation, with default settings balancing compatibility and speed, and supports multiple platforms.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, including core emulation logic, graphics renderers, UI, ad-hoc multiplayer, documentation, and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on graphics APIs (e.g., OpenGL, Vulkan) and audio libraries, with multi-platform build support.
en.hot: As a long-maintained and well-known PSP emulator with 14k+ stars, it has frequent updates, adding multiplayer and texture upscaling features, attracting many players and developers.
uses: PSP gamers: Relive classic PSP games on mobile or PC without the original console.
Emulator developers: Reference implementation for HLE emulation, graphics rendering, and cross-platform porting.
Game testers: Use community compatibility reports to help test and report game issues.

zh.tag: 高颜值动态平铺 Wayland 合成器
zh.what: Hyprland 是一个独立开发的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器，注重外观和可定制性。它提供最新的 Wayland 特性，支持渐变边框、模糊、动画等视觉效果，并拥有强大的插件系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含合成器源代码、文档、配置示例和资源文件。主要目录包括 src（核心代码）、assets（图片和图标）、以及 wiki 链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Wayland 协议，不依赖 wlroots 等库。支持自定义布局（如 Lua）和插件。
zh.hot: 凭借出色的视觉效果和高度可定制性，在 Linux 用户中广受欢迎。当前星标 38,298，今日新增 32，位居 C++ 趋势榜第 15 名。
uses: 追求美观和动态平铺体验的 Linux 桌面用户
喜欢深度定制窗口管理器的开发者或极客
需要高性能和低延迟的游戏玩家（支持撕裂控制）
对 Wayland 合成器开发感兴趣的学习者

en.tag: A beautiful, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor
en.what: Hyprland is an independent, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that prioritizes aesthetics and customization. It offers the latest Wayland features, visual effects like gradient borders and blur, and a powerful plugin system.
en.content: The repository contains the compositor's source code, documentation, configuration examples, and assets. Main directories include src (core code), assets (images and icons), and links to the wiki.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it relies on Wayland protocols and does not depend on wlroots or similar libraries. Supports custom layouts (e.g., Lua) and plugins.
en.hot: Popular among Linux users for its stunning visuals and high customizability. Currently at 38,298 stars, with 32 added today, ranking 15th on the C++ trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users seeking a beautiful and dynamic tiling experience
Developers or enthusiasts who enjoy deep customization of window managers
Gamers needing high performance and low latency (with tearing control)
Learners interested in Wayland compositor development

zh.tag: 跨GPU统一超分与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一个工具，允许你在已支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换超分器，并管理帧生成（包括通过实验性 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用）。它提供广泛的定制选项，适用于包括 Nvidia DLSS 用户在内的所有玩家。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、预编译的稳定版和夜间版发布、详细的 Wiki 文档、Discord 社区链接以及赞助渠道。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 GPU 厂商的 SDK（如 DLSS、FSR、XeSS）以及 DirectX 12 等图形 API。
zh.hot: 本周新增 151 星，总星数突破 1 万，位列 C++ 周榜第 15。它解决了跨 GPU 使用超分和帧生成的痛点，受到游戏玩家和 mod 社区欢迎。
uses: 游戏玩家：在非 Nvidia 显卡上使用 DLSS 超分或帧生成，提升游戏画质和流畅度。
Mod 开发者：利用其 API 和文档集成自定义超分或帧生成方案。
技术爱好者：探索不同超分和帧生成技术的兼容性与性能表现。

en.tag: Bridges upscaling/frame gen across GPUs, replacing native upscalers
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games that already support DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation (including enabling it in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG). It offers extensive customization for all users, including Nvidia DLSS users.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, precompiled stable and nightly releases, detailed Wiki documentation, Discord community links, and sponsorship channels.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging GPU vendor SDKs (DLSS, FSR, XeSS) and graphics APIs like DirectX 12.
en.hot: Gained 151 stars this week, surpassing 10k total, ranking #15 on C++ weekly. It solves cross-GPU upscaling/frame gen pain points, popular among gamers and modders.
