uses: Gamers: Use DLSS upscaling or frame gen on non-Nvidia GPUs to enhance visuals and smoothness.
Mod developers: Integrate custom upscaling or frame gen solutions via its API and docs.
Tech enthusiasts: Explore compatibility and performance of various upscaling/frame gen technologies.

zh.tag: 为爬虫与AI代理打造的开源反检测浏览器
zh.what: Camoufox 是一款开源的反检测浏览器，专为网络爬虫和 AI 代理设计，帮助用户绕过网站的反机器人检测。它基于 Firefox 构建，提供强大的指纹伪装和自动化功能，使爬虫和 AI 代理能够更稳定地访问目标网站。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Camoufox 的完整源代码、文档、构建脚本和示例，以及用于集成 Python 的客户端库。项目处于积极开发阶段，提供详细的文档网站和赞助商支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Firefox 引擎，提供 Python 绑定（通过 Playwright 兼容接口）。依赖包括 Firefox 的构建系统、Python 包管理工具等。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和网络爬虫需求的激增，反检测浏览器成为热门工具。Camoufox 在 GitHub 上获得 11.5k+ 星标，今日新增 28 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 17 名，显示出社区的高度关注。
uses: 网络爬虫开发者：需要绕过反爬机制，稳定抓取数据。
AI 代理开发者：为 AI 代理提供真实浏览器环境，避免被目标网站屏蔽。
自动化测试工程师：需要模拟真实用户行为进行端到端测试。

en.tag: Open-source anti-detect browser for web scraping & AI agents
en.what: Camoufox is an open-source anti-detect browser built for web scraping and AI agents, helping users bypass anti-bot detection. It is based on Firefox and offers robust fingerprint spoofing and automation features, enabling more reliable access to target websites.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, build scripts, and examples for Camoufox, along with a Python client library for integration. The project is under active development, with a comprehensive documentation site and sponsor support.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, based on the Firefox engine, with Python bindings via a Playwright-compatible interface. Dependencies include Firefox's build system, Python packaging tools, etc.
en.hot: With the surge in AI agents and web scraping needs, anti-detect browsers have become popular. Camoufox has gained 11.5k+ stars on GitHub, with 28 new stars today, ranking 17th on the C++ daily trending list, showing high community interest.
uses: Web scraping developers: need to bypass anti-bot mechanisms to reliably extract data.
AI agent developers: provide a real browser environment for AI agents to avoid being blocked.
Automation test engineers: need to simulate real user behavior for end-to-end testing.

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库
zh.what: 这是一个为 GPT-Image2 图像生成模型打造的提示词工程资源库，包含 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，将提示词视为代码进行管理和复用。项目提供可视化网站用于浏览和复制提示词，并持续更新。
zh.content: 仓库包含数据目录（案例图片与提示词）、源码（网站前端）、模板库、技能提炼文档，以及多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主要基于 JavaScript，可能使用前端框架（如 React/Vue）构建可视化网站，依赖 GitHub Pages 或类似服务部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 500+ 逆向工程案例和 20+ 工业级模板，为 GPT-Image2 用户提供高质量提示词参考，今日新增 409 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: AI 图像生成爱好者：快速获取高质量提示词，提升生成效果。
提示词工程师：学习逆向工程案例，提炼可复用的技能。
产品团队：将提示词作为代码管理，实现工业化生成流程。

en.tag: Industrial prompt engine & template library for GPT-Image2
en.what: This is a prompt engineering resource library for the GPT-Image2 image generation model, featuring 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, treating prompts as code for management and reuse. It provides a visual website for browsing and copying prompts, with continuous updates.
en.content: The repository contains data directories (case images and prompts), source code (website frontend), template library, skill extraction docs, and multilingual README.
en.stack: Primarily based on JavaScript, likely using a frontend framework (e.g., React/Vue) for the visual website, deployed via GitHub Pages or similar.
en.hot: With 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, it offers high-quality prompt references for GPT-Image2 users, gaining 409 stars today and trending on GitHub.
uses: AI image generation enthusiasts: quickly obtain high-quality prompts to improve output.
Prompt engineers: learn from reverse-engineered cases and extract reusable skills.
Product teams: manage prompts as code for industrial generation workflows.

zh.tag: Claude 社区插件市场，只读镜像，每日同步
zh.what: 这是 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 的社区插件市场仓库，包含可安装的插件列表。它由 Anthropic 内部审核流程同步，所有插件都经过安全扫描和批准。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个 marketplace.json 文件，列出了所有社区插件及其元数据。此外还有 README 说明如何使用和提交插件。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python，但仓库本身是静态 JSON 数据，由自动化流程同步。
zh.hot: 今日新增 190 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因为 Claude 插件生态正在快速增长，开发者需要官方认可的插件来源。
uses: Claude Code 用户：通过命令行快速安装社区插件，扩展功能。
插件开发者：提交插件到官方市场，获得分发和曝光。
企业团队：在受控环境中使用经过安全审核的插件。

en.tag: Read-only mirror of Claude community plugin marketplace, synced nightly
en.what: This is the community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code, containing a list of installable plugins. It is synced from Anthropic's internal review pipeline, and all plugins have passed security scanning and approval.
en.content: The repository mainly contains a marketplace.json file listing all community plugins with their metadata, plus a README explaining how to use and submit plugins.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, but the repo itself is static JSON data synced by automated processes.
en.hot: Gained 190 stars today and hit the trending list, as the Claude plugin ecosystem is rapidly growing and developers need an official source for plugins.
uses: Claude Code users: quickly install community plugins via CLI to extend functionality.
Plugin developers: submit plugins to the official marketplace for distribution and visibility.
Enterprise teams: use security-reviewed plugins in controlled environments.

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 manual/ 目录，内含 51 篇 Markdown 格式的手册章节，涵盖入门、导航、应用、配置等主题。此外还有安装脚本和配置文件，用于构建和定制系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本进行系统配置和安装，依赖 Linux 生态中的各种开源工具（如 Neovim、终端模拟器等）。手册使用 Markdown 编写，并托管在 learn.omacom.io。
zh.hot: 凭借 DHH 的知名度和对美观、现代体验的强调，Omarchy 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 6475 星，总星数达 34824，登上趋势榜第三。
uses: 喜欢 DHH 风格、追求开箱即用且美观的 Linux 桌面用户
希望从 Mac/Windows 迁移到 Linux 并希望有完整指南的用户
对 Linux 发行版定制和配置感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.
en.content: The repository contains a manual/ directory with 51 Markdown chapters covering topics like getting started, navigation, applications, and configuration. It also includes installation scripts and configuration files for building and customizing the system.
en.stack: Primarily uses Shell scripts for system configuration and installation, relying on various open-source tools from the Linux ecosystem (e.g., Neovim, terminal emulators). The manual is written in Markdown and hosted on learn.omacom.io.
en.hot: Thanks to DHH's fame and the emphasis on beautiful, modern experience, Omarchy quickly gained popularity on GitHub, adding 6,475 stars this week to reach 34,824 total, ranking #3 on the trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users who appreciate DHH's style and want a beautiful, out-of-the-box experience
Users migrating from Mac/Windows to Linux who want a comprehensive guide
Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，日志即运行时
zh.what: Apache Maka 是一个本地优先的 AI 代理工作台，用于实际工作而非仅仅回答问题。它通过受控权限检查项目、执行工具、生成工件，并将模型消息和工具调用记录为可恢复的执行事实。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（Electron + React）、终端 TUI 和 CLI（maka, maka run）、评估工具（maka eval run），以及核心的 Runtime Host 和 Runtime Event Log 实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，桌面端基于 Electron 和 React，支持多种模型连接（云 API、本地模型或兼容网关），并包含本地工具如 Read、Write、Edit、Bash、Glob 和 Grep。
zh.hot: 今日新增 460 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 7，因其本地优先、日志即运行时的创新架构，以及 Apache 孵化项目的背书，吸引了关注 AI 代理可靠性和可恢复性的开发者。
uses: 日常 AI 辅助开发：在本地项目中安全地让代理读写文件、执行命令。
需要可审计、可恢复的 AI 代理工作流的团队，用于记录和回溯每次工具调用。
AI 代理评估：使用 maka eval 进行可复现的基准测试。
偏好本地优先、数据不出机器的隐私敏感用户。

en.tag: Local-first AI agent workspace with log-as-runtime architecture
en.what: Apache Maka is a local-first AI agent workspace built for real work. It inspects projects, executes tools, produces artifacts with controlled permissions, and preserves model messages and tool calls as recoverable execution facts.
en.content: The repo includes a desktop app (Electron + React), a terminal TUI and CLI (maka, maka run), an evaluation tool (maka eval run), and the core Runtime Host and Runtime Event Log implementation.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Electron and React for the desktop app, supporting multiple model connections (cloud API, local model, or compatible gateway), and local tools including Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, and Grep.
en.hot: With 460 stars added today and ranking #7 on the TypeScript trending list, its local-first, log-as-runtime architecture and Apache incubation status attract developers focused on AI agent reliability and recoverability.
uses: Daily AI-assisted development: let agents safely read/write files and run commands in local projects.
Teams needing auditable and recoverable AI agent workflows, with logs of every tool call.
AI agent evaluation: use maka eval for reproducible benchmark experiments.
Privacy-conscious users preferring local-first, data-stays-on-machine solutions.

zh.tag: 基于 Claude Code 的 AI 求职申请框架
zh.what: 这是一个运行在你机器上的 AI 求职框架，利用 Claude Code 自动评估职位、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试。用户只需 Fork 仓库并填写个人资料，即可让 AI 代理完成求职流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Claude Code 工作流（/setup、/scrape、/apply、/interview），以及针对丹麦求职市场的职位搜索技能（Jobindex、Jobnet 等），但设计为可替换为本地求职网站。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python 和 Claude Code，利用 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型进行自然语言处理。
zh.hot: 作者用该框架成功获得 AI 工程师职位，69 份申请换来 20 次面试，真实案例引发共鸣。34k+ 星标，日增 434，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第三。
uses: 求职者：自动化繁琐的申请流程，节省时间并提高效率。
开发者：学习如何构建基于 Claude Code 的 AI 代理工作流。
非丹麦用户：可修改代码以适配本地求职网站，实现定制化求职。

en.tag: AI job application framework built on Claude Code
en.what: This is an AI-powered job application framework that runs on your machine, using Claude Code to evaluate job postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, and prepare for interviews. Fork it, fill in your profile, and let the AI agent handle the job search process.
en.content: The repo contains a full Claude Code workflow (/setup, /scrape, /apply, /interview) and job portal search skills for the Danish market (Jobindex, Jobnet, etc.), but the pattern is designed to be swapped for local job boards.
en.stack: Primarily based on Python and Claude Code, leveraging Anthropic's Claude models for natural language processing.
en.hot: The author used this framework to land an AI engineer job, with 69 applications leading to 20 interviews, a real success story that resonates. With 34k+ stars and 434 daily additions, it hit #3 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Job seekers: automate tedious application processes, saving time and increasing efficiency.
Developers: learn how to build AI agent workflows on Claude Code.
Non-Danish users: modify the code to adapt to local job boards for customized job hunting.

zh.tag: Claude Code 官方插件市场，高质量插件目录
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 官方维护的 Claude Code 插件目录，收录了内部开发的高质量插件以及经过审核的第三方插件。用户可以通过 Claude Code 的插件系统直接安装这些插件，扩展 Claude Code 的功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 /plugins 目录（Anthropic 内部插件）和 /external_plugins 目录（第三方插件），每个插件遵循标准结构，包含 plugin.json、可选命令、代理、技能和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，插件基于 Claude Code 插件系统，支持 MCP 服务器配置、斜杠命令、代理和技能定义。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方插件市场，上线即受关注，3.4 万 star 显示开发者对 Claude Code 生态的高度热情。
uses: Claude Code 用户：发现并安装官方或社区插件，扩展编码助手功能。
插件开发者：参考内部插件示例，提交高质量第三方插件进入官方市场。
团队管理者：通过标准插件结构统一管理团队的工具链和自动化流程。

en.tag: Official Anthropic-managed marketplace for high-quality Claude Code plugins
en.what: This is the official Anthropic-managed directory of high-quality plugins for Claude Code, featuring both internally developed plugins and vetted third-party plugins. Users can install these plugins directly via Claude Code's plugin system to extend its functionality.
en.content: The repository contains /plugins (internal plugins) and /external_plugins (third-party plugins), each following a standard structure with plugin.json, optional commands, agents, skills, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Python, plugins built on Claude Code's plugin system, supporting MCP server configs, slash commands, agents, and skill definitions.
en.hot: As the official Anthropic plugin marketplace, it gained immediate attention, with 34k stars reflecting high developer enthusiasm for the Claude Code ecosystem.
uses: Claude Code users: discover and install official or community plugins to extend the coding assistant.
Plugin developers: reference internal examples and submit high-quality third-party plugins to the official marketplace.
Team managers: standardize toolchains and automation workflows via the standard plugin structure.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: 从零到精通的 AI 工程实战课程
zh.what: 这是一个免费开源的 AI 工程学习课程，包含 511 节课、20 个阶段，约 329 小时的学习内容。课程强调实践，每一课都会产出可复用的成果，如提示词、技能、代理或 MCP 服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含课程内容、多语言翻译（i18n）、网站源码（site/）以及构建脚本（build.js）。课程覆盖 Python、TypeScript、Rust 和 Julia 等多种语言。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，同时涉及 TypeScript、Rust 和 Julia。网站可能基于静态生成器，使用 build.js 构建。
zh.hot: 该仓库因提供系统化、实战导向的 AI 学习路径而迅速走红，48k+ 星标，30 天内 15 万读者，反映了市场对实用 AI 技能的巨大需求。
uses: 希望系统学习 AI 工程、从零构建项目的开发者
需要实战经验以提升职场竞争力的学生和转行者
教育者或培训师，可将其作为课程大纲或教学资源

en.tag: Hands-on AI engineering curriculum from scratch to mastery
en.what: A free, open-source AI engineering curriculum with 511 lessons, 20 phases, and ~329 hours of content. It emphasizes hands-on learning, where each lesson produces a reusable artifact like a prompt, skill, agent, or MCP server.
en.content: The repository contains curriculum content, i18n translations, website source (site/), and build scripts (build.js). The curriculum covers multiple languages including Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with TypeScript, Rust, and Julia. The website likely uses a static site generator with build.js.
en.hot: This repo went viral for its systematic, hands-on AI learning path, amassing 48k+ stars and 150k readers in 30 days, reflecting huge demand for practical AI skills.
uses: Developers who want to systematically learn AI engineering and build projects from scratch
Students and career switchers needing hands-on experience to boost employability
Educators or trainers who can use it as a curriculum outline or teaching resource

zh.tag: 生产级 Agent Skills 精选集，赋能 AI 编程助手
zh.what: 这是一个为 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 AI 编程代理精心策划的 Agent Skills 集合，包含网页设计、知识检索、图像生成等技能。每个技能都是可直接使用的生产级模块，通过 SKILL.md 规范定义，帮助 AI 代理高效完成特定任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能目录，如 web-video-presentation、web-design-engineer、gpt-image-2、beautiful-article 等，每个技能都有详细的说明文档和示例。还提供了多种安装方式，包括 CLI、插件市场、zip 包等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 CSS 和 Markdown，技能基于 SKILL.md 规范，支持通过 npx CLI 或 Claude Code 插件市场安装，兼容多种 AI 代理。
zh.hot: 一周新增 1154 星，总星数达 11660，登上 GitHub 趋势榜第 14 名。作为开源技能库，它填补了 AI 代理实用技能的空缺，受到开发者社区的广泛关注。
uses: AI 编程代理用户：为 Claude Code、Cursor 等代理添加现成技能，提升开发效率。
前端开发者：利用 web-design-engineer 技能快速生成高质量网页设计。
内容创作者：使用 beautiful-article 技能将任意素材转化为精美文章。

en.tag: Curated production-ready Agent Skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more
en.what: This is a curated collection of production-ready Agent Skills for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. It includes skills for web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more, each defined by the SKILL.md spec for immediate use.
en.content: The repo contains skill directories like web-video-presentation, web-design-engineer, gpt-image-2, and beautiful-article, each with detailed docs and examples. Multiple installation methods are provided, including CLI, plugin marketplace, and zip.
en.stack: Primarily uses CSS and Markdown, with skills based on the SKILL.md spec. Installable via npx CLI or Claude Code plugin marketplace, compatible with multiple AI agents.
en.hot: Gained 1,154 stars in a week, reaching 11,660 total, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending. As an open-source skill library, it fills a gap in practical AI agent skills, gaining wide attention from developers.
uses: AI coding agent users: add ready-made skills to Claude Code, Cursor, etc., boosting productivity.
Frontend developers: leverage web-design-engineer to quickly generate high-quality web designs.
Content creators: use beautiful-article to transform any source into a beautiful article.

zh.tag: 免费聚合多款 AI 编码代理，每月 13 亿+免费 token
zh.what: 这是一个开源项目，让你免费使用 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、OpenCode 等 9 种编码代理，并接入 49 个合规的模型提供商，每月提供超过 13 亿免费 token。它提供一个统一的搜索界面，支持终端、桌面、IDE 或手机访问，还支持语音和故障转移。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包、CLI 工具、配置文件和文档，支持多种客户端接入，提供模型目录、故障转移和优化功能，如 RTK 过滤和 token 节省。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.14，使用 uv 管理依赖，采用 Pytest 测试、Ruff 格式化、Loguru 日志，并集成多个 AI 代理和提供商 API。
zh.hot: 凭借免费使用高级编码代理和巨额 token 的吸引力，star 数已达 4.7 万，今日新增 1040，登上 GitHub 日榜第 8 名。
uses: 开发者希望免费使用 Claude Code 等高级编码代理，降低 AI 编程成本。
需要跨多个模型提供商进行故障转移，确保编码任务不中断的团队。
在终端、IDE 或手机上灵活使用 AI 编码助手的个人用户。

en.tag: Free multi-agent coding hub with 1.3B+ monthly tokens
en.what: This open-source project lets you use 9 coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode for free, with access to 49 ToS-friendly providers offering 1.3B+ free tokens monthly. It provides a unified searchable UI, works from terminal, desktop, IDE, or phone, and supports voice and automatic failover.
en.content: The repo includes a Python package, CLI tool, configuration files, and docs, supporting multiple clients, with a model catalog, failover, and optimizations like RTK filtering and token savings.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.14, uses uv for dependency management, Pytest for testing, Ruff for formatting, Loguru for logging, and integrates multiple AI agents and provider APIs.
en.hot: With the appeal of free access to premium coding agents and huge token allowances, it has 47k stars, +1040 today, ranking #8 on GitHub daily trending.
uses: Developers who want to use premium coding agents like Claude Code for free, reducing AI coding costs.
Teams needing failover across multiple model providers to ensure uninterrupted coding tasks.
Individuals who prefer flexible AI coding assistance from terminal, IDE, or phone.

zh.tag: 终端里的轻量 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的本地运行编码代理，能在终端中直接执行代码任务。它支持与 ChatGPT 计划集成，也可通过 API 密钥使用，提供命令行交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、二进制发布包及文档，支持 npm、Homebrew 等安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 OpenAI API 或 ChatGPT 认证，支持跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方开源项目，今日新增 2729 星，总星数突破 11 万，登顶 GitHub 日榜，开发者期待在终端中直接使用 AI 编程。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中快速执行 AI 辅助编码任务，无需离开命令行环境。
使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 等计划的用户，可无缝集成现有订阅进行编程。
需要轻量级、可脚本化的代码生成与修改工具的技术团队。

en.tag: Lightweight AI coding agent that runs in your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. It executes coding tasks directly in the terminal, integrates with ChatGPT plans, and can also be used with an API key.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based CLI tool, installation scripts, binary release assets, and documentation, with support for npm and Homebrew installation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, it relies on OpenAI API or ChatGPT authentication, and supports cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows).
en.hot: As an official OpenAI open-source project, it gained 2,729 stars today, surpassing 110k total stars and topping the daily GitHub trending list. Developers are eager to use AI coding directly in the terminal.
uses: Developers who want to perform AI-assisted coding tasks quickly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: 本地优先的个人 AI 超级智能，记忆+编排+深度研究
zh.what: OpenHuman 是一个开源的个人 AI 超级智能，旨在构建你生活的本地优先记忆，并作为智能体舰队和工作流的出色编排器，同时提供深度研究能力。它强调本地优先、简单和强大，让用户拥有自己的 AI 大脑。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的核心引擎、文档（gitbooks）、演示图片、社区链接（Discussions、Discord、Reddit、X）以及 Product Hunt 徽章。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 GitBook 文档框架，并集成 Product Hunt 和 Trendshift 徽章。
zh.hot: 凭借 36.5k 星标和每日新增 51 星，OpenHuman 在 GitHub 趋势榜上排名第 9，其本地优先的 AI 超级智能概念和强大的编排能力吸引了大量关注。
uses: 个人知识管理：构建本地优先的生活记忆，用于个人助理和知识库。
智能体编排：管理和协调多个 AI 智能体执行复杂工作流。
深度研究：利用 AI 进行深入的信息检索和分析。
开发者与 AI 爱好者：探索开源 AI 工具链和本地优先架构。

en.tag: Local-first personal AI superintelligence: memory, orchestration, deep research
en.what: OpenHuman is an open-source personal AI superintelligence that builds a local-first memory of your life, acts as an orchestrator for agent fleets and workflows, and offers deep research capabilities. It emphasizes local-first, simplicity, and power, giving users ownership of their AI brain.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based core engine, documentation (gitbooks), demo images, community links (Discussions, Discord, Reddit, X), and Product Hunt badges.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, uses GitBook for documentation, and integrates Product Hunt and Trendshift badges.
en.hot: With 36.5k stars and 51 new stars daily, OpenHuman ranks #9 on GitHub Trending, attracting attention for its local-first AI superintelligence concept and powerful orchestration capabilities.
uses: Personal knowledge management: build local-first memory for personal assistants and knowledge bases.
Agent orchestration: manage and coordinate multiple AI agents for complex workflows.
Deep research: leverage AI for in-depth information retrieval and analysis.
Developers and AI enthusiasts: explore open-source AI toolchains and local-first architecture.

zh.tag: 开源智能体视频制作系统，把AI编程助手变成视频工作室
zh.what: OpenMontage 是全球首个开源的智能体视频制作系统，提供12条生产流水线、100多个工具和700多个智能体技能与制作知识文件。它能让你的AI编程助手（如Claude、ChatGPT）直接生成完整视频，从脚本到成片全流程自动化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心Python代码、12条生产流水线（pipelines）、100多个工具模块、700多个智能体技能和制作知识文件，以及文档、赞助商信息和吉祥物素材。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python，依赖AI编程助手（如Claude、ChatGPT）作为智能体后端，集成多种视频处理和生成工具。
zh.hot: 凭借5.2万星标和日增1292星的火爆势头，OpenMontage 登上GitHub Trending日榜第9名，因其首创的智能体视频制作概念和强大的自动化能力吸引了大量关注。
uses: 内容创作者：快速生成视频脚本、分镜和成片，提升制作效率
开发者：将AI编程助手扩展为视频制作工具，实现自动化工作流
视频制作团队：利用12条流水线覆盖不同视频类型，降低制作门槛

en.tag: Open-source agentic video production system turning AI coding assistants into a full video studio
en.what: OpenMontage is the world's first open-source, agentic video production system with 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, and 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. It turns your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio, automating the entire workflow from script to final video.
en.content: The repository contains core Python code, 12 production pipelines, 100+ tool modules, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files, along with documentation, sponsor info, and mascot assets.
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) as agent backends, integrating various video processing and generation tools.
en.hot: With 52.5k stars and 1,292 new stars today, OpenMontage ranks #9 on GitHub Trending daily, drawing massive attention for its pioneering agentic video production concept and powerful automation capabilities.
uses: Content creators: quickly generate scripts, storyboards, and final videos to boost production efficiency
Developers: extend AI coding assistants into video production tools for automated workflows
Video production teams: leverage 12 pipelines covering various video types to lower production barriers

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 开源基础模型研发框架，覆盖数据到评估全流程
zh.what: Marin 是一个用于基础模型研究与开发的开源框架，专注于大语言模型的训练，包括数据整理、转换、过滤、分词、预训练、后训练和评估。它强调开放开发，记录所有过程、实验和决策，并支持音频文本、DNA 和蛋白质模型等扩展应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、实验配置、数据处理管道（如 Nemotron-CC 等数据集的确定性复现）、缩放套件 Delphi 的配方和检查点，以及文档和社区资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，并利用 Google TPU 研究云进行大规模训练。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1599 星，总星数达 3054，因其开放开发理念和前沿的 MoE 模型训练而备受关注。
uses: 研究人员：用于从头训练大规模语言模型，探索数据管道和缩放定律。
工程师：利用其模块化框架构建自定义训练流程，支持多模态扩展。
教育者：作为教学案例，展示基础模型研发的完整过程。

en.tag: Open-source framework for foundation model R&D, from data to evaluation
en.what: Marin is an open-source framework for the research and development of foundation models, focusing on training large language models, including data curation, transformation, filtering, tokenization, pretraining, posttraining, and evaluation. It emphasizes open development, documenting all processes, experiments, and decisions, and supports extensions to audio-text, DNA, and protein models.
en.content: The repository contains core framework code, experiment configurations, data processing pipelines (e.g., deterministic reproduction of Nemotron-CC datasets), scaling suite Delphi recipes and checkpoints, plus documentation and community resources.
en.stack: Primarily Python, leveraging deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, and utilizing Google TPU Research Cloud for large-scale training.
en.hot: Gained 1599 stars this week, reaching 3054 total, due to its open development philosophy and cutting-edge MoE model training.
uses: Researchers: to pretrain large language models from scratch and explore data pipelines and scaling laws.
Engineers: to build custom training pipelines using its modular framework, with support for multimodal extensions.
Educators: as a teaching case to demonstrate the complete process of foundation model development.

zh.tag: 用 Claude Code 打造自组织 AI 第二大脑，连接 Obsidian 知识图谱
zh.what: claude-obsidian 是一个本地优先的知识管理系统，集成 Claude Code 和 Obsidian。它自动捕获、链接和整理你的笔记，构建一个互联的知识图谱，所有内容都是纯 Markdown，完全由你掌控。它基于 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，旨在成为 Notion 的开源替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含 15 个 Agent Skills（如捕获、检索、维护、可视化映射）、工作流文档、安装指南、以及用于构建知识循环的脚本和配置。输出是普通的 Markdown 和 JSON 文件，可在 Obsidian 中直接使用。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python，依赖 Claude Code 和 Agent Skills 框架，兼容 Obsidian 插件。使用内容寻址存储来保留源文件，并利用 Markdown 和 JSON 进行数据组织。
zh.hot: 凭借 11.8k 星标和日增 310 星，它抓住了 AI 笔记和个人知识管理的热潮，提供了开源、本地优先的 Notion 替代方案，并基于 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式，受到开发者社区追捧。
uses: 知识工作者：希望用 AI 自动整理笔记、构建个人知识库，同时保持数据完全本地可控。
开发者：想基于 Claude Code 和 Agent Skills 构建自定义 AI 工作流，或扩展 Obsidian 功能。
研究人员：需要从大量文献中提取、链接和引用信息，形成可追溯的知识网络。
Notion 用户：寻求开源、本地优先的替代方案，避免云锁定和隐私问题。

en.tag: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code, turning sources into a connected knowledge graph
en.what: claude-obsidian is a local-first knowledge system that integrates Claude Code and Obsidian. It automatically captures, links, and organizes your notes into a connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown, fully owned by you. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern, it serves as an open-source alternative to Notion.
en.content: The repo includes 15 Agent Skills (capture, retrieval, maintenance, visual mapping), workflow docs, installation guides, and scripts/configs for the compounding knowledge loop. Output is plain Markdown and JSON files, usable directly in Obsidian.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on Claude Code and Agent Skills framework, compatible with Obsidian plugins. Uses content-addressed storage for source preservation and Markdown/JSON for data organization.
en.hot: With 11.8k stars and +310 today, it taps into the AI note-taking and PKM trend, offering an open-source, local-first Notion alternative based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern, gaining rapid traction.
uses: Knowledge workers who want AI to auto-organize notes and build a personal knowledge base while keeping data fully local and controllable.
Developers looking to build custom AI workflows with Claude Code and Agent Skills, or extend Obsidian's capabilities.
Researchers needing to extract, link, and cite information from large corpora into a traceable knowledge network.
Notion users seeking an open-source, local-first alternative to avoid cloud lock-in and privacy concerns.

zh.tag: 自托管A股量化工作台：选股+监控+回测
zh.what: 这是一个面向个人散户和量化爱好者的自托管、零运维的A股量化工作台，集选股、监控、回测于一体。它基于TickFlow数据源，利用LLM能力实现策略定制、个股分析和复盘，并支持自由接入第三方数据源。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的量化工作台代码，涵盖选股引擎、指标流水线、回测研究、因子挖掘、市场环境分析、异动监控、监控中心、个股分析、连板梯队等模块，并提供Docker部署和详细文档。
zh.stack: 后端基于Python 3.11+，使用Polars进行高性能数据处理；前端使用React 18；数据源为TickFlow，支持插件化扩展；部署支持Docker。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜（Python）排名第17，今日新增82星，总星数达3509。其亮点在于结合LLM能力提供AI驱动的策略定制和个股分析，且完全自托管、零运维，吸引了大量个人量化爱好者。
uses: 个人散户：希望用开源工具进行A股量化选股和回测，无需自己搭建复杂基础设施。
量化爱好者：需要灵活的策略定制和因子挖掘，且希望数据源可插拔。
开发者：想学习或扩展一个完整的量化工作台，包括前端React和后端Python。

en.tag: Self-hosted A-share quant workbench: screening, monitoring, backtesting
en.what: A self-hosted, zero-maintenance quantitative workbench for A-shares, targeting individual investors and quant enthusiasts. It integrates stock screening, monitoring, and backtesting, powered by TickFlow data, with LLM capabilities for strategy customization, stock analysis, and review, and supports pluggable third-party data sources.
en.content: The repo contains a full quant workbench codebase, including modules for stock screening, indicator pipeline, backtesting, factor mining, market environment analysis, anomaly monitoring, monitoring center, stock analysis, and limit-up ladder, with Docker deployment and detailed docs.
en.stack: Backend in Python 3.11+, using Polars for high-performance data processing; frontend in React 18; data source is TickFlow with plugin support; deployment via Docker.
en.hot: Ranked #17 on GitHub Trending (Python) with 82 stars today and 3509 total. Its appeal lies in LLM-powered strategy customization and stock analysis, plus full self-hosting with zero maintenance, attracting many individual quant enthusiasts.
uses: Individual investors: seeking an open-source tool for A-share quant screening and backtesting without complex infrastructure.
Quant enthusiasts: needing flexible strategy customization and factor mining with pluggable data sources.
Developers: interested in learning or extending a full quant workbench with React frontend and Python backend.

zh.tag: macOS 菜单栏原生 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存
zh.what: oMLX 是一个专为 Apple Silicon 优化的 LLM 推理服务器，提供连续批处理和分层 KV 缓存，将热数据保存在内存、冷数据存储在 SSD，并支持跨请求复用缓存。用户可通过 macOS 菜单栏直接管理模型、切换上下文长度，并监控性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 macOS 应用（.dmg 安装包）、Homebrew 安装支持、CLI 工具（~/.omlx/bin/omlx）以及可选的 MCP 支持。还提供多语言 README（中/英/韩/日）和基准测试页面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11-3.13，针对 Apple Silicon 优化，可能包含自定义内核（如 GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3）。支持 Homebrew 安装，可选安装 MCP 依赖。
zh.hot: 针对 Mac 用户痛点：在便利性和控制力之间取得平衡，通过菜单栏管理 LLM 服务器，并利用 SSD 缓存实现长上下文复用，适合本地 AI 开发。Star 数近 1.9 万，今日新增 78，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行 LLM，并通过菜单栏轻松管理模型和上下文
开发者使用 Claude Code 等工具进行真实编码，需要跨请求缓存以提升效率
需要灵活控制内存和 SSD 缓存、自动切换模型的高级用户
通过 Homebrew 或 CLI 集成到自动化工作流（如 Apple Shortcuts）

en.tag: Native macOS menu bar LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching
en.what: oMLX is an LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and tiered KV caching that persists hot data in memory and cold data on SSD, enabling cache reuse across requests. Users can manage models, switch context lengths, and monitor performance directly from the macOS menu bar.
en.content: The repository includes a full macOS app (.dmg installer), Homebrew installation support, a CLI shim (~/.omlx/bin/omlx), and optional MCP support. It also provides multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/KO/JA) and a benchmarks page.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11-3.13, optimized for Apple Silicon, possibly with custom kernels (e.g., GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3). Supports Homebrew installation, with optional MCP dependencies.
en.hot: Addresses Mac users' pain point: balancing convenience and control by managing LLM servers from the menu bar, with SSD caching for long-context reuse, ideal for local AI development. With ~19k stars and +78 today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally and manage models/context from the menu bar
Developers using tools like Claude Code for real coding, needing cross-request caching for efficiency
Power users who need flexible control over memory/SSD caching and auto-swapping models
Those integrating with automation workflows via Homebrew or CLI (e.g., Apple Shortcuts)

zh.tag: 即时语音克隆与多语言音色控制
zh.what: OpenVoice 是一个由 MIT 和 MyShell 开发的音频基础模型，能够精确克隆参考音色，并支持多语言、多口音生成语音。它还允许细粒度控制语音风格，如情感、口音、节奏、停顿和语调，并支持零样本跨语言语音克隆。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenVoice V1 和 V2 的代码、预训练模型、使用文档（USAGE.md）、常见问题解答（QA.md）以及示例资源。主要目录包括模型实现、训练策略和推理脚本。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 实现，依赖 PyTorch 等深度学习框架，并借鉴了 TTS、VITS 等项目。
zh.hot: OpenVoice 在 GitHub 上获得 37k+ 星标，因其强大的即时语音克隆能力和灵活的语音风格控制而广受欢迎。自发布以来，已被全球用户使用数千万次，并持续在 GitHub Trending 上排名靠前。
uses: 语音合成开发者：快速集成多语言语音克隆功能到应用中。
内容创作者：为视频、播客等生成个性化配音。
AI 研究者：研究零样本语音克隆和跨语言语音合成。

en.tag: Instant voice cloning with flexible style control
en.what: OpenVoice is an audio foundation model developed by MIT and MyShell that accurately clones reference tone colors and generates speech in multiple languages and accents. It enables granular control over voice styles, including emotion, accent, rhythm, pauses, and intonation, and supports zero-shot cross-lingual voice cloning.
en.content: The repository contains code for OpenVoice V1 and V2, pre-trained models, usage documentation (USAGE.md), FAQ (QA.md), and example resources. Key directories include model implementations, training strategies, and inference scripts.
en.stack: Implemented in Python, built on deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, and leverages projects such as TTS and VITS.
en.hot: OpenVoice has gained 37k+ stars on GitHub, popular for its powerful instant voice cloning and flexible style control. It has been used tens of millions of times by users worldwide and consistently ranks high on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers building voice synthesis: quickly integrate multi-language voice cloning into applications.
Content creators: generate personalized voiceovers for videos, podcasts, etc.
AI researchers: study zero-shot voice cloning and cross-lingual speech synthesis.

zh.tag: Claude Code 的通用 SEO 技能包，25 子技能 + 18 子代理
zh.what: 这是一个为 Claude Code 设计的开源 SEO 分析插件，能够并行运行 25 个子技能和 18 个专家代理，覆盖技术 SEO、内容质量（E-E-A-T）、Schema 标记、AI 搜索优化（GEO）、本地 SEO、电商和国际 SEO 等领域。每次审计都会生成优先行动计划，并提供基于 Google 官方指南的可测试建议。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的技能定义、子代理配置、测试套件（410 个通过测试）、示例报告和文档，还支持可选的 DataForSEO、Firecrawl 和 Banana 扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，基于 Claude Code 的 Skill 机制，依赖 Claude API，可选集成 DataForSEO、Firecrawl 和 Banana 等外部服务。
zh.hot: 凭借 15.7k 星标和本周新增近千星，它精准抓住了 AI 搜索优化（GEO）和自动化 SEO 审计的需求，且提供可验证、非推销性的方法论，在开发者社区迅速走红。
uses: SEO 专业人士：快速进行全站审计，生成优先行动计划
开发者：将 SEO 最佳实践集成到 Claude Code 工作流中
内容营销人员：利用 E-E-A-T 和 GEO 优化提升 AI 搜索可见性
电商运营者：针对产品页面和结构化数据实施 SEO 策略

en.tag: Universal SEO skill for Claude Code: 25 sub-skills + 18 sub-agents
en.what: An open-source SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code that runs 25 sub-skills and 18 specialist agents in parallel across technical SEO, content quality (E-E-A-T), Schema.org markup, AI search optimization (GEO), local SEO, e-commerce, and international SEO. Each audit produces a prioritized action plan with testable recommendations grounded in primary-source guidance from Google.
en.content: The repo includes full skill definitions, sub-agent configurations, a test suite (410 passing tests), example reports, and documentation, with optional DataForSEO, Firecrawl, and Banana extensions.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on Claude Code's Skill mechanism, leveraging the Claude API, with optional integrations for DataForSEO, Firecrawl, and Banana.
en.hot: With 15.7k stars and nearly 1k added this week, it taps into the demand for AI search optimization (GEO) and automated SEO audits, offering a falsifiable, non-promotional methodology that resonates with developers.
uses: SEO professionals: run full-site audits and get prioritized action plans quickly
Developers: integrate SEO best practices into Claude Code workflows
Content marketers: leverage E-E-A-T and GEO to improve AI search visibility
E-commerce operators: implement SEO strategies for product pages and structured data

zh.tag: 自托管、隐私优先的个人财务管理工具
zh.what: Securo 是一款开源的个人财务管理器，强调数据自主权，让用户在自己的基础设施上运行，完全掌控账户、支出和习惯，不向第三方泄露任何数据。它提供多账户管理、交易管理、自动分类、预算、目标追踪等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端、后端、文档和安装脚本，提供 Docker 镜像和 Helm chart，支持快速部署。主要目录包括 docs、src 等，包含完整的应用代码和测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，前端可能涉及 JavaScript/TypeScript，依赖 Docker 或 Podman 进行容器化部署，支持多种文件格式导入（OFX, QIF, CAMT, CSV）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 617 星，总星数达 2307，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Python）第 17 名。其隐私优先的理念和自托管特性吸引了关注数据安全的用户。
uses: 注重财务数据隐私的个人用户，希望完全掌控自己的财务信息。
技术爱好者或开发者，喜欢自托管服务并愿意自行部署和维护。
小型团队或家庭，需要集中管理多账户和预算，同时避免第三方服务。

en.tag: Self-hosted, privacy-first personal finance manager
en.what: Securo is an open-source personal finance manager that emphasizes data sovereignty, allowing users to run it on their own infrastructure, gaining full visibility into accounts, spending, and habits without surrendering data to third parties. It offers multi-account management, transaction management, auto-categorization, budgets, and goal tracking.
en.content: The repository contains frontend, backend, documentation, and installation scripts, with Docker images and Helm charts for quick deployment. Main directories include docs, src, etc., containing full application code and tests.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, frontend likely uses JavaScript/TypeScript, relies on Docker or Podman for containerized deployment, and supports multiple file formats (OFX, QIF, CAMT, CSV).
en.hot: Gained 617 stars this week, reaching 2307 total, ranking 17th on GitHub Trending (Python) weekly. Its privacy-first philosophy and self-hosted nature attract users concerned about data security.
uses: Individuals who prioritize financial data privacy and want full control over their financial information.
Tech enthusiasts or developers who prefer self-hosted services and are willing to deploy and maintain them.
Small teams or families needing centralized multi-account and budget management without third-party services.

zh.tag: 实时语音与多模态 AI 代理的开源框架
zh.what: Pipecat 是一个用于构建实时语音和多模态对话代理的 Python 框架。它支持构建单个语音代理或完整的多代理系统，其中专业代理可以交接、并行扩展，并通过共享总线进行协调，支持本地或跨进程/机器分布式部署。它简化了音频/视频、AI 服务、传输和对话管道的编排，让开发者专注于代理的独特功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、客户端 SDK（JavaScript、React、React Native、Swift、Kotlin、C++）、文档、示例和快速入门指南。框架提供可插拔的 AI 服务集成、可组合的管道组件，以及支持 WebSockets 和 WebRTC 等实时传输。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种 AI 服务（如语音识别、文本转语音）和传输协议（WebSockets、WebRTC）。支持与多种 AI 服务和工具集成，并提供了多语言客户端 SDK。
zh.hot: Pipecat 在 GitHub 上获得了 14952 颗星，本周新增 491 颗，位列 Python 周榜第 13 名。其热度源于对实时语音和多模态 AI 代理的专注，提供了可组合的管道和多代理支持，满足了开发者对低延迟、可扩展对话系统的需求。
uses: 构建语音助手、AI 伴侣、会议助手等实时对话应用
开发多代理系统，实现专业代理间的交接、并行扩展和协调
创建多模态交互界面，集成语音、视频、图像等多种输入输出
用于客户服务、支持机器人、引导式流程等业务场景

en.tag: Open-source framework for real-time voice & multimodal AI agents
en.what: Pipecat is a Python framework for building real-time voice and multimodal conversational agents. It enables building single voice agents or full multi-agent systems where specialists hand off, fan out in parallel, and coordinate over a shared bus, locally or distributed across processes and machines. It streamlines orchestration of audio/video, AI services, transports, and conversation pipelines, letting developers focus on what makes their agents unique.
en.content: The repository contains core framework code, client SDKs (JavaScript, React, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, C++), documentation, examples, and a quickstart guide. The framework offers pluggable AI service integrations, composable pipeline components, and real-time transports like WebSockets and WebRTC.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python, it integrates with various AI services (e.g., speech recognition, text-to-speech) and transport protocols (WebSockets, WebRTC). It supports integration with many AI services and tools, and offers client SDKs in multiple languages.
en.hot: Pipecat has 14,952 stars with 491 added this week, ranking #13 on the Python weekly trending list. Its popularity stems from its focus on real-time voice and multimodal AI agents, offering composable pipelines and multi-agent support that meet developers' needs for low-latency, scalable conversational systems.
uses: Build real-time conversational apps like voice assistants, AI companions, and meeting assistants
Develop multi-agent systems with handoff, parallel fan-out, and coordination among specialist agents
Create multimodal interfaces integrating voice, video, images, and more
Apply to business scenarios such as customer intake, support bots, and guided flows

zh.tag: 多智能体框架，模拟软件公司，实现自然语言编程
zh.what: MetaGPT 是一个多智能体框架，将不同角色（如产品经理、架构师、项目经理、工程师）分配给 GPT，以协作完成复杂任务。它接收一行需求，输出用户故事、竞品分析、需求文档、数据结构、API 等，实现软件公司的完整流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架代码、示例（examples）、文档（docs）以及相关论文代码（如 SPO、AOT）。还提供了 MGX（MetaGPT X）产品，即自然语言编程的 AI 代理开发团队。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.9+（<3.12），依赖 OpenAI API 等 LLM 接口，支持异步处理，使用 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 作为多智能体框架的先锋，MetaGPT 已获得 70k+ star，近期 MGX 产品在 ProductHunt 上成为当日和当周第一，且论文被 ICLR 2025 接收为口头报告，热度持续攀升。
uses: 开发者希望用自然语言快速生成软件需求文档和原型，加速项目启动。
研究多智能体协作、SOP 自动化或 LLM 应用架构的学者和工程师。
产品经理或创业团队需要自动化竞品分析和需求拆解，提升效率。
对 AI 编程工具感兴趣，希望体验从需求到代码的完整流程的用户。

en.tag: Multi-agent framework simulating a software company for natural language programming
en.what: MetaGPT is a multi-agent framework that assigns different roles (e.g., product manager, architect, project manager, engineer) to GPTs to collaborate on complex tasks. It takes a one-line requirement and outputs user stories, competitive analysis, requirements, data structures, APIs, etc., simulating a software company's full process.
en.content: The repository contains core framework code, examples, documentation, and code for related papers (e.g., SPO, AOT). It also offers MGX (MetaGPT X), an AI agent development team for natural language programming.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.9+ (<3.12), relies on LLM APIs like OpenAI, supports async processing, and installable via pip.
en.hot: As a pioneer in multi-agent frameworks, MetaGPT has gained 70k+ stars, with recent MGX product topping ProductHunt as #1 Product of the Day and Week, and a paper accepted as oral at ICLR 2025, sustaining its popularity.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate software requirement docs and prototypes from natural language to accelerate project kickoff.
Researchers and engineers studying multi-agent collaboration, SOP automation, or LLM application architectures.
Product managers or startup teams needing automated competitive analysis and requirement breakdown for efficiency.
Users interested in AI coding tools who want to experience the full pipeline from requirement to code.

zh.tag: NVIDIA 官方大规模 Transformer 训练库，支持多种并行策略与混合精度
zh.what: Megatron-LM 是 NVIDIA 开源的用于大规模训练 Transformer 模型的 GPU 优化库，包含 Megatron-LM 参考示例和 Megatron Core 可组合库。它提供张量并行、流水线并行、数据并行、专家并行和上下文并行等高级并行策略，并支持 FP16、BF16、FP8 和 FP4 混合精度训练。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Megatron-LM（参考实现，含预配置训练脚本）和 Megatron Core（可组合库，提供 Transformer 构建模块、并行策略、混合精度支持和模型架构）。还提供 Megatron Bridge 用于 Hugging Face 与 Megatron 之间的检查点转换。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，基于 PyTorch 和 NVIDIA CUDA 生态，支持分布式训练框架（如 NCCL）。可通过 PyPI 安装，或从源码构建（需注意内存限制）。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方的大规模训练库，本周新增 155 星，总星数 17675，持续受到 AI 研究和工程社区关注。近期支持 DeepSeek-V4 等前沿模型，进一步推动热度。
uses: 研究团队：用于大规模 Transformer 模型的预训练和实验，快速验证新架构。
机器学习工程师：构建自定义训练流程，利用高级并行策略和混合精度优化性能。
框架开发者：基于 Megatron Core 的可组合模块，开发定制化训练框架。
学习分布式训练：通过参考示例和文档，理解大规模模型训练的并行技术。

en.tag: NVIDIA's GPU-optimized library for training transformer models at scale with advanced parallelism
en.what: Megatron-LM is NVIDIA's open-source GPU-optimized library for training transformer models at scale, comprising Megatron-LM reference examples and Megatron Core composable library. It offers advanced parallelism strategies (TP, PP, DP, EP, CP) and mixed precision support (FP16, BF16, FP8, FP4).
en.content: The repository contains Megatron-LM (reference implementation with pre-configured training scripts) and Megatron Core (composable library with transformer building blocks, parallelism strategies, mixed precision support, and model architectures). Megatron Bridge provides checkpoint conversion between Hugging Face and Megatron.
en.stack: Primarily Python, built on PyTorch and NVIDIA CUDA ecosystem, supporting distributed training frameworks like NCCL. Installable via PyPI or from source (mind memory limits).
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official large-scale training library, it gained 155 stars this week (total 17,675), consistently popular in AI research and engineering. Recent support for DeepSeek-V4 and other frontier models boosts its appeal.
uses: Research teams: for pretraining and experimenting with large-scale transformer models, quickly validating new architectures.
ML engineers: building custom training pipelines, leveraging advanced parallelism and mixed precision for performance.
Framework developers: using Megatron Core's composable modules to develop customized training frameworks.
Learners of distributed training: understanding parallel techniques via reference examples and documentation.

zh.tag: 用 AI 代理自动开发跨引擎游戏，从描述到可玩成品
zh.what: Godogen 是一个自动化游戏开发工具，它利用 AI 代理（如 Claude Code 和 Codex）根据简短的描述自动构建完整的游戏。它支持 Godot、Bevy 和 Babylon.js 三种引擎，并自动生成资产、运行引擎、验证结果，最终提供可玩的游戏或录制的视频证明。
zh.content: 仓库包含运行时清单、跨引擎资产生成技能、各引擎指南（Godot、Bevy、Babylon.js）以及发布脚本。它不是一个游戏，而是生成游戏的生成器，通过发布到新仓库，代理在仓库内根据指南构建游戏。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Godot 4 (.NET)、Rust/Bevy、Node.js/Babylon.js，以及外部 AI 服务（Gemini、xAI Grok、Tripo3D）用于资产生成。
zh.hot: 凭借 6443 颗星和每日 131 的新增，它因实现 AI 驱动的游戏开发自动化而备受关注，大幅降低了游戏制作门槛，吸引了开发者和 AI 爱好者。
uses: 游戏开发者希望快速原型化游戏创意，利用 AI 自动生成代码和资产。
AI 爱好者探索代理驱动的开发流程，了解如何将大语言模型应用于复杂任务。
教育者或内容创作者需要生成演示游戏或教学示例，无需手动编码。

en.tag: Autonomous game development for Godot, Bevy, and Babylon.js with Claude Code and Codex
en.what: Godogen is an autonomous game development tool that uses AI agents (like Claude Code and Codex) to build complete games from a short description. It supports Godot, Bevy, and Babylon.js engines, automatically generates assets, runs the engine, and verifies results, providing a playable game or recorded video proof.
en.content: The repo contains a runtime manifest, cross-engine asset generation skill, per-engine guides (Godot, Bevy, Babylon.js), and a publish script. It is not a game but a generator that produces games by publishing to a fresh repo where the agent builds the game from the guide.
en.stack: Primarily Python, with dependencies on Godot 4 (.NET), Rust/Bevy, Node.js/Babylon.js, and external AI services (Gemini, xAI Grok, Tripo3D) for asset generation.
en.hot: With 6443 stars and 131 new stars per day, it gains attention for automating AI-driven game development, significantly lowering the barrier to game creation, attracting developers and AI enthusiasts.
uses: Game developers who want to rapidly prototype game ideas, using AI to auto-generate code and assets.
AI enthusiasts exploring agent-driven development workflows, learning how to apply LLMs to complex tasks.
Educators or content creators needing to generate demo games or teaching examples without manual coding.

zh.tag: 开源、隐私优先的 Notebook LM 替代品
zh.what: Open Notebook 是一个开源的 Notebook LM 替代品，提供更灵活的功能和更高的隐私保护。它允许用户完全掌控自己的数据，并支持多种 AI 模型提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档（安装指南、用户指南、核心概念）、示例资源（如 hero.svg）以及多语言翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，支持 18+ 个 AI 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama、LM Studio），集成全文和向量搜索，支持多模态内容处理。
zh.hot: 凭借 37.5k 星标和日增 138 星，Open Notebook 成为 GitHub Trending 日榜（TypeScript）第 6 名，因其隐私保护和多模型支持而备受关注。
uses: 研究人员和学生：需要隐私保护的研究笔记和知识管理工具
AI 开发者：希望集成多个 AI 模型并自定义工作流的开发者
内容创作者：需要生成专业播客或多模态内容整理的用户

en.tag: Open-source, privacy-focused alternative to Notebook LM
en.what: Open Notebook is an open-source alternative to Notebook LM, offering more flexibility and privacy. It gives users full control over their data and supports multiple AI model providers.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation (installation, user guide, core concepts), example assets (like hero.svg), and multi-language translation files.
en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript, supports 18+ AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, LM Studio, etc.), integrates full-text and vector search, and handles multi-modal content.
en.hot: With 37.5k stars and 138 new stars today, Open Notebook ranks #6 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) daily, gaining attention for its privacy and multi-model support.
uses: Researchers and students: privacy-focused research note-taking and knowledge management
AI developers: those who want to integrate multiple AI models and customize workflows
Content creators: users who need professional podcast generation or multi-modal content organization

zh.tag: 自托管个人图书馆与阅读平台
zh.what: BookOrbit 是一个自托管的图书馆和阅读平台，支持电子书、PDF、有声书和漫画。它提供网页阅读器、Kobo 和 KOReader 支持，并同步阅读进度、高亮和状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务端和前端代码，提供仪表盘、书架管理、阅读统计、成就系统、OPDS 和 Send-to-Kindle 等功能，并支持多用户和 OIDC/SSO 认证。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于现代 Web 技术栈构建，支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种第三方服务（如 Crowdin 翻译、Codecov 覆盖率）。
zh.hot: BookOrbit 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 248 星，总星数达 2613，因其自托管、跨设备同步和丰富功能而备受关注。
uses: 喜欢自托管服务的阅读爱好者，希望完全掌控自己的书籍数据。
需要在不同设备（如 Kobo、KOReader）间无缝同步阅读进度的用户。
注重隐私和自主权的用户，希望避免依赖商业云服务。
开发者或技术爱好者，希望扩展或定制自己的阅读平台。

en.tag: Self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics
en.what: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It offers a web reader, Kobo and KOReader support, and syncs progress, highlights, and reading status across devices.
en.content: The repository contains full server and frontend code, featuring a dashboard, bookshelf management, reading stats, achievements, OPDS and Send-to-Kindle delivery, multi-user accounts with OIDC/SSO, and automatic sync to Hardcover, Readwise, and StoryGraph.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on modern web technologies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates with third-party services like Crowdin for translation and Codecov for coverage.
en.hot: BookOrbit is rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub with 248 stars today and 2,613 total, thanks to its self-hosted nature, cross-device sync, and rich feature set.
uses: Reading enthusiasts who prefer self-hosted services and want full control over their book data.
Users who need seamless reading progress sync across devices like Kobo and KOReader.
Privacy-conscious individuals who want to avoid relying on commercial cloud services.
Developers or tech enthusiasts looking to extend or customize their reading platform.

zh.tag: 面向开发者的 Markdown 演示文稿工具
zh.what: Slidev 是一个专为开发者设计的演示文稿工具，允许用户使用 Markdown 编写幻灯片，并支持代码高亮、实时编码、主题定制和交互组件。它旨在将开发者的工作流（如代码编辑器和版本控制）与演示文稿创建无缝集成。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 CLI、Vue 组件、主题系统、文档和示例，以及用于导出、录制和编辑器的集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 和 Vue 3，使用 Vite 作为构建工具，支持 UnoCSS 进行样式处理，并集成 Mermaid 和 LaTeX 等库。
zh.hot: Slidev 拥有超过 48k 的 star，因其将 Markdown 的简洁性与开发者的工具链结合，成为开发者制作演示文稿的首选，本周新增 167 星，持续受到关注。
uses: 技术演讲者希望快速创建包含代码示例的幻灯片
开发团队用于内部技术分享和培训材料
教育工作者制作编程课程或教程演示
开源贡献者展示项目或撰写技术博客配套演示

en.tag: Markdown-based presentation tool for developers
en.what: Slidev is a presentation tool designed for developers, allowing users to write slides in Markdown with features like code highlighting, live coding, theming, and interactive components. It aims to integrate seamlessly with developer workflows such as code editors and version control.
en.content: The repository includes the core CLI, Vue components, theming system, documentation, and examples, along with integrations for exporting, recording, and editors.
en.stack: Built on Node.js and Vue 3, using Vite as the build tool, with UnoCSS for styling, and integrations for Mermaid and LaTeX.
en.hot: With over 48k stars, Slidev is a top choice for developers creating presentations due to its blend of Markdown simplicity and developer tooling, gaining 167 stars this week and remaining popular.
uses: Tech speakers who want to quickly create slides with code examples
Development teams for internal tech talks and training materials
Educators creating programming courses or tutorial presentations
Open-source contributors showcasing projects or accompanying tech blog posts

zh.tag: 高质量 TypeScript 类型定义仓库
zh.what: DefinitelyTyped 是 TypeScript 社区维护的高质量类型定义仓库，为没有自带类型的 npm 包提供 .d.ts 文件。它通过社区贡献和严格审查，确保类型定义的准确性和可用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含数千个包的 @types 定义，采用 pnpm monorepo 结构，每个包独立管理，并有完善的贡献指南和自动化检查。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 pnpm 管理依赖，dtslint 进行类型检查和 lint，GitHub Actions 用于 CI。
zh.hot: 作为 TypeScript 生态的基础设施，star 数高达 51k，虽今日新增不多，但持续被开发者依赖和贡献。
uses: TypeScript 开发者：为缺少类型的 npm 包安装 @types 定义，提升开发体验。
库作者：通过贡献类型定义，让更多用户受益，同时提升自身库的可用性。
维护者/贡献者：参与社区审查，确保类型定义质量，积累开源经验。

en.tag: High-quality TypeScript type definitions repository
en.what: DefinitelyTyped is a community-maintained repository providing high-quality TypeScript type definitions (.d.ts files) for npm packages that lack built-in types. It relies on community contributions and rigorous review to ensure accuracy and usability.
en.content: The repo contains thousands of @types definitions for various packages, organized as a pnpm monorepo with independent package management, comprehensive contribution guidelines, and automated checks.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript, uses pnpm for dependency management, dtslint for type-checking and linting, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: As a foundational piece of the TypeScript ecosystem, it has 51k stars; despite modest daily growth, it remains heavily relied upon and contributed to by developers.
uses: TypeScript developers: install @types definitions for packages lacking types to improve DX.
Library authors: contribute type definitions to benefit users and enhance library usability.
Maintainers/contributors: participate in community review to ensure quality and gain OSS experience.

zh.tag: 终端 AI 编程代理，内置 IDE 能力
zh.what: oh-my-pi 是一个终端 AI 编程代理，将 IDE 的编辑能力集成到命令行中。它支持哈希锚定的编辑、优化的工具集、LSP、Python、浏览器和子代理等功能，旨在提供开箱即用且高度可定制的编码体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Rust 代码库（约 8 万行）、TypeScript 编写的编码代理包，以及安装脚本和文档。提供 60+ 提供商、31 个内置工具、14 个 LSP 操作和 28 个 DAP 操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 和 TypeScript，运行时支持 Bun（推荐），并支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。依赖包括 LSP 和 DAP 协议，以及多种 AI 提供商。
zh.hot: 作为 Pi 的 fork，它提供了更强大的代理表面，并持续根据真实使用进行调优。本周新增 1739 星，总星数达 22525，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 16 名，反映了开发者对终端 AI 编码工具的高度关注。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接获得 AI 辅助编码，无需切换 IDE
需要高度可定制和可扩展的 AI 代理，支持多种提供商和工具
喜欢使用 Rust 和 TypeScript 构建高性能命令行工具的技术爱好者
希望利用 LSP 和 DAP 集成进行代码导航和调试的开发者

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with IDE wired in
en.what: oh-my-pi is a terminal AI coding agent that integrates IDE capabilities into the command line. It supports hash-anchored edits, an optimized tool harness, LSP, Python, browser, and subagents, aiming to provide an out-of-the-box yet deeply customizable coding experience.
en.content: The repository contains a core Rust codebase (~80k lines), a TypeScript coding agent package, and installation scripts and docs. It offers 60+ providers, 31 built-in tools, 14 LSP ops, and 28 DAP ops.
en.stack: Primarily Rust and TypeScript, with Bun as the recommended runtime, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows. It leverages LSP and DAP protocols and integrates with multiple AI providers.
en.hot: As a fork of Pi, it offers a more capable agent surface and is continuously tuned by real-world use. With 1,739 stars added this week and a total of 22,525, ranking #16 on the TypeScript weekly trending, it reflects high developer interest in terminal AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want AI-assisted coding directly in the terminal without switching IDEs
Those needing a highly customizable and extensible AI agent with multiple providers and tools
Tech enthusiasts interested in building high-performance CLI tools with Rust and TypeScript
Developers who want to leverage LSP and DAP integration for code navigation and debugging

zh.tag: 有状态、有记忆、能自我进化的 AI 代理框架
zh.what: Letta Code 是一个有状态的代理框架，旨在创建更像人而非工具的 AI 代理。这些代理拥有记忆、身份和随时间积累的经验，能够通过重写自身记忆、技能、提示甚至框架本身来学习和进化。它支持交互式使用，也可用于始终在线的主动代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的代理运行时、CLI、桌面应用、浏览器客户端、消息集成（Telegram、Slack、Discord 等），以及丰富的功能如自我改进、消息搜索、MemFS、技能系统、子代理和多代理支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，基于 Node.js 生态，依赖 git 进行上下文版本控制，支持多种消息平台集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 3152 颗星和本周新增 67 颗，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 TypeScript 第 9 名。其独特的“类人”代理概念和强大的自我进化能力吸引了开发者关注。
uses: 开发者构建具有长期记忆和自适应能力的 AI 代理，用于自动化复杂任务。
团队集成到 Slack、Discord 等平台，实现主动式 AI 助手。
研究人员探索代理的自我改进和持续学习机制。
个人用户通过 CLI 或桌面应用体验个性化 AI 代理。

en.tag: Stateful AI agent framework with memory, identity, and self-evolution
en.what: Letta Code is a stateful agent harness for creating agents that are more like people than tools. These agents have memory, identity, and a sense of experience over time, learning and evolving through rewriting their own memory, skills, prompts, and even the harness itself. It can be used interactively or to power always-on agents that work proactively.
en.content: The repository includes a full agent runtime, CLI, desktop app, browser client, messaging integrations (Telegram, Slack, Discord, etc.), and features like self-improvement, message search, MemFS, skills, subagents, and multi-agent support.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, built on the Node.js ecosystem, uses git for context versioning, and supports integrations with various messaging platforms.
en.hot: With 3152 stars and 67 new this week, it ranks 9th on GitHub Trending weekly for TypeScript. Its unique 'human-like' agent concept and powerful self-evolution capabilities attract developers.
uses: Developers building AI agents with long-term memory and adaptability for automating complex tasks.
Teams integrating proactive AI assistants into platforms like Slack, Discord, and more.
Researchers exploring self-improvement and continuous learning mechanisms in agents.
Individual users experiencing personalized AI agents via CLI or desktop app.

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 开源项目管理平台，Jira/Linear 替代品
zh.what: Plane 是一个开源的项目管理平台，旨在替代 Jira、Linear、Monday 和 ClickUp。它帮助团队管理任务、迭代（Cycles）、文档和问题分类（Triage），提供现代化的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的项目管理系统源码，包括前端（TypeScript/React）、后端（Python/Django）以及部署配置（Docker、Kubernetes）。提供丰富的功能：工作项、周期、模块、视图等。
zh.stack: 前端使用 TypeScript 和 React，后端使用 Python 和 Django，数据库采用 PostgreSQL，支持 Docker 和 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.hot: Plane 在 GitHub 上拥有 56k+ stars，今日新增 98 个，位列 Trending 日榜第 15。其开源替代商业项目管理工具的理念吸引了大量开发者，且功能丰富、部署灵活。
uses: 团队项目管理：适合需要任务跟踪、迭代管理和文档协作的团队。
自托管需求：对数据隐私和基础设施有控制要求的企业或组织。
开发者社区：对开源项目管理工具感兴趣，希望参与贡献或定制的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source project management platform, Jira/Linear alternative

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

en.hot: A Rust implementation of Git attracts attention for its safety and performance benefits. With over 11k stars and 10 new stars today, it ranks 11th on the Rust daily trending list.

适合教学场景，作为入门级函数式编程语言，帮助理解类型系统和编译原理。

Great for functional programming enthusiasts who want type safety without sacrificing performance.

Enterprise platform teams adding security, observability, and governance to agent communications.

en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation (in docs/), CI configuration (GitHub Actions), and badges. It provides the worktrunk command for creating, listing, switching, and cleaning worktrees.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem, dual-licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0.
en.hot: Since its release at the start of the year, it has quickly become the most popular Git worktree manager, now with 6,667 stars and 44 new stars today, ranking #2 on the Rust trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: need to run multiple AI agents in parallel for code generation or review, isolating worktrees to avoid conflicts.
Multi-tasking developers: handle multiple feature branches or fixes simultaneously, requiring efficient management of multiple worktrees.
CI/CD engineers: execute tasks in parallel in automated pipelines, needing isolated Git working directories.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的高性能 JS/TS 工具链集合
zh.what: Oxc（氧化编译器）是用 Rust 编写的高性能 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 工具集合，旨在为 JS 生态提供统一、极速的开发工具链。它驱动了 Rolldown（Vite 的打包器），并支持下一代超快开发工具的无缝协作。
zh.content: 仓库包含解析器（Parser）、转换器（Transformer）、压缩器（Minifier）、模块解析器（Resolver）以及 linter（Oxlint）和格式化器（Oxfmt）等组件，并提供 CLI 工具和库供集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，利用其内存安全和零成本抽象实现高性能；同时提供 npm 包（如 oxlint、oxfmt）以便在 JS 生态中使用。
zh.hot: Oxc 因成为 Vite 下一代打包器 Rolldown 的核心而备受关注，其 Rust 实现带来显著的性能提升，吸引了大量 star（22k+），并在 GitHub Trending 上持续上榜。
uses: 前端工具链开发者：希望构建或集成高性能 JS 解析、转换、压缩功能的开发者。
使用 Vite/Rolldown 的团队：需要极速打包和开发体验的现代前端项目。
需要快速 lint 和格式化的项目：用 oxlint 和 oxfmt 替代传统工具以提升 CI 速度。
对 Rust 与 JS 互操作感兴趣的工程师：学习如何用 Rust 构建高性能 JS 工具。

en.tag: A collection of high-performance JavaScript/TypeScript tools written in Rust
en.what: Oxc (The Oxidation Compiler) is a collection of high-performance tools for JavaScript and TypeScript written in Rust, aiming to provide a unified, ultra-fast toolchain for the JS ecosystem. It powers Rolldown (Vite's bundler) and enables the next generation of seamlessly integrated, ultra-fast development tools.
en.content: The repository contains components such as a parser, transformer, minifier, module resolver, as well as linter (Oxlint) and formatter (Oxfmt), offering CLI tools and libraries for integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging its memory safety and zero-cost abstractions for high performance; also provides npm packages (e.g., oxlint, oxfmt) for use in the JS ecosystem.
en.hot: Oxc gains attention as the core of Rolldown, Vite's next-generation bundler, with its Rust implementation delivering significant performance improvements, attracting over 22k stars and consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Developers building or integrating high-performance JS parsing, transformation, or minification features.
Teams using Vite/Rolldown: modern frontend projects needing blazing-fast bundling and dev experience.
Projects needing fast linting and formatting: replace traditional tools with oxlint and oxfmt to speed up CI.
Engineers interested in Rust-JS interop: learn how to build high-performance JS tools in Rust.

zh.tag: 数据中心级分布式推理服务编排层
zh.what: Dynamo 是一个开源的数据中心级推理服务框架，作为推理引擎（如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM、vLLM）之上的编排层，将它们整合为协调的多节点推理系统。它通过分离式服务、智能路由、多级 KV 缓存和自动扩展，最大化吞吐量并最小化延迟，适用于 LLM、推理、多模态和视频生成等负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心、Python 扩展、文档、示例、recipes 和容器镜像，并提供设计提案和社区贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 实现高性能，Python 提供可扩展性；依赖推理引擎如 SGLang、TensorRT-LLM 和 vLLM。
zh.hot: 本月新增 285 星，总星数 7813，登上 GitHub Trending（Rust）月榜第 20 名。作为 NVIDIA 支持的开源项目，它填补了推理引擎之上的编排层空白，吸引大量关注。
uses: AI 基础设施团队：构建大规模多节点推理服务，优化 GPU 利用率和成本。
模型部署工程师：需要为 LLM、多模态或视频生成模型设计高吞吐、低延迟的服务架构。
平台开发者：希望扩展或定制推理编排逻辑，利用 Rust 和 Python 的混合开发。
研究与实验：在数据中心规模下测试分离式推理、KV 缓存等先进技术。

en.tag: Datacenter-scale distributed inference serving orchestration layer
en.what: Dynamo is an open-source, datacenter-scale inference serving framework that acts as an orchestration layer above inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, turning them into a coordinated multi-node inference system. It uses disaggregated serving, intelligent routing, multi-tier KV caching, and automatic scaling to maximize throughput and minimize latency for LLM, reasoning, multimodal, and video generation workloads.
en.content: The repository includes a Rust core, Python extensions, documentation, examples, recipes, and container images, along with design proposals and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility; relies on inference engines like SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM.
en.hot: With 285 stars added this month and 7,813 total, it ranks #20 on GitHub Trending (Rust) monthly. As an NVIDIA-backed open-source project, it fills the orchestration gap above inference engines, drawing significant attention.
uses: AI infrastructure teams: building large-scale multi-node inference services to optimize GPU utilization and cost.
Model deployment engineers: designing high-throughput, low-latency serving architectures for LLMs, multimodal, or video generation models.
Platform developers: extending or customizing inference orchestration logic with Rust and Python.
Research and experimentation: testing advanced techniques like disaggregated serving and KV caching at datacenter scale.

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供长期记忆，实现跨工具无缝交接
zh.what: ai-memory 是一个为 AI 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等）提供长期记忆的解决方案。它允许你在一个代理中开始任务，中途退出后，用另一个代理在相同目录继续，无需重新解释架构、失败尝试或未决问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心二进制、MCP 配置和生命周期钩子，支持多种代理和平台（Linux、macOS、Windows/WSL2）。提供安装脚本、Docker 镜像、原生二进制和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 1.95+，使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol）集成代理，通过生命周期钩子捕获会话。支持 Docker 和原生二进制分发。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2520 星，总星数 4411，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 9。它解决了 AI 编码代理缺乏长期记忆的痛点，让不同代理间切换变得无缝，引发开发者广泛关注。
uses: 使用多个 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望在切换工具时保留上下文
需要跨会话维护项目架构和决策记录的技术团队
对 AI 辅助编程工具链感兴趣，希望提升代理效率的开发者

en.tag: Long-term memory for AI coding agents, enabling seamless handoff across tools
en.what: ai-memory is a solution for long-term memory in AI coding agents (like Claude Code, Codex, etc.). It lets you start a task with one agent, quit mid-task, and continue with another agent in the same directory without re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches, or open questions.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust core binary, MCP configs, and lifecycle hooks, supporting multiple agents and platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows/WSL2). Includes install scripts, Docker images, native binaries, and docs.
en.stack: Built with Rust 1.95+, uses MCP (Model Context Protocol) for agent integration, and lifecycle hooks to capture sessions. Distributed via Docker and native binaries.
en.hot: Gained 2520 stars this week (total 4411), ranking #9 on GitHub Trending weekly. It addresses the pain point of AI coding agents lacking long-term memory, enabling seamless switching between agents, which has attracted wide developer attention.
uses: Developers using multiple AI coding agents who want to preserve context when switching tools
Technical teams needing to maintain project architecture and decision records across sessions
Developers interested in AI-assisted programming toolchains and improving agent efficiency

zh.tag: Rust 即时模式 GUI 库，跨平台易用
zh.what: egui 是一个用 Rust 编写的即时模式 GUI 库，简单、快速且高度可移植。它可以在 Web、原生平台以及游戏引擎中运行，旨在成为最易用的 Rust GUI 库。
zh.content: 仓库包含 egui 核心库、官方框架 eframe（支持 Web、Linux、Mac、Windows、Android），以及示例和集成。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，无 unsafe 代码，依赖较少，支持集成到游戏引擎。
zh.hot: 凭借其易用性和跨平台能力，在 Rust 社区广受欢迎，star 数超 3 万，本周新增 113。
uses: Rust 开发者快速构建跨平台桌面应用或 Web 应用
游戏开发者需要集成 GUI 到游戏引擎中
想要学习即时模式 GUI 概念的开发者

en.tag: Easy-to-use immediate mode GUI library in Rust, runs on web and native
en.what: egui is an immediate mode GUI library written in Rust, simple, fast, and highly portable. It runs on web, native, and in game engines, aiming to be the easiest-to-use Rust GUI library.
en.content: The repository contains the egui core library, the official framework eframe (supporting Web, Linux, Mac, Windows, Android), along with examples and integrations.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation, no unsafe code, minimal dependencies, and supports integration into game engines.
en.hot: Popular in the Rust community for its ease of use and cross-platform capability, with over 30k stars and 113 new this week.
uses: Rust developers quickly building cross-platform desktop or web apps
Game developers needing to integrate GUI into their game engine
Developers wanting to learn immediate mode GUI concepts

zh.tag: Rust 编写的极简数据驱动游戏引擎
zh.what: Bevy 是一个用 Rust 编写的开源游戏引擎，采用数据驱动架构和实体组件系统（ECS），提供完整的 2D 和 3D 功能。它强调简单性、模块化和高性能，适合新手快速上手，也支持高级用户灵活定制。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎核心代码、官方示例、文档和迁移指南。目录结构包括 crates（模块化组件）、examples（可运行示例）、docs（文档）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Rust 标准库和多个 crates。利用 ECS 架构和并行计算，支持 WASM 等目标平台。
zh.hot: Bevy 在 GitHub 上拥有近 4.8 万星标，本周新增 180，位居 Rust 周榜第 16。其简洁的设计、活跃的社区和持续更新吸引了大量 Rust 游戏开发者。
uses: 游戏开发者：使用 Rust 构建 2D 或 3D 游戏，享受数据驱动和 ECS 带来的高效开发体验。
学习 Rust 的开发者：通过 Bevy 的示例和文档，深入理解 Rust 在游戏开发中的应用。
希望定制引擎的团队：Bevy 的模块化设计允许按需使用和替换组件，适合需要高度定制引擎的项目。

en.tag: A refreshingly simple data-driven game engine built in Rust
en.what: Bevy is an open-source game engine written in Rust, featuring a data-driven architecture with an Entity Component System (ECS). It provides a full 2D and 3D feature set, emphasizing simplicity, modularity, and high performance, making it accessible for beginners yet flexible for power users.
en.content: The repository contains the engine's core code, official examples, documentation, and migration guides. The directory structure includes crates (modular components), examples (runnable examples), docs (documentation), and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging the Rust standard library and various crates. It uses an ECS architecture and parallel computation, supporting targets like WASM.
en.hot: Bevy has nearly 48k stars on GitHub, with 180 added this week, ranking 16th on the Rust weekly trending list. Its simple design, active community, and continuous updates attract many Rust game developers.
uses: Game developers: Build 2D or 3D games in Rust, enjoying the efficiency of data-driven and ECS architecture.
Rust learners: Deepen understanding of Rust in game development through Bevy's examples and docs.
Teams needing custom engines: Bevy's modular design allows using and replacing components as needed, suitable for highly customized projects.

zh.tag: 多模态AI的开源湖仓格式，支持向量检索与随机访问
zh.what: Lance 是一个面向多模态 AI 的开源湖仓格式，提供文件格式、表格式和目录规范，可在对象存储上构建完整的湖仓。它支持混合搜索（向量+全文+SQL）、闪电般的随机访问、原生多模态数据存储、数据演进和零拷贝版本控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心实现、Python 绑定（pylance）、格式规范文档、示例和集成测试。目录结构包括 src（Rust 源码）、python（Python 包）、docs（文档）等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 Python 绑定，兼容 Apache Arrow、Pandas、Polars、DuckDB、Spark、Ray 等生态。依赖 Arrow 列式内存格式，支持对象存储（如 S3）。
zh.hot: 随着多模态 AI 和向量检索需求激增，Lance 提供比 Parquet 快 100 倍的随机访问和原生向量索引，吸引了大量关注。今日新增 5 星，总星数近 7000，位列 Rust 趋势榜第五。
uses: 构建混合搜索的搜索引擎和特征存储，结合向量、全文和 SQL 分析。
大规模机器学习训练，需要高性能 IO 和随机访问的数据集。
存储和管理图像、视频、音频、文本和嵌入等多模态数据。
数据工程师和 AI 工程师希望从 Parquet 迁移到更高效的格式。

en.tag: Open lakehouse format for multimodal AI with vector search and fast random access
en.what: Lance is an open lakehouse format for multimodal AI, providing a file format, table format, and catalog spec to build a complete lakehouse on object storage. It supports expressive hybrid search, lightning-fast random access, native multimodal data storage, data evolution, and zero-copy versioning.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust core implementation, Python bindings (pylance), format specification docs, examples, and integration tests. Directory structure includes src (Rust source), python (Python package), docs, etc.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust with Python bindings, compatible with Apache Arrow, Pandas, Polars, DuckDB, Spark, Ray, and more. Built on Arrow columnar memory format, supports object storage like S3.
en.hot: With the surge in multimodal AI and vector search demand, Lance offers 100x faster random access than Parquet and native vector indexing, attracting significant attention. Gaining 5 stars today, total stars near 7000, ranking 5th on Rust trending.
uses: Building search engines and feature stores with hybrid search capabilities combining vector, full-text, and SQL analytics.
Large-scale ML training requiring high-performance IO and random access to datasets.
Storing and managing multimodal data including images, videos, audio, text, and embeddings.
Data and AI engineers looking to migrate from Parquet to a more efficient format.

zh.tag: 沉浸式AI-Galgame聊天，带桌宠与剧情
zh.what: LingChat 是一款基于 AI 的 Galgame 风格聊天软件，提供情感表达、桌宠模式、日程管理和互动剧情。它让用户与自定义角色进行沉浸式对话，并具备永久记忆和情绪识别功能。
zh.content: 包含核心聊天引擎、情绪识别模型、角色自定义系统、桌宠模式、日程与待办工具，以及多角色剧本和羁绊系统。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，可能使用 Tauri 或类似框架构建跨平台桌面应用，并集成 VITS 语音服务。
zh.hot: 凭借独特的 AI-Galgame 概念和丰富功能，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 233 星，总星数达 2010，位列 Rust 周榜第 18。
uses: 适合喜欢 Galgame 和 AI 聊天，追求沉浸式陪伴体验的玩家
适合需要桌宠和日程管理，希望 AI 主动提醒的效率爱好者
适合对角色扮演和剧情创作感兴趣，想自定义角色和剧本的创作者

en.tag: Immersive AI Galgame chat with desktop pet and story modules
