en.what: LingChat is an AI-driven Galgame-style chat app offering emotional expressions, desktop pet mode, scheduling, and interactive story modules. It enables immersive conversations with customizable characters, featuring permanent memory and emotion recognition.
en.content: Includes core chat engine, emotion recognition model, character customization, desktop pet mode, scheduling tools, and multi-character script with bond system.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, likely using Tauri or similar for cross-platform desktop, integrating VITS for voice synthesis.
en.hot: Its unique AI-Galgame concept and rich features have driven rapid popularity, gaining 233 stars this week and reaching 2010 total, ranking #18 on Rust weekly trending.
uses: For fans of Galgame and AI chat seeking immersive companionship
For productivity enthusiasts wanting a desktop pet with scheduling and proactive reminders
For creators interested in roleplay and storytelling, who want to customize characters and scripts

zh.tag: 高性能云原生向量数据库，支撑 AI 非结构化数据检索
zh.what: Milvus 是一个专为大规模向量相似性搜索设计的高性能向量数据库。它能够高效组织和检索文本、图像等多模态非结构化数据，为 AI 应用提供底层数据支撑。支持分布式部署与实时流式更新，可处理数十亿向量和数万级 QPS。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Milvus 的完整源代码，采用 Go 和 C++ 编写，提供 Standalone 单机模式和分布式集群模式，并包含 Milvus Lite 轻量版（可通过 pip 安装）以及云服务 Zilliz Cloud 的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 和 C++，利用 CPU/GPU 硬件加速实现高性能向量搜索，架构完全分布式且原生支持 Kubernetes，便于水平扩展。
zh.hot: Milvus 是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的向量数据库之一，拥有 45.8k 星标，今日新增 22 星并登上 Go 语言趋势榜。随着 AI 应用对向量检索需求的爆发，其高性能和云原生特性吸引了大量开发者。
uses: AI 应用开发者：构建 RAG、语义搜索、推荐系统等需要向量检索的功能。
数据工程师：管理大规模非结构化数据，实现实时流式更新和高效查询。
云原生架构师：在 Kubernetes 集群中部署可水平扩展的向量数据库服务。
机器学习工程师：利用 Milvus Lite 快速原型验证，或通过 Zilliz Cloud 免运维使用。

en.tag: High-performance cloud-native vector database for scalable AI search
en.what: Milvus is a high-performance vector database built for large-scale vector similarity search. It efficiently organizes and retrieves unstructured data like text, images, and multi-modal information, powering AI applications. It supports distributed deployment and real-time streaming updates, handling billions of vectors and tens of thousands of queries per second.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Milvus, written in Go and C++, offering Standalone mode for single-machine deployment and distributed cluster mode, along with Milvus Lite (pip installable) and integration with Zilliz Cloud managed service.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go and C++, leveraging CPU/GPU hardware acceleration for high-performance vector search. The architecture is fully distributed and K8s-native, enabling horizontal scaling.
en.hot: Milvus is one of the most popular vector databases on GitHub with 45.8k stars, gaining 22 stars today and trending in the Go category. The surge in AI applications requiring vector search has made its high performance and cloud-native features highly attractive.
uses: AI developers building RAG, semantic search, recommendation systems, and other vector-based features.
Data engineers managing large-scale unstructured data with real-time streaming updates and efficient queries.
Cloud-native architects deploying horizontally scalable vector databases on Kubernetes.
ML engineers prototyping quickly with Milvus Lite or using Zilliz Cloud for zero-ops managed service.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台
zh.what: WeKnora是腾讯开源的LLM知识平台，将原始文档转化为可查询的RAG、自主推理的Agent和自维护的Wiki。它支持多源数据导入、树状文件夹视图、块编辑与版本回滚，并提供交互式知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、架构文档、API参考、开发者指南，以及多语言README（中英日韩）。核心功能包括RAG快速问答、ReAct Agent、Wiki模式、知识图谱、多源导入（飞书、Notion、语雀、RSS等）和网站嵌入组件。
zh.stack: 主语言为Go，基于LLM能力构建，涉及RAG、ReAct Agent、MCP工具集成、向量检索等技术。支持多种文档格式和外部服务（如飞书、Notion、RSS）。
zh.hot: 上线后迅速获得2万+星标，今日新增105星，位列GitHub Go语言日榜第5。其将文档自动转化为可交互知识图谱和自维护Wiki的能力，解决了企业知识管理的痛点，备受开发者关注。
uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。
复杂任务自动化：通过ReAct Agent编排检索、工具调用和网络搜索，完成多步骤分析。
个人知识管理：导入个人文档，生成知识图谱和Wiki，辅助学习和研究。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. It supports multi-source ingestion, tree-structured folder views, chunk editing with revision history, and an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, architecture docs, API reference, developer guide, and multi-language READMEs (EN, CN, JA, KO). Key features include RAG-based Q&A, ReAct Agent, Wiki mode, knowledge graph, multi-source ingestion (Feishu, Notion, Yuque, RSS, etc.), and website embed widgets.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, built on LLM capabilities, incorporating RAG, ReAct Agent, MCP tool integration, and vector retrieval. Supports various document formats and external services like Feishu, Notion, and RSS.
en.hot: Quickly gained over 20k stars with 105 new stars today, ranking #5 on GitHub Go daily trending. Its ability to auto-convert documents into interactive knowledge graphs and self-maintaining wikis addresses enterprise knowledge management pain points, drawing significant developer attention.
uses: Enterprise knowledge base: Automatically organize internal documents into queryable RAG and self-maintaining Wiki to boost employee retrieval efficiency.
Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 多协议多用户的 Xray 管理面板
zh.what: 3X-UI 是一个开源的 Xray-core 服务器管理面板，提供多语言 Web 界面，支持部署、配置和监控多种代理协议。它支持单节点和多节点部署，并提供了丰富的用户管理功能，如流量限制、到期时间和 IP 限制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的面板源码、多语言翻译文件、文档和自定义订阅模板。主要组件包括 Web 界面、RESTful API、Telegram 机器人以及内置的订阅服务器。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，依赖 Xray-core 作为核心代理引擎。前端使用 Vue.js 和 Element Plus 构建，后端采用 Gin 框架，并支持 SQLite 和 PostgreSQL 数据库。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 45k 星标，今日新增 86 星，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 8。其强大的功能、活跃的社区和持续的更新使其成为 Xray 面板的热门选择。
uses: 个人用户：搭建和管理自己的代理服务器，支持多种协议和用户管理
小型团队或组织：在多台服务器上部署统一管理面板，实现集中监控和配置
开发者：通过 RESTful API 集成到自己的应用或服务中，实现自动化管理

en.tag: Multi-protocol, multi-user Xray management panel
en.what: 3X-UI is an open-source web control panel for managing Xray-core servers, offering a multi-language interface for deploying, configuring, and monitoring various proxy protocols. It supports both single and multi-node setups, with per-client management including traffic quotas, expiry dates, and IP limits.
en.content: The repository contains the full panel source code, multi-language translation files, documentation, and custom subscription templates. Key components include a web interface, RESTful API, Telegram bot, and built-in subscription server.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging Xray-core as the core proxy engine. The frontend is built with Vue.js and Element Plus, while the backend uses the Gin framework, with support for SQLite and PostgreSQL databases.
en.hot: With over 45k stars and 86 new stars today, ranking 8th on the Go trending list, its powerful features, active community, and continuous updates make it a popular choice for Xray panels.
uses: Individual users: set up and manage their own proxy servers with multi-protocol support and user management
Small teams or organizations: deploy a unified panel across multiple servers for centralized monitoring and configuration
Developers: integrate via RESTful API into their own applications or services for automated management

zh.tag: 自建私有搜索引擎，索引浏览记录与本地文件
zh.what: Hister 是一个注重隐私的搜索引擎，可以索引你访问过的网页和本地文件的内容，支持全文搜索。它提供 Web 界面、终端界面和 MCP 接口，方便你随时找回信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web UI（基于 Svelte）、浏览器扩展（Firefox/Chrome）以及终端客户端。支持多用户、语义搜索、爬虫和浏览器历史导入。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 CGO（需要 C 编译器），Web 前端使用 npm 和 Svelte。
zh.hot: 今日新增 142 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4。在隐私担忧加剧的背景下，自托管搜索引擎需求上升，Hister 提供完整功能且易于部署。
uses: 注重隐私的个人用户，希望本地搜索自己的浏览历史和文件。
团队或组织，需要内部文档和网页的私有搜索解决方案。
开发者，希望集成 MCP 到 AI 助手，实现个性化信息检索。

en.tag: Self-hosted private search engine for your browsing history and local files
en.what: Hister is a privacy-focused search engine that indexes the full content of pages you visit and files you keep, enabling full-text search. It offers web, terminal, and MCP interfaces for easy information retrieval.
en.content: The repository includes a Go backend, a web UI (Svelte-based), browser extensions for Firefox/Chrome, and a terminal client. It supports multi-user, semantic search, crawler, and browser history import.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with CGO dependencies (requires C compiler), and npm/Svelte for the web frontend.
en.hot: Gained 142 stars today, ranking #4 on Go trending. Amid growing privacy concerns, self-hosted search engines are in demand, and Hister offers full features with easy deployment.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want to search their browsing history and files locally.
Teams or organizations needing a private search solution for internal documents and web pages.
Developers who want to integrate MCP into AI assistants for personalized information retrieval.

zh.tag: 云原生 AI 原生 API 网关，支持 MCP 托管与多模型代理
zh.what: Higress 是一个基于 Istio 和 Envoy 的云原生 API 网关，专为 AI 场景设计。它支持通过 Go/Rust/JS 编写 Wasm 插件进行扩展，并提供开箱即用的控制台。其 AI 网关能力支持国内外主流模型提供商，并可通过插件机制托管 MCP 服务器，使 AI 代理能够轻松调用各种工具和服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Higress 的源代码、文档、示例和插件市场。核心组件包括基于 Envoy 的网关引擎、Wasm 插件运行时、控制台界面以及丰富的预置插件（如 AI 代理、限流、认证等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Istio 和 Envoy 构建，支持 Wasm 插件（Go/Rust/JS）。依赖 Kubernetes 生态，提供 Helm 部署方式。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF Sandbox 项目，Higress 在 AI 网关领域迅速走红，凭借对 MCP 的原生支持和多模型代理能力，吸引了大量开发者。目前 Star 数已达 9220，今日新增 22，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 10 名。
uses: AI 应用开发者：需要统一接入多个大模型提供商，简化 API 管理和成本控制。
平台工程师：希望为微服务和 AI 服务提供高性能、可扩展的 API 网关，并支持 Wasm 插件定制。
MCP 服务提供者：需要快速将工具或服务暴露为 MCP 服务器，供 AI 代理调用。

en.tag: Cloud-native AI-native API gateway with MCP hosting and multi-provider AI proxy
en.what: Higress is a cloud-native API gateway based on Istio and Envoy, designed for AI scenarios. It can be extended with Wasm plugins written in Go/Rust/JS and provides an out-of-the-box console. Its AI gateway capabilities support all mainstream model providers, and it can host MCP servers via plugins, enabling AI agents to easily call various tools and services.
en.content: The repository contains Higress source code, documentation, examples, and a plugin hub. Core components include the Envoy-based gateway engine, Wasm plugin runtime, console UI, and dozens of ready-to-use plugins (e.g., AI proxy, rate limiting, authentication).
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, built on Istio and Envoy, with Wasm plugin support (Go/Rust/JS). It leverages the Kubernetes ecosystem and offers Helm deployment.
en.hot: As a CNCF Sandbox project, Higress has gained rapid popularity in the AI gateway space, thanks to its native MCP support and multi-provider AI proxy capabilities. With 9,220 stars and 22 added today, it ranks #10 on the Go trending list.
uses: AI application developers: need to unify access to multiple LLM providers, simplifying API management and cost control.
Platform engineers: want a high-performance, scalable API gateway for microservices and AI services, with Wasm plugin customization.
MCP service providers: need to quickly expose tools or services as MCP servers for AI agents to call.

zh.tag: 为自主 AI 代理打造的零配置、零信任 P2P 智能网络
zh.what: SAM 是一个专为自主 AI 代理设计的智能网络，节点自动发现并构建 P2P 网络，无需配置。所有连接、节点和数据包都经过严格认证，确保零信任安全。代理可以动态接入网络，发现并调用工具，实现跨环境无缝移动。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个核心组件：sam-control-plane（注册与控制平面）、sam-router（基于 libp2p 的引导节点和中继）、sam-node（本地节点客户端，提供网格传输和 MCP 边车路由）。还提供详细的文档、快速入门指南、集成指南和 Kubernetes 部署方案。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 libp2p 实现 P2P 网络，支持 MCP（模型上下文协议）边车路由，可集成 Google Gemini、Claude 等 AI 代理。支持 Docker 和 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 408 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Go）第 3 名，因为其零配置、零信任的 P2P 网络设计直击 AI 代理协作的痛点，且来自 Google 背书。
uses: AI 代理开发者：希望让代理动态发现并调用其他代理或工具，构建去中心化协作网络。
基础设施运维：需要为分布式系统提供安全、自愈的 P2P 连接，支持多云和边缘环境。
研究爱好者：对零信任网络、自主代理通信感兴趣，希望探索前沿技术。

en.tag: Zero-config, zero-trust P2P mesh network for autonomous AI agents
en.what: SAM is a smart network built for autonomous AI agents, where nodes automatically discover each other and form a P2P network with zero configuration. Every connection, node, and packet is strictly authenticated, ensuring zero-trust security. Agents can plug in, communicate, and dynamically invoke tools across the mesh, with cryptographic identities enabling seamless mobility across environments.
en.content: The repository contains three core components: sam-control-plane (registry and control plane), sam-router (libp2p bootstrap nodes and relays), and sam-node (local node client providing mesh transport and MCP sidecar routing). It also includes comprehensive documentation, quick start guides, integration guides, and Kubernetes deployment options.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging libp2p for P2P networking, with MCP (Model Context Protocol) sidecar routing. Integrates with AI agents like Google Gemini and Claude. Supports Docker and Kubernetes deployment.
en.hot: Gained 408 stars this week, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) weekly, because its zero-config, zero-trust P2P network design directly addresses the pain points of AI agent collaboration, backed by Google.
uses: AI agent developers: want agents to dynamically discover and invoke tools from other agents, building decentralized collaboration networks.
Infrastructure operators: need secure, self-healing P2P connectivity for distributed systems across cloud and edge environments.
Researchers and enthusiasts: interested in zero-trust networking and autonomous agent communication, exploring cutting-edge technology.

zh.tag: 开源电动车充电控制器与家庭能源管理系统
zh.what: evcc 是一个可扩展的电动车充电控制器和家庭能源管理系统，旨在提供本地能源管理，不依赖云服务。它支持多种充电桩、智能开关和热泵，并具有简洁的用户界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、截图和构建配置，支持通过 Docker 部署，并集成了多种设备驱动。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种开源库，支持 Docker 容器化部署，并集成 EEBus、OCPP 等协议。
zh.hot: 随着电动汽车和太阳能充电的普及，evcc 提供了本地化、开源的能源管理解决方案，受到广泛关注，当前在 GitHub 上拥有 7125 颗星。
uses: 电动汽车车主希望优化太阳能充电，降低电费。
家庭能源管理者需要集成多种设备，实现智能用电。
开源爱好者对自托管能源管理系统感兴趣。

en.tag: Open-source EV charge controller and home energy management system
en.what: evcc is an extensible EV charge controller and home energy management system that provides local energy management without relying on cloud services. It supports a wide range of chargers, smart switches, and heat pumps, and features a clean user interface.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, screenshots, and build configuration, with Docker deployment support and integration of various device drivers.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various open-source libraries, supporting Docker containerization, and integrating protocols like EEBus and OCPP.
en.hot: With the rise of EVs and solar charging, evcc offers a local, open-source energy management solution, gaining significant attention with 7,125 stars on GitHub.
uses: EV owners looking to optimize solar charging and reduce electricity costs.
Home energy managers needing to integrate multiple devices for smart power usage.
Open-source enthusiasts interested in self-hosted energy management systems.

zh.tag: 可编程的异构LLM推理路由层，构建混合模型系统
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程的路由层，用于在异构 LLM 基础设施上构建 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它评估请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不硬编码路由逻辑的情况下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私和安全性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的路由器核心、安装脚本、文档站点（website/）、以及示例和配置。提供在线 Playground 和 Hugging Face 集成，支持 v0.3 Themis 等版本发布。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 vLLM 生态，可能集成 Hugging Face 模型和云/边缘计算资源。
zh.hot: 随着 LLM 应用多样化，对混合模型路由的需求增长，该仓库提供可编程路由方案，今日新增 28 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 3 名。
uses: 需要优化 LLM 推理成本与延迟的工程团队，通过路由策略动态选择模型。
构建多模型系统（MoM）的开发者，希望根据请求内容智能组合模型输出。
关注数据隐私的企业，利用路由将敏感数据保留在本地或私有云。
研究人员探索信号驱动的路由算法，可基于此进行实验和扩展。

en.tag: Programmable routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference to build Mixture-of-Models systems
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path for each request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based router core, installation scripts, documentation site (website/), examples, and configurations. It offers an online Playground and Hugging Face integration, with releases like v0.3 Themis.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, leveraging the vLLM ecosystem, with potential integrations with Hugging Face models and cloud/edge compute resources.
en.hot: As LLM applications diversify, the need for Mixture-of-Models routing grows; this repo offers a programmable solution, gaining 28 stars today and ranking #3 on Go trending.
uses: Engineering teams optimizing LLM inference cost and latency by dynamically routing requests to appropriate models.
Developers building Mixture-of-Models systems who want to intelligently compose model outputs based on request content.
Enterprises concerned with data privacy, using routing to keep sensitive data within local or private cloud boundaries.
Researchers exploring signal-driven routing algorithms, can experiment and extend based on this project.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 模型网关与资产管理平台
zh.what: New API 是一个集中式 AI 模型网关，支持将多种 LLM 统一转换为 OpenAI、Claude 或 Gemini 兼容格式，便于聚合与分发。它提供个人和企业级模型管理、认证、用量统计与成本核算，并支持私有化部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web 前端（基于 React 等）、Docker 部署配置、多语言 README（中英法日等）以及详细的文档和快速入门指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能采用 React 等现代框架，依赖 Docker 进行容器化部署，并集成多种 LLM API 协议转换。
zh.hot: 凭借 45.5k 星标和日增 115 星，New API 成为 AI 基础设施的热门选择，因其解决了多模型统一接入的痛点，并支持私有化部署，深受开发者和企业青睐。
uses: 开发者：需要统一管理多个 LLM API 密钥和调用格式的开发者
企业：希望构建内部 AI 网关，实现成本控制和审计的企业
自托管用户：偏好私有化部署，避免依赖第三方服务的用户
AI 应用团队：需要将不同模型快速集成到现有应用中的团队

en.tag: Unified AI model gateway and asset management platform
en.what: New API is a centralized AI model gateway that aggregates and distributes various LLMs by converting them into OpenAI-compatible, Claude-compatible, or Gemini-compatible formats. It offers personal and enterprise-grade model management, authentication, usage analytics, cost accounting, and supports private deployment.
en.content: The repository includes a Go-based backend service, a web frontend (e.g., React), Docker deployment configurations, multilingual READMEs (Chinese, English, French, Japanese, etc.), and comprehensive documentation and quick-start guides.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with a modern frontend framework like React, containerized via Docker, and integrates protocol conversion for various LLM APIs.
en.hot: With 45.5k stars and 115 new stars today, New API is a popular choice for AI infrastructure, solving the pain point of unified multi-model access and supporting private deployment, which appeals to developers and enterprises.
uses: Developers: those needing to manage multiple LLM API keys and formats in one place
Enterprises: seeking an internal AI gateway for cost control and auditing
Self-hosters: users preferring private deployment to avoid third-party dependencies
AI application teams: teams needing to quickly integrate various models into existing apps

zh.tag: 行业标准容器运行时，强调简单、稳健与可移植性
zh.what: containerd 是一个行业标准的容器运行时，专注于简单性、健壮性和可移植性。它以守护进程形式运行于 Linux 和 Windows，管理宿主机上容器的完整生命周期，包括镜像传输与存储、容器执行与监督、底层存储与网络挂载等。它被设计为嵌入到更大的系统中，而不是直接供开发者或最终用户使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 containerd 的源代码、构建配置、文档（包括架构设计文档）以及 CI/CD 工作流。项目采用 Go 语言编写，并遵循 CNCF 的治理模型，包含多个子项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux/Windows 系统调用，并集成 CNCF 生态工具。构建系统支持 Makefile 和 GitHub Actions。
zh.hot: 作为 CNCF 毕业项目，containerd 是 Kubernetes 等主流平台的默认运行时，拥有 21168 颗星，持续获得社区关注。其稳定性与广泛采用使其成为容器基础设施的核心组件。
uses: 平台工程师：集成 containerd 以构建容器平台或 Kubernetes 节点，管理容器生命周期。
容器运行时开发者：基于 containerd 扩展或定制运行时功能，满足特定需求。
DevOps 团队：利用 containerd 的高效镜像管理和稳定运行，优化 CI/CD 流水线。
安全研究人员：审查和贡献安全补丁，参与 CNCF 安全顾问团队。

en.tag: Industry-standard container runtime emphasizing simplicity, robustness, and portability
en.what: containerd is an industry-standard container runtime with an emphasis on simplicity, robustness, and portability. It is available as a daemon for Linux and Windows, managing the complete container lifecycle of its host system: image transfer and storage, container execution and supervision, low-level storage and network attachments, etc. It is designed to be embedded into a larger system, rather than being used directly by developers or end-users.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, build configuration, documentation (including architecture design docs), and CI/CD workflows for containerd. The project is written in Go and follows CNCF governance, with multiple subprojects.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on Linux/Windows system calls and integrating with CNCF ecosystem tools. Build system supports Makefile and GitHub Actions.
en.hot: As a CNCF graduated project, containerd is the default runtime for mainstream platforms like Kubernetes, with 21,168 stars and ongoing community attention. Its stability and widespread adoption make it a core component of container infrastructure.
uses: Platform engineers: Integrate containerd to build container platforms or Kubernetes nodes, managing container lifecycles.
Container runtime developers: Extend or customize runtime features based on containerd to meet specific needs.
DevOps teams: Leverage containerd's efficient image management and stable operation to optimize CI/CD pipelines.
Security researchers: Review and contribute security patches, participate in CNCF security advisor team.

zh.tag: Go 语言高性能并行 Lint 工具
zh.what: golangci-lint 是一个快速运行的 Go 语言 linter 聚合工具，它并行执行多个 linter，利用缓存加速，支持 YAML 配置，并集成主流 IDE。它内置超过一百种 linter，帮助开发者发现代码中的错误、风格问题和潜在缺陷。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、文档（位于 golangci-lint.run）、安装脚本、CI 配置、Docker 镜像以及贡献者列表。核心是一个命令行工具，通过配置文件选择并运行多个 linter。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 生态中的各种 linter 库，支持 YAML 配置，并提供 Docker 镜像和 CI 集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Go 社区的标准 lint 工具，拥有 19k+ star，今日新增 9 星并登上 Go 日榜，因其高效并行和丰富 linter 集成而广受欢迎。
uses: Go 开发者：在本地开发或 CI 中运行 lint 检查，提升代码质量
团队协作：统一代码风格和规范，减少 review 时间
开源项目维护者：集成到 CI 流程，自动检查 PR 代码

en.tag: Fast parallel linter runner for Go with caching and 100+ linters
en.what: golangci-lint is a fast linter runner for Go that executes linters in parallel, uses caching, supports YAML configuration, and integrates with major IDEs. It includes over a hundred linters to help developers catch errors, style issues, and potential bugs.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code, documentation (hosted at golangci-lint.run), installation scripts, CI configs, Docker images, and a contributors list. The core is a CLI tool that runs multiple linters via configuration.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging various linter libraries from the Go ecosystem, supports YAML config, and provides Docker images and CI integration.
en.hot: As the standard lint tool for Go, it has 19k+ stars, gained 9 stars today, and ranked #4 on the Go daily trending list, popular for its parallel efficiency and extensive linter integration.
uses: Go developers: run lint checks locally or in CI to improve code quality
Teams: unify code style and standards, reduce review time
Open-source maintainers: integrate into CI to automatically check PRs

zh.tag: 自托管聚合仪表盘，把订阅源集中一处
zh.what: Glance 是一个轻量级、高度可定制的自托管仪表盘，用于集中展示 RSS、Reddit、Hacker News、天气、YouTube 等订阅源。它通过美观简洁的界面，让用户在一个页面中快速浏览所有信息流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务、YAML 配置文件示例、文档（配置、主题、预配置页面）、社区组件目录以及 Docker 部署支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖少量 JavaScript（原生），生成单一可执行文件（<20MB），支持多平台和 Docker 容器。
zh.hot: 凭借极低的资源占用、丰富的组件生态和高度可定制性，Glance 在自托管社区广受欢迎，目前已收获 36,682 颗星，今日新增 22 颗。
uses: 自托管爱好者：搭建个人信息中心，整合 RSS、新闻、天气等订阅源。
开发者和技术爱好者：监控 GitHub、Hacker News、Reddit 等技术社区动态。
追求效率的用户：通过自定义布局和主题，打造专属的极简仪表盘。

en.tag: Self-hosted dashboard aggregating all your feeds in one place
en.what: Glance is a lightweight, highly customizable self-hosted dashboard that aggregates feeds like RSS, Reddit, Hacker News, weather, YouTube, and more. It presents all your information streams in a beautiful, streamlined interface for quick browsing.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, YAML configuration examples, documentation (configuration, themes, preconfigured pages), community widgets directory, and Docker deployment support.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with minimal vanilla JavaScript, producing a single binary under 20MB for multiple OS/architectures, and a small Docker container.
en.hot: With its low resource usage, extensive widget ecosystem, and high customizability, Glance has gained popularity in the self-hosting community, amassing 36,682 stars with 22 added today.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: build a personal dashboard to aggregate RSS, news, weather, and more.
Developers and tech enthusiasts: monitor GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, and other tech communities.
Productivity-focused users: create a minimal, personalized dashboard with custom layouts and themes.

zh.tag: 高性能 Go 编写的 WhatsApp 集成 API
zh.what: Evolution Go 是一个用 Go 构建的高性能 WhatsApp API，属于 Evolution Foundation 生态系统的一部分。它基于 whatsmeow 库，提供 RESTful API、实时事件（WebSocket、Webhook、AMQP/NATS）以及媒体支持，方便开发者将 WhatsApp 集成到自己的应用中。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、Docker 配置、Swagger 文档、示例环境文件（.env.example）以及 Makefile 构建脚本。核心功能包括二维码配对、媒体存储（MinIO/S3）、消息持久化（PostgreSQL）和内置许可证管理。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 whatsmeow 库实现 WhatsApp 协议，支持 PostgreSQL、MinIO/S3、RabbitMQ/NATS 等外部服务，并提供 Docker 镜像。
zh.hot: 本周新增 115 星，总星数 779，登上 GitHub Trending（Go 周榜）第 15 名。作为 Evolution Foundation 生态的官方 WhatsApp 引擎，它提供了高性能、轻量级的集成方案，受到 CRM 社区等项目的青睐。
uses: 开发者需要将 WhatsApp 消息功能集成到自己的应用或 CRM 系统中。
企业希望构建自动化客服或营销通知服务，利用 Webhook 和实时事件。
对 Go 语言感兴趣，希望学习或贡献高性能消息 API 的开源开发者。

en.tag: High-performance WhatsApp integration API built in Go
en.what: Evolution Go is a high-performance WhatsApp API built in Go, part of the Evolution Foundation ecosystem. It leverages the whatsmeow library to offer a RESTful API, real-time events (WebSocket, Webhook, AMQP/NATS), and media support, enabling developers to integrate WhatsApp into their applications.
en.content: The repository contains complete Go source code, Docker configuration, Swagger docs, an example environment file (.env.example), and Makefile build scripts. Key features include QR code pairing, media storage (MinIO/S3), message persistence (PostgreSQL), and built-in license management.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it depends on the whatsmeow library for WhatsApp protocol, supports external services like PostgreSQL, MinIO/S3, RabbitMQ/NATS, and provides Docker images.
en.hot: With 115 stars added this week and 779 total, it ranks #15 on GitHub Trending (Go weekly). As the official WhatsApp engine in the Evolution Foundation ecosystem, it offers a high-performance, lightweight integration solution, favored by projects like the CRM community.
uses: Developers who need to integrate WhatsApp messaging into their apps or CRM systems.
Businesses looking to build automated customer support or marketing notifications using webhooks and real-time events.
Open-source developers interested in Go who want to learn or contribute to a high-performance messaging API.

zh.tag: 自托管一体化软件开发服务平台
zh.what: Gitea 是一个用 Go 编写的自托管软件开发服务平台，提供 Git 托管、代码审查、问题跟踪、团队协作、包注册表和 CI/CD 等功能。它旨在成为最简单、最快、最无痛的自托管解决方案，并支持复用 GitHub Actions。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Gitea 源代码、文档、构建脚本和配置文件。项目采用模块化结构，包含前端、后端、文档等目录，并支持多种部署方式，如 Docker、二进制包等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端采用 Vue.js 和 Fomantic UI。依赖包括 Go 模块、Node.js 等，支持跨平台运行，包括 Linux、macOS、Windows 等。
zh.hot: Gitea 作为轻量级、易部署的 GitHub 替代品，持续受到开发者青睐。本周新增 161 颗星，总星数达 57,673，在 Go 语言周榜中位列第 21 名，显示出稳定的热度和社区支持。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队希望自建 Git 服务，避免依赖第三方平台。
企业需要内部代码托管和协作平台，并希望完全掌控数据。
开源项目寻求轻量级、低资源消耗的代码托管解决方案。
对 GitHub Actions 有依赖但希望自托管 CI/CD 的用户。

en.tag: Self-hosted all-in-one software development service
en.what: Gitea is a self-hosted software development service written in Go, offering Git hosting, code review, issue tracking, team collaboration, package registry, and CI/CD. It aims to be the easiest, fastest, and most painless way to set up a self-hosted all-in-one service, with support for reusing GitHub Actions.
en.content: The repository contains the full Gitea source code, documentation, build scripts, and configuration files. It is modularly structured with frontend, backend, and docs directories, and supports various deployment methods such as Docker and binary packages.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with a frontend using Vue.js and Fomantic UI. Dependencies include Go modules and Node.js, and it supports cross-platform execution on Linux, macOS, Windows, and more.
en.hot: As a lightweight and easy-to-deploy GitHub alternative, Gitea continues to gain developer traction. With 161 new stars this week and a total of 57,673, it ranks #21 on the Go weekly trending list, reflecting steady popularity and community support.
uses: Individual developers or small teams wanting to self-host Git services to avoid third-party dependencies.
Enterprises needing an internal code hosting and collaboration platform with full data control.
Open-source projects seeking a lightweight, low-resource code hosting solution.
Users who rely on GitHub Actions but want self-hosted CI/CD.

zh.tag: 复古终端音乐播放器，致敬 Winamp
zh.what: cliamp 是一款受 Winamp 启发的复古终端音乐播放器，支持播放本地文件、流媒体、播客、YouTube、Spotify 等众多来源。它提供频谱可视化、参数均衡器和播放列表管理，将现代音乐服务带入终端环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的完整播放器代码，基于 Bubbletea、Lip Gloss、Beep 和 go-librespot 构建。提供安装脚本、Homebrew、AUR、Nix 等多种安装方式，并附有文档和演示视频。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Charmbracelet 的 Bubbletea 和 Lip Gloss 构建 TUI，使用 Beep 处理音频，go-librespot 支持 Spotify。可选依赖包括 ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp 以扩展格式和平台支持。
zh.hot: 凭借对 Winamp 的怀旧情怀和强大的多平台支持，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，3.4k stars 且日增 61，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4 名。
uses: 终端爱好者：喜欢在终端中完成所有操作，追求极客风格的音乐播放体验。
多平台用户：需要统一播放本地、流媒体、播客等多种来源的音乐，且跨平台使用。
怀旧玩家：怀念 Winamp 的界面和功能，希望在终端中重现类似体验。

en.tag: Retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp
en.what: cliamp is a retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp, supporting local files, streams, podcasts, YouTube, Spotify, and more. It features a spectrum visualizer, parametric EQ, and playlist management, bringing modern music services to the terminal.
en.content: The repository contains the full player code written in Go, built with Bubbletea, Lip Gloss, Beep, and go-librespot. It offers multiple installation methods including script, Homebrew, AUR, Nix, and includes documentation and demo videos.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, using Charmbracelet's Bubbletea and Lip Gloss for the TUI, Beep for audio processing, and go-librespot for Spotify support. Optional dependencies include ffmpeg and yt-dlp for extended format and platform support.
en.hot: Riding on Winamp nostalgia and robust multi-platform support, it quickly gained traction with 3.4k stars and 61 daily additions, ranking #4 on the Go trending list.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts: enjoy doing everything in the terminal and seek a geeky music playback experience.
Multi-platform users: need a unified player for local files, streams, podcasts, etc., across different OSes.
Nostalgic users: miss Winamp's interface and features and want a similar experience in the terminal.

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的开源门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证与授权服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）。它作为反向代理的前端，保护应用免受未授权访问，支持多种认证方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Authelia 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置、Docker 镜像构建文件以及测试套件。项目采用 Go 编写，提供可执行二进制文件和容器化部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种开源库，如用于 Web 框架的 Gin、用于配置管理的 Viper 等。支持多种数据库后端（如 SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL）和 LDAP/Active Directory 集成。
zh.hot: Authelia 因其强大的安全功能和对 OpenID Connect 的官方认证而受到广泛关注，star 数接近 2.9 万。本周新增 98 个 star，持续活跃在 GitHub 趋势榜上，表明社区对自托管身份认证解决方案的需求旺盛。
uses: 自托管服务提供商：为个人或组织自托管的 Web 应用添加统一登录和二次验证，提升安全性。
家庭实验室爱好者：在 NAS 或家庭服务器上部署，保护各类服务（如媒体、监控）的访问。
企业 IT 管理员：需要为内部应用实现集中身份认证和访问控制，且希望避免商业 IAM 成本。
开发者：希望集成 OIDC 或 SAML 认证到自己的应用中，并需要一个开源参考实现。

en.tag: Open-source SSO and MFA portal for web apps, OpenID Certified
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication and authorization server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as a front-end for reverse proxies, protecting apps from unauthorized access and supporting various authentication methods.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configurations, Docker image build files, and test suites for Authelia. Written in Go, it provides executable binaries and containerized deployment options.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging open-source libraries like Gin for web framework and Viper for configuration management. Supports multiple database backends (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and LDAP/Active Directory integration.
en.hot: Authelia gains attention for its robust security features and official OpenID Connect certification, with nearly 29k stars. Adding 98 stars this week, it remains active on GitHub Trending, reflecting strong community demand for self-hosted identity solutions.
uses: Self-hosters: Add unified login and two-factor verification to self-hosted web apps for enhanced security.
Home lab enthusiasts: Deploy on NAS or home servers to protect access to services like media and monitoring.
Enterprise IT admins: Implement centralized authentication and access control for internal apps without commercial IAM costs.
Developers: Integrate OIDC or SAML authentication into their apps and need an open-source reference implementation.

zh.tag: 海量文件分布式存储系统，支持 S3 与 Iceberg
zh.what: SeaweedFS 是一个分布式存储系统，用于对象存储（S3 兼容）、文件系统和 Iceberg 表，能够处理数十亿文件，实现 O(1) 磁盘访问和轻松的水平扩展。它旨在提供高效、可扩展的存储解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SeaweedFS 的完整源代码，包括主程序（weed）、客户端库、文档、示例和部署配置。项目采用 Go 编写，提供二进制发布和 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gRPC、FUSE、S3 兼容 API 等，支持多种存储后端和协议。
zh.hot: SeaweedFS 因其高性能、可扩展性和多功能性而受到欢迎，拥有 34k+ 星标，本周新增 146 星，持续吸引开发者关注。它解决了大规模文件存储的痛点，并积极维护。
uses: 适合需要存储海量小文件或大文件的场景，如社交媒体、备份、日志存储等。
适合需要 S3 兼容对象存储的开发者，可无缝迁移现有应用。
适合需要分布式文件系统或 Iceberg 表存储的数据湖场景。
适合希望以低成本实现高可用、可扩展存储的团队。

en.tag: Distributed storage for billions of files with S3, file system, and Iceberg support
en.what: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for object storage (S3-compatible), file systems, and Iceberg tables, designed to handle billions of files with O(1) disk access and effortless horizontal scaling. It aims to provide an efficient and scalable storage solution.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of SeaweedFS, including the main program (weed), client libraries, documentation, examples, and deployment configurations. It is written in Go and offers binary releases and Docker images.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging gRPC, FUSE, S3-compatible APIs, and supporting multiple storage backends and protocols.
en.hot: SeaweedFS is popular for its high performance, scalability, and versatility, with 34k+ stars and 146 new stars this week, continuing to attract developer attention. It addresses pain points in large-scale file storage and is actively maintained.
uses: Ideal for storing massive numbers of small or large files, such as social media, backups, and log storage.
Suitable for developers needing S3-compatible object storage, enabling seamless migration of existing applications.
Great for data lake scenarios requiring distributed file systems or Iceberg table storage.
Perfect for teams seeking cost-effective, highly available, and scalable storage solutions.

zh.tag: 英特尔开源 AI 推理优化与部署工具包
zh.what: OpenVINO 是一个开源工具包，用于优化和部署深度学习模型，提升推理性能。它支持多种主流框架（如 PyTorch、TensorFlow、ONNX）的模型转换与部署，并覆盖从边缘到云的多种硬件平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎、模型优化工具、文档、教程以及 Python/C++/Node.js 等语言的 API 绑定。还提供与 Hugging Face Optimum Intel 的集成，便于直接部署 transformers 和 diffusers 模型。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、C++、Node.js 等 API。依赖 CMake、ONNX、TensorFlow 等，并支持 Intel CPU、GPU、NPU 等硬件加速。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 推理需求激增，OpenVINO 作为成熟的优化工具持续获得关注。今日新增 12 星，总星数达 10726，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 4，体现其在开发者社区中的稳定热度。
uses: AI 应用开发者：优化模型推理性能，降低延迟和资源消耗。
边缘计算工程师：在资源受限的设备上高效部署深度学习模型。
研究学者：快速将 PyTorch/TensorFlow 模型转换并部署到多种硬件。
企业团队：利用 OpenVINO 实现从云端到边缘的统一推理方案。

en.tag: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
en.what: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models, boosting inference performance. It supports model conversion and deployment from popular frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and ONNX, and runs on a wide range of platforms from edge to cloud.
en.content: The repository contains the core inference engine, model optimization tools, documentation, tutorials, and API bindings for Python, C++, and Node.js. It also integrates with Hugging Face Optimum Intel for direct deployment of transformers and diffusers models.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with APIs for Python, C++, and Node.js. It relies on CMake, ONNX, TensorFlow, and supports acceleration on Intel CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs.
en.hot: With the surge in AI inference demand, OpenVINO remains a mature optimization tool. Gaining 12 stars today, it reached 10,726 total stars and ranked 4th on the C++ trending list, reflecting steady popularity among developers.
uses: AI app developers: optimize model inference performance, reducing latency and resource usage.
Edge computing engineers: efficiently deploy deep learning models on resource-constrained devices.
Researchers: quickly convert and deploy PyTorch/TensorFlow models across various hardware.
Enterprise teams: leverage OpenVINO for unified inference solutions from cloud to edge.

zh.tag: 一站式 3D 高斯泼溅工作站
zh.what: LichtFeld Studio 是一个原生的模块化工作站，用于训练、检查、编辑、自动化和导出 3D 高斯泼溅场景。它整合了模型训练、实时可视化、高斯编辑、导出、插件和自动化于一个工具链中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心、GUI 可视化器、Python 插件系统、MCP 支持、文档和示例资源。提供 Windows 下载和源码构建指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 构建，集成 Python 插件和 MCP 协议，支持 COLMAP 数据集和 3D 高斯泼溅技术。
zh.hot: 本周新增 62 星，总星数达 3627，在 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜排名第四。因其一站式解决 3D 高斯泼溅全流程而受到关注。
uses: 3D 重建研究人员和开发者，需要训练和编辑高斯泼溅模型。
视觉特效和游戏开发者，需要导出高质量 3D 场景。
自动化工作流爱好者，希望通过 MCP 或 Python 插件扩展功能。

en.tag: All-in-one workstation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
en.what: LichtFeld Studio is a native modular workstation for training, inspecting, editing, automating, and exporting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. It combines model training, real-time visualization, gaussian editing, export, plugins, and automation into one toolchain.
en.content: The repository includes a C++ core, GUI visualizer, Python plugin system, MCP support, documentation, and sample assets. Offers Windows downloads and build-from-source instructions.
en.stack: Primarily built with C++, integrates Python plugins and MCP protocol, supports COLMAP datasets and 3D Gaussian Splatting.
en.hot: Gained 62 stars this week, reaching 3627 total, ranking #4 on GitHub Trending C++ weekly. It attracts attention for its all-in-one workflow for 3D Gaussian Splatting.
uses: 3D reconstruction researchers and developers needing to train and edit Gaussian Splatting models.
VFX and game developers needing to export high-quality 3D scenes.
Automation enthusiasts wanting to extend functionality via MCP or Python plugins.

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流主机，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务器，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将游戏从自己的电脑远程串流到其他设备，无需依赖第三方云服务。支持低延迟、高画质的游戏体验，并可通过 Web 界面进行配置。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Sunshine 源代码、构建脚本、Docker 镜像配置、文档以及用于 Web UI 的前端资源。项目采用 C++ 编写，并附带多种安装方式（如 Docker、Flatpak、Winget）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA/NVENC、AMF 等硬件编码库，以及 WebSocket 和 HTTP 服务器库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 随着云游戏和远程办公需求增长，自托管串流方案备受青睐。Sunshine 拥有 4 万+ Star，本周新增 265，持续活跃，社区生态完善。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到客厅电视、手机或平板，享受低延迟体验。
远程工作者：通过 Moonlight 客户端远程访问工作站，进行图形密集型任务。
自托管爱好者：搭建完全自主可控的串流服务器，摆脱商业云服务限制。

en.tag: Self-hosted game stream host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It lets users stream games from their own PC to other devices remotely without relying on third-party cloud services. It offers low-latency, high-quality gameplay and can be configured via a web interface.
en.content: The repository contains the full Sunshine source code, build scripts, Docker image configurations, documentation, and frontend assets for the web UI. The project is written in C++ and offers multiple installation methods (e.g., Docker, Flatpak, Winget).
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on FFmpeg, CUDA/NVENC, AMF for hardware encoding, and WebSocket/HTTP server libraries. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: With the rise of cloud gaming and remote work, self-hosted streaming solutions are in demand. Sunshine has 40k+ stars, adding 265 this week, and remains highly active with a mature community.
uses: Gamers: Stream PC games to living room TVs, phones, or tablets with low latency.
Remote workers: Access workstations remotely via Moonlight client for graphics-intensive tasks.
Self-hosting enthusiasts: Build a fully controlled streaming server, free from commercial cloud constraints.

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整源代码、文档、扩展机制以及多种客户端（Python、R、Java、Wasm 等）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Python 3 等开发环境。
zh.hot: 作为进程内分析数据库的标杆，DuckDB 凭借其极简部署和高性能查询，在数据科学领域迅速走红，star 数已突破 4 万，今日新增 69 个。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师，希望在 Python 或 R 环境中快速分析大型数据集，无需单独部署数据库服务器。
数据工程师，需要将 CSV/Parquet 文件直接作为 SQL 查询源，简化数据管道。
应用开发者，希望嵌入分析能力到现有应用中，提供轻量级 OLAP 功能。

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database, blazing fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect including complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, extension mechanisms, and integrations for multiple clients (Python, R, Java, Wasm, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++17, built with CMake, and supports Python 3 for development.
en.hot: As a benchmark for in-process analytical databases, DuckDB has gained rapid popularity in data science due to its minimal deployment and high-performance queries, with over 40k stars and 69 new today.
uses: Data scientists and analysts who want to quickly analyze large datasets in Python or R without deploying a separate database server.
Data engineers who need to query CSV/Parquet files directly as SQL sources to simplify data pipelines.
Application developers who want to embed analytical capabilities into existing applications for lightweight OLAP functionality.

zh.tag: AI视频超分辨率与补帧工具
zh.what: Video2X 是一个基于机器学习的视频超分辨率和帧插值框架，能够提升视频分辨率和帧率。它支持多种算法，如 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN 等，并提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C/C++ 重写的核心库、Windows 安装程序、Linux 支持、GUI 界面以及文档。
zh.stack: 基于 C/C++，利用 ncnn 和 Vulkan 加速，支持 Anime4K、Real-ESRGAN、Real-CUGAN 和 RIFE 模型。
zh.hot: 6.0 版本完全重写，性能大幅提升，跨平台支持，且今日新增 174 星，登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 动漫爱好者提升老番画质，享受高清视觉体验。
视频创作者对素材进行超分和补帧，提升作品质量。
研究人员测试不同超分算法效果，进行对比实验。

en.tag: AI-powered video upscaling and frame interpolation tool
en.what: Video2X is a machine learning-based framework for video super-resolution and frame interpolation, enhancing video resolution and frame rate. It supports algorithms like Anime4K and Real-ESRGAN, with both GUI and CLI.
en.content: The repository includes a C/C++ rewritten core library, Windows installer, Linux support, GUI, and documentation.
en.stack: Built with C/C++, accelerated via ncnn and Vulkan, supporting Anime4K, Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, and RIFE models.
en.hot: Version 6.0 is a complete rewrite with significant performance gains and cross-platform support, gaining 174 stars today and trending in C++.
uses: Anime fans upscale old shows for a high-definition viewing experience.
Video creators enhance footage with super-resolution and frame interpolation to improve quality.
Researchers test and compare different super-resolution algorithms for experiments.

zh.tag: 单卡极限推理引擎，专为精选Qwen模型打造
zh.what: NInfer 是一个从零开始用 C++/CUDA 编写的高性能推理引擎，专门在单张 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上运行精选的 Qwen 模型检查点。它支持文本、图像和视频提示，通过本地 CLI 或兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 HTTP API 提供服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎源码、预转换的 NInfer 模型工件（如 Qwen3.6-27B 等），以及性能基准测试数据。
zh.stack: 基于 C++/CUDA，利用 Tensor Core MMA、CUDA Graphs 和 MTP3 等技术实现极致性能。
zh.hot: 本周新增 269 星，登顶 C++ 周榜，因其在单卡上实现接近硬件极限的推理速度，吸引追求极致性能的开发者。
uses: 在 RTX 5090 上运行 Qwen3.6/3.8 系列模型，追求最高吞吐量的 AI 应用开发者。
需要本地部署多模态模型（文本/图像/视频）并兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic API 的工程师。
对 CUDA 优化和推理引擎设计感兴趣的研究者，可参考其实现。

en.tag: Single-GPU inference engine for selected Qwen checkpoints
en.what: NInfer is a from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine for explicitly registered Qwen checkpoints on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090. It runs text, image, and video prompts through a local CLI or OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible HTTP APIs.
en.content: The repository contains engine source code, pre-converted NInfer model artifacts (e.g., Qwen3.6-27B), and performance benchmarks.
en.stack: Built with C++/CUDA, leveraging Tensor Core MMA, CUDA Graphs, and MTP3 for extreme performance.
en.hot: Gained 269 stars this week, topping the C++ weekly chart, due to its near-hardware-limit inference speed on a single GPU, attracting performance-focused developers.
uses: AI developers running Qwen3.6/3.8 models on RTX 5090 seeking maximum throughput.
Engineers deploying multimodal models locally with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs.
Researchers interested in CUDA optimization and inference engine design.

zh.tag: 用 QtQuick 打造 Wayland/X11 桌面外壳的灵活工具包
zh.what: Quickshell 是一个用于创建桌面外壳（如任务栏、启动器、小部件）的工具包，基于 QtQuick 技术。它支持 Wayland 和 X11 显示服务器，提供灵活的 API 和组件，让开发者能够快速构建自定义桌面环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Quickshell 的源代码、构建脚本（BUILD.md）、开发指南（HACKING.md）和贡献政策（CONTRIBUTING.md）。项目采用 C++ 编写，并依赖 QtQuick 和 Qt 框架。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 QtQuick（QML），依赖 Qt 库。支持 Wayland 和 X11 协议，可能涉及 compositor 相关技术。
zh.hot: 随着 Linux 桌面自定义需求的增长，Quickshell 提供了现代化的桌面外壳开发方案。本周新增 90 星，总星数达 2897，在 GitHub Trending 周榜（C++）中排名第 11，显示出社区对灵活桌面工具的兴趣。
uses: Linux 桌面开发者：希望创建自定义桌面外壳或小部件，替代传统面板和启动器。
Wayland 爱好者：需要兼容 Wayland 协议的桌面组件，用于构建现代桌面环境。
Qt/QML 开发者：熟悉 QtQuick 技术，希望扩展其应用场景到桌面外壳领域。

en.tag: Flexible toolkit for building desktop shells with QtQuick on Wayland and X11
en.what: Quickshell is a toolkit for creating desktop shells (such as panels, launchers, and widgets) using QtQuick. It supports both Wayland and X11 display servers, offering flexible APIs and components for developers to quickly build custom desktop environments.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of Quickshell, along with build instructions (BUILD.md), development guidelines (HACKING.md), and contribution policies (CONTRIBUTING.md). The project is written in C++ and relies on QtQuick and Qt frameworks.
en.stack: Primarily uses C++ and QtQuick (QML), depending on Qt libraries. Supports Wayland and X11 protocols, possibly involving compositor-related technologies.
en.hot: With the growing demand for Linux desktop customization, Quickshell offers a modern solution for desktop shell development. Gaining 90 stars this week to reach 2897 total, it ranks 11th on GitHub Trending (C++) weekly, reflecting community interest in flexible desktop tools.
uses: Linux desktop developers: aiming to create custom desktop shells or widgets, replacing traditional panels and launchers.
Wayland enthusiasts: needing desktop components compatible with Wayland protocol for building modern desktop environments.
Qt/QML developers: familiar with QtQuick technology, seeking to extend its use to desktop shell development.

zh.tag: Telegram 官方桌面客户端，跨平台消息应用
zh.what: 这是 Telegram 官方桌面客户端的完整源代码，基于 Telegram API 和 MTProto 安全协议构建。它提供了消息收发、语音通话、文件共享等核心功能，并支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、构建说明、多平台安装包（Windows、macOS、Linux）以及旧版本兼容信息。还列出了第三方依赖如 Qt、OpenSSL 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 框架，依赖 OpenSSL、WebRTC、zlib 等库，支持 CMake 构建。
zh.hot: 作为 Telegram 官方桌面客户端，拥有 3.2 万星标，持续维护，是跨平台消息应用的重要参考实现。
uses: 开发者可学习大型 C++ 跨平台应用的架构与构建流程。
用户可下载官方客户端，享受安全、快速的即时通讯服务。
对 MTProto 协议感兴趣的开发者可研究其实现细节。

en.tag: Official Telegram desktop client, cross-platform messaging app
en.what: This is the complete source code of the official Telegram desktop client, built on the Telegram API and MTProto secure protocol. It offers messaging, voice calls, file sharing, and more, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.content: The repo contains full source code, build instructions, multi-platform installers (Windows, macOS, Linux), and legacy version compatibility info. Third-party dependencies like Qt and OpenSSL are listed.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with Qt framework, depends on OpenSSL, WebRTC, zlib, and others, built with CMake.
en.hot: As the official Telegram desktop client, it has 32k+ stars, actively maintained, and serves as a key reference for cross-platform messaging apps.
uses: Developers can learn architecture and build process of large-scale C++ cross-platform apps.
Users can download the official client for secure and fast instant messaging.
Developers interested in MTProto protocol can study its implementation details.

zh.tag: 开源软件KVM，一套键鼠控制多台电脑
zh.what: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键鼠共享应用，让你用一台电脑的键盘、鼠标或触控板控制附近的多台电脑，实现无缝切换。它相当于一个软件 KVM（不含视频），默认启用 TLS 加密，支持 Wayland 和剪贴板共享。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、安装包生成配置（如 Windows、macOS、Linux 及 Flathub），以及详细的 README 文档和社区讨论链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Qt 等跨平台库，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Wayland。
zh.hot: 作为 Synergy 的开源继任者，Deskflow 在 2.8 万星基础上持续增长，本周新增 173 星，位列 C++ 周榜第 12。其免费开源、支持 TLS 和 Wayland 的特性吸引了大量寻求替代方案的用户。
uses: 多机办公用户：在台式机和笔记本之间共享键鼠，提升效率。
跨平台开发者：在 Windows、macOS、Linux 间无缝切换，统一操作。
开源爱好者：寻找 Synergy 的免费替代品，并参与社区贡献。

en.tag: Open-source software KVM to share one keyboard/mouse across computers
en.what: Deskflow is a free and open-source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you control nearby computers using the keyboard, mouse, or trackpad of one machine. It acts as a software KVM (without video), with TLS encryption enabled by default, Wayland support, and clipboard sharing.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code, build scripts, packaging configurations for Windows/macOS/Linux and Flathub, plus detailed README and community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, leveraging cross-platform libraries like Qt, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, and Wayland.
en.hot: As an open-source successor to Synergy, Deskflow has amassed over 28k stars and continues to grow, adding 173 stars this week and ranking #12 on the C++ weekly trending. Its free, open-source nature with TLS and Wayland support attracts users seeking an alternative.
uses: Multi-machine office workers: share keyboard/mouse between desktop and laptop for efficiency.
Cross-platform developers: seamlessly switch between Windows, macOS, Linux with unified control.
Open-source enthusiasts: seeking a free alternative to Synergy and contributing to the community.

zh.tag: 原生高性能桌面命令面板，支持 Raycast 生态扩展
zh.what: Vicinae 是一个面向桌面的原生命令面板，提供应用搜索、剪贴板历史、文本扩展、文件搜索、浏览器标签切换、表情选择、计算器、窗口切换等功能。它支持通过 React/TypeScript 扩展、脚本命令和 dmenu 风格菜单进行扩展，兼容 Raycast 生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心源码、文档（docs 目录）、扩展示例、截图和品牌资源。项目采用模块化设计，支持通过 Vicinae 商店和 Raycast 商店安装扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，扩展支持 React/TypeScript，兼容 Raycast 扩展 API。依赖包括 CMake、Node.js 等构建工具。
zh.hot: 凭借 9130 颗星和今日新增 77 颗，Vicinae 在 C++ 日榜排名第 12。其原生性能与 Raycast 生态兼容性吸引开发者，成为桌面效率工具的热门选择。
uses: 桌面用户寻求快速启动应用、搜索文件和管理剪贴板的一体化工具
开发者希望使用 React/TypeScript 构建自定义扩展，并复用 Raycast 生态
Linux 用户偏好 dmenu 风格的轻量级菜单交互

en.tag: Native high-performance desktop command palette with Raycast-compatible extensions
en.what: Vicinae is a native command palette for the desktop, offering app search, clipboard history, text expansion, file search, browser tab switching, emoji picking, calculator, and window switching. It can be extended via React/TypeScript extensions, script commands, and dmenu-style menus, compatible with the Raycast ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains C++ core source code, documentation (docs directory), extension examples, screenshots, and branding assets. The project is modular, supporting extensions from both the Vicinae store and the Raycast store.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with extensions in React/TypeScript, compatible with Raycast's extension API. Build dependencies include CMake, Node.js, etc.
en.hot: With 9,130 stars and 77 added today, Vicinae ranks #12 on the C++ daily trending list. Its native performance and Raycast ecosystem compatibility attract developers, making it a popular desktop productivity tool.
uses: Desktop users seeking an all-in-one tool for quick app launching, file search, and clipboard management
Developers who want to build custom extensions with React/TypeScript and reuse the Raycast ecosystem
Linux users who prefer dmenu-style lightweight menu interactions

zh.tag: 本地 AI 服务器，让 GPU/NPU 秒变云端 API
zh.what: Lemonade 是一个本地 AI 服务器，提供与云端 API 相同的功能，但完全免费且私密。它支持在自有 NPU 和 GPU 上运行最新的聊天、编程、语音和图像生成模型。
zh.content: 包含 Lemonade Server（可连接数百个应用的服务）和 Embeddable Lemonade（可嵌入应用的可移植二进制文件），提供模型管理器、内置聊天/图像/语音界面，以及 Windows、Linux、macOS、Docker 和移动端支持。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 构建，针对 AMD Ryzen AI、Radeon 和 Strix Halo 进行了优化，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Ollama 标准 API。
zh.hot: 凭借 5532 颗星和今日新增 15 星，Lemonade 在 C++ 趋势榜上排名第三，其免费、私密且高性能的本地 AI 方案吸引了大量关注。
uses: 希望在不牺牲隐私的前提下使用最新 AI 模型的个人开发者
需要将多模态 AI 集成到应用中的软件团队
寻求在自有硬件上运行 AI 以减少云成本的企业用户
对本地 AI 优化和硬件加速感兴趣的爱好者

en.tag: Local AI server turning your GPU/NPU into cloud-grade APIs
en.what: Lemonade is a local AI server that offers cloud-API capabilities, 100% free and private. It runs the latest models for chat, coding, speech, and image generation on your own NPU and GPU.
en.content: Includes Lemonade Server (a service for connecting to hundreds of apps) and Embeddable Lemonade (a portable binary for embedding), with a model manager, built-in chat/image/speech interfaces, and support for Windows, Linux, macOS, Docker, and mobile.
en.stack: Built in C++, optimized for AMD Ryzen AI, Radeon, and Strix Halo, supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama standard APIs.
en.hot: With 5,532 stars and 15 added today, Lemonade ranks #3 on the C++ trending list, attracting attention for its free, private, and high-performance local AI solution.
uses: Individual developers wanting to use the latest AI models without sacrificing privacy
Software teams needing to integrate multimodal AI into their applications
Enterprise users seeking to run AI on their own hardware to reduce cloud costs
Enthusiasts interested in local AI optimization and hardware acceleration

zh.tag: 开源重制经典过山车大亨2，延续游乐场经营乐趣
zh.what: OpenRCT2 是经典模拟经营游戏《过山车大亨2》的开源重制版，旨在让这款经典游戏在现代系统上继续运行并增强体验。它保留了原作的玩法和内容，同时修复了 bug、增加了新功能，并支持跨平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的游戏引擎、资源管理、多人游戏支持、场景编辑器以及本地化文件。项目采用模块化结构，包含源代码、构建脚本、文档和翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SDL2、OpenGL 等库，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。构建系统采用 CMake，并利用 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 凭借怀旧情怀和持续更新，OpenRCT2 在经典游戏粉丝中保持高人气，本周新增 64 星，总星数达 16170，位列 C++ 周榜第 16 名。
uses: 经典游戏爱好者：希望在现代设备上重温《过山车大亨2》的玩家。
模组开发者：想为游戏添加新内容或修改机制的开发者。
游戏本地化贡献者：参与翻译和社区维护的志愿者。

en.tag: Open-source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, preserving the classic park management fun
en.what: OpenRCT2 is an open-source re-implementation of the classic construction and management simulation game RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, aiming to keep the game playable on modern systems with enhanced features. It preserves the original gameplay and content while fixing bugs, adding new features, and supporting cross-platform play.
en.content: The repository contains the full game engine, asset management, multiplayer support, scenario editor, and localization files. The project is modular, including source code, build scripts, documentation, and translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on libraries such as SDL2 and OpenGL, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. The build system uses CMake, with GitHub Actions for continuous integration.
en.hot: With nostalgia and continuous updates, OpenRCT2 remains highly popular among classic game fans, gaining 64 stars this week and reaching 16,170 total stars, ranking 16th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Classic game fans: players who want to relive RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 on modern devices.
Mod developers: developers who want to add new content or modify game mechanics.
Localization contributors: volunteers who participate in translation and community maintenance.

zh.tag: MySQL 社区分支，功能丰富且兼容的开源关系型数据库
zh.what: MariaDB 是一个由 MySQL 原核心团队发起的开源关系型数据库，是 MySQL 的分支，保持高度兼容性，同时提供更多原生功能。它广泛应用于从小型应用到大规模生产系统的工作负载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MariaDB 服务器的完整源代码，包括存储引擎（InnoDB、Aria、MyRocks 等）、复制与集群模块、SQL 解析器、向量搜索支持，以及构建和测试框架。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 MySQL 兼容的客户端协议，支持多种存储引擎，并集成 HNSW 索引等现代特性。
zh.hot: 作为 MySQL 的流行替代品，MariaDB 持续获得关注，今日新增 7 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 12 名，其原生向量搜索等新特性吸引了开发者。
uses: 需要从 MySQL 迁移且希望获得更多功能的企业级应用开发者
对原生向量搜索和多种存储引擎感兴趣的数据工程师
构建高可用集群或需要同步多主复制的系统架构师
学习数据库内部实现和参与开源贡献的开发者

en.tag: Community-developed MySQL fork, feature-rich and compatible open-source relational database
en.what: MariaDB is an open-source relational database, a fork of MySQL initiated by the original core team, maintaining high compatibility while offering additional native features. It powers workloads from small applications to large-scale production systems.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the MariaDB server, including storage engines (InnoDB, Aria, MyRocks, etc.), replication and clustering modules, SQL parser, vector search support, and build and test frameworks.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on MySQL-compatible client protocol, supports multiple storage engines, and integrates modern features like HNSW indexing.
en.hot: As a popular MySQL alternative, MariaDB continues to gain attention, with 7 stars today, ranking 12th on the C++ trending list, and its native vector search and other new features attract developers.
uses: Enterprise developers migrating from MySQL and seeking more features
Data engineers interested in native vector search and multiple storage engines
System architects building high-availability clusters or needing synchronous multi-primary replication
Developers learning database internals and contributing to open source

zh.tag: CUDA 高性能线性代数模板库与 Python DSL
zh.what: CUTLASS 是 NVIDIA 开源的 CUDA 抽象集合，用于实现高性能矩阵乘法（GEMM）及相关计算，覆盖从底层硬件到上层应用的所有层级。它提供分层分解和数据移动策略，将复杂内核拆解为可复用的模块化组件，并支持多种数据类型和架构。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 模板库、CuTe DSL（Python 领域特定语言）、示例代码（如 GEMM 分解图）以及针对 Volta 到 Blackwell 架构的优化内核。
zh.stack: 基于 CUDA C++ 模板，支持 FP64/FP32/TF32/FP16/BF16/FP8/块缩放/窄整数/二进制等数据类型，并集成 Python DSL（CuTe DSL）以简化开发。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方高性能计算库，CUTLASS 是 GPU 内核开发的基石，star 数超 1 万，今日新增 7 星，排名 C++ 日榜第五，持续受到性能工程师和 AI 研究者的关注。
uses: GPU 性能工程师：用于优化深度学习推理和训练中的矩阵运算，提升效率。
AI 研究人员：借助 CuTe DSL 快速原型设计新内核，无需深入 C++ 细节。
学生与教育者：学习 CUDA 编程和 GPU 架构的绝佳资源，降低入门门槛。
框架开发者：集成到 PyTorch 等框架中，无需编写胶水代码即可获得高性能内核。

en.tag: CUDA templates & Python DSLs for high-performance linear algebra
en.what: CUTLASS is NVIDIA's open-source collection of CUDA abstractions for high-performance matrix multiplication (GEMM) and related computations across all levels and scales. It decomposes complex kernels into reusable modular components with hierarchical decomposition and data movement strategies, supporting diverse data types and architectures.
en.content: The repo contains C++ template library, CuTe DSL (Python domain-specific language), examples (e.g., GEMM decomposition diagram), and optimized kernels for Volta to Blackwell architectures.
en.stack: Built on CUDA C++ templates, supporting FP64/FP32/TF32/FP16/BF16/FP8/block-scaled/narrow-int/binary data types, with Python DSL (CuTe DSL) for simplified development.
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official high-performance computing library, CUTLASS is a cornerstone for GPU kernel development, with 10k+ stars and 7 new today, ranking #5 on C++ daily trending, consistently attracting performance engineers and AI researchers.
uses: GPU performance engineers: optimize matrix operations in deep learning inference and training for higher efficiency.
AI researchers: leverage CuTe DSL for rapid prototyping of new kernels without deep C++ expertise.
Students and educators: an excellent resource for learning CUDA programming and GPU architecture, lowering the entry barrier.
Framework developers: integrate into frameworks like PyTorch to obtain high-performance kernels without glue code.

zh.tag: 极简 Markdown 写作应用，自动跟随系统深色模式
zh.what: Omawrite 是一款极简的 Markdown 写作应用，基于 Qt Quick 和 C++ 构建，自动跟随系统的深色/浅色模式。它提供专注的写作环境，支持快捷键操作、自动恢复未保存草稿、外部文件变更提醒等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Qt Quick 应用源码，包括 QML 界面、C++ 后端、键盘快捷键处理、文件监视、主题切换逻辑，以及捆绑的 iA Writer Mono 字体（SIL OFL 许可）。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 C++ 和 Qt 6（qt6-base、qt6-declarative、qt6-quickcontrols2），依赖 xdg-desktop-portal 进行文件对话框和打印等系统集成。
zh.hot: 尽管 star 数不高（177），但今日新增 9 星并登上 C++ 日榜，可能因其极简设计和与 Omarchy 发行版的集成而受到关注。
uses: 喜欢极简、无干扰写作环境的 Markdown 用户
使用 Omarchy 或类似 Linux 发行版、希望开箱即用的写作工具的用户
对 Qt Quick 和 C++ 开发感兴趣的开发者，可学习其架构

en.tag: A dead-simple Markdown writing app with Qt Quick and C++ that follows system dark/light mode
en.what: Omawrite is a dead-simple Markdown writing app built with Qt Quick and C++. It automatically follows the system's dark/light mode, offering a distraction-free writing environment with keyboard shortcuts, automatic recovery of unsaved drafts, and warnings before external file changes.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Qt Quick app, including QML UI, C++ backend, keyboard shortcut handling, file watching, theme switching logic, and the bundled iA Writer Mono font (under SIL OFL).
en.stack: Tech stack is C++ with Qt 6 (qt6-base, qt6-declarative, qt6-quickcontrols2), relying on xdg-desktop-portal for system integration like file pickers and printing.
en.hot: Despite modest stars (177), it gained 9 stars today and hit #6 on the C++ daily trending, likely due to its minimal design and integration with the Omarchy distribution.
uses: Markdown writers who prefer a minimal, distraction-free writing environment
Users on Omarchy or similar Linux distros who want a pre-installed writing tool
Developers interested in Qt Quick and C++ who want to study its architecture

zh.tag: 1-bit 大模型官方推理框架，CPU/GPU 高效部署
zh.what: BitNet 是微软推出的 1-bit 大语言模型（LLM）官方推理框架，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行 BitNet b1.58 等极低比特模型。它通过优化的内核和量化技术，显著降低内存占用和计算成本，使大模型能在普通硬件上快速推理。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理引擎（C++ 实现）、CPU 和 GPU 优化内核、模型转换工具、示例代码及文档，并提供了 Hugging Face 模型集合和在线演示。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 BLAS、OpenMP 等，支持 x86 (AVX2) 和 ARM (NEON) 架构，GPU 内核基于 CUDA。
zh.hot: BitNet 突破了传统 LLM 的内存瓶颈，以 1-bit 量化实现接近全精度的性能，在 GitHub 上获得 4 万+ star，成为低比特推理的标杆项目。
uses: 在边缘设备或 CPU 上部署大语言模型，如智能终端、嵌入式系统
需要低成本、低功耗推理的 AI 应用，如实时语音识别（ASR）
研究低比特量化技术或进行模型压缩的学者与开发者
构建隐私敏感或离线场景下的本地 AI 助手

en.tag: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, efficient on CPU/GPU
en.what: BitNet is Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, enabling efficient deployment of ultra-low-bit models like BitNet b1.58 on both CPU and GPU. It leverages optimized kernels and quantization to drastically reduce memory footprint and compute cost, making large models run fast on commodity hardware.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference engine (C++), optimized CPU/GPU kernels, model conversion tools, examples, and documentation, along with Hugging Face model collections and an online demo.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on BLAS, OpenMP, etc., supporting x86 (AVX2) and ARM (NEON), and GPU kernels based on CUDA.
en.hot: BitNet breaks the memory bottleneck of traditional LLMs, achieving near-full-precision performance with 1-bit quantization, amassing 40k+ stars on GitHub as a benchmark for low-bit inference.
uses: Deploying LLMs on edge devices or CPUs, such as smart terminals and embedded systems
AI applications requiring low-cost, low-power inference, like real-time speech recognition (ASR)
Researchers and developers studying low-bit quantization or model compression
Building local AI assistants for privacy-sensitive or offline scenarios

zh.tag: 基于 rizin 的免费开源逆向工程平台
zh.what: Cutter 是一个由逆向工程师为逆向工程师打造的免费开源逆向工程平台，基于 rizin 引擎，提供高级且可定制的逆向分析功能，同时注重用户体验。它支持多种架构和文件格式，集成了反汇编、反编译、调试等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cutter 的完整源代码、构建脚本、文档（用户指南、贡献指南、开发者文档）、Docker 配置，以及支持 Python 和 C++ 插件的接口。还集成了 Ghidra 反编译器等社区插件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Qt 构建图形界面，核心分析引擎基于 rizin（C 语言编写）。支持 Python 插件，并可选集成 Ghidra 反编译器。
zh.hot: 作为免费开源的逆向工程平台，Cutter 在安全研究社区广受欢迎，拥有近 2 万星标，本周新增 91 星，持续活跃。其易用性和强大的 rizin 后端使其成为商业工具的流行替代品。
uses: 安全研究人员分析恶意软件、漏洞研究和二进制审计
逆向工程师进行软件破解、协议逆向和固件分析
CTF 玩家用于解题和逆向挑战
开发人员学习汇编语言和程序内部工作原理

en.tag: Free & open-source reverse engineering platform powered by rizin
en.what: Cutter is a free and open-source reverse engineering platform powered by rizin, created by reverse engineers for reverse engineers. It aims to be an advanced and customizable RE platform while keeping user experience in mind, offering disassembly, decompilation, debugging, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, build scripts, documentation (user guide, contribution guidelines, developer docs), Docker configuration, and plugin interfaces for Python and C++ plugins. It also integrates community plugins like the Ghidra decompiler.
en.stack: Built primarily with C++ and Qt for the GUI, with the core analysis engine based on rizin (written in C). Supports Python plugins and optional integration with the Ghidra decompiler.
en.hot: As a free and open-source reverse engineering platform, Cutter is widely popular in the security research community, with nearly 20k stars and 91 new stars this week, remaining highly active. Its ease of use and powerful rizin backend make it a popular alternative to commercial tools.
uses: Security researchers analyzing malware, vulnerability research, and binary auditing
Reverse engineers performing software cracking, protocol reversing, and firmware analysis
CTF players solving challenges and reverse engineering tasks
Developers learning assembly language and how programs work internally

zh.tag: 跨平台实时物理渲染引擎，轻量高效
zh.what: Filament 是 Google 开发的实时物理渲染引擎，支持 Android、iOS、Linux、macOS、Windows 和 WebGL2。它专为 Android 优化，力求体积最小、效率最高，同时提供跨平台一致的渲染质量。
zh.content: 仓库包含渲染引擎的核心源码、构建脚本、示例应用，以及用于生成资产的主机端工具（如材质编译器 matc）。提供 Maven 依赖和预编译发布包，方便集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持 Vulkan、OpenGL 和 Metal 后端。提供 Java/Kotlin (Android)、JavaScript (Web) 等语言的绑定，依赖 CMake 构建系统。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方维护的高性能渲染引擎，Filament 在跨平台移动端和桌面端都有广泛应用，star 数已超 2 万，今日新增 6 星，稳居 C++ 趋势榜前列。
uses: 移动应用开发者：在 Android/iOS 上实现高质量 3D 渲染，如地图、游戏或 AR 应用。
桌面与 Web 开发者：利用同一套代码在 Windows、Linux、macOS 及浏览器中渲染 3D 场景。
图形学研究者：学习实时物理渲染的实现，或基于 Filament 扩展自定义渲染特性。
产品可视化：为电商、建筑或工业设计构建逼真的产品预览和交互展示。

en.tag: Cross-platform real-time PBR rendering engine, lightweight and efficient
en.what: Filament is a real-time physically based rendering engine developed by Google, supporting Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Windows, and WebGL2. It is optimized for Android, aiming to be as small and efficient as possible while delivering consistent rendering quality across platforms.
en.content: The repository contains the core rendering engine source code, build scripts, sample apps, and host-side tools for asset generation (e.g., material compiler matc). It offers Maven dependencies and prebuilt release archives for easy integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with support for Vulkan, OpenGL, and Metal backends. Provides bindings for Java/Kotlin (Android) and JavaScript (Web), and uses CMake as the build system.
en.hot: As an officially maintained high-performance rendering engine by Google, Filament is widely used across mobile and desktop platforms. With over 20k stars and 6 new stars today, it consistently ranks high on the C++ trending list.
uses: Mobile app developers: Achieve high-quality 3D rendering on Android/iOS for maps, games, or AR apps.
Desktop and web developers: Render 3D scenes on Windows, Linux, macOS, and browsers with a single codebase.
Graphics researchers: Study real-time PBR implementation or extend Filament with custom rendering features.
Product visualization: Build realistic product previews and interactive showcases for e-commerce, architecture, or industrial design.

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: 通用物理仿真引擎，机器人/强化学习核心工具
zh.what: MuJoCo 是一个用于多关节动力学与接触仿真的通用物理引擎，旨在为机器人、生物力学、图形动画和机器学习等领域提供快速准确的仿真。它支持 C API，并附带 Python 绑定和 Unity 插件。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 仿真库、交互式可视化 GUI（OpenGL）、Python 绑定、Unity 插件、文档和教程（如 Colab 笔记本）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenGL 进行渲染，提供 Python 绑定（通过 PyPI）和 Unity 插件。
zh.hot: 作为强化学习和机器人领域广泛使用的物理引擎，MuJoCo 持续获得关注，本周新增 160 星，总星数达 14801，位居 C++ 趋势榜第 25 名。
uses: 机器人研究者：用于验证控制算法和进行仿真训练，如强化学习环境。
生物力学与动画开发者：模拟人体或动物运动，用于研究和视觉特效。
机器学习工程师：作为环境模拟器，用于训练和评估智能体。
游戏开发者：通过 Unity 插件集成物理仿真，提升游戏真实感。

en.tag: General-purpose physics engine for robotics, biomechanics, and ML
en.what: MuJoCo is a general-purpose physics engine for multi-joint dynamics with contact, designed to facilitate research in robotics, biomechanics, graphics, and machine learning. It provides a C API, Python bindings, and a Unity plugin.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ simulation library, interactive visualization GUI (OpenGL), Python bindings, Unity plugin, documentation, and tutorials (e.g., Colab notebooks).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, uses OpenGL for rendering, offers Python bindings (via PyPI) and a Unity plugin.
en.hot: As a widely-used physics engine in reinforcement learning and robotics, MuJoCo continues to gain attention, adding 160 stars this week to reach 14,801 total, ranking 25th on the C++ trending list.
uses: Robotics researchers: for validating control algorithms and simulation-based training, e.g., reinforcement learning environments.
Biomechanics and animation developers: to simulate human or animal motion for research and visual effects.
Machine learning engineers: as an environment simulator to train and evaluate agents.
Game developers: to integrate physics simulation via the Unity plugin for enhanced realism.

zh.tag: 超快 Rust PDF 检测与文本提取库
zh.what: pdf-inspector 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能 PDF 处理库，能快速检测 PDF 是扫描版还是文本版，并提取带位置信息的文本，转换为干净的 Markdown。它内置智能分类功能，可在几十毫秒内判断 PDF 类型，并支持选择性 OCR，从而避免不必要的昂贵 OCR 服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库、Python/Node.js 绑定、浏览器 WebAssembly 版本，以及 CLI 工具。提供文本提取、Markdown 转换、表格检测、多栏布局处理、CID 字体支持等功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust，依赖 PDFium 和 ONNX Runtime（用于 OCR），支持 Python、Node.js 和 WebAssembly。OCR 集成使用 PP-OCRv6 Small 模型。
zh.hot: 本月新增 15341 星，总星数达 17007，位居 GitHub 趋势榜第二。其极快的速度和智能分类能力解决了 PDF 处理中的痛点，且由 Firecrawl 团队开发，信誉度高。
uses: 开发者需要快速将 PDF 转换为 Markdown 或提取文本，用于 RAG 或数据管道。
处理大量 PDF 的文档管理系统，需要区分扫描件和文本件以优化流程。
需要本地化、低延迟 PDF 解析的浏览器应用或边缘计算场景。

en.tag: Ultra-fast Rust library for PDF inspection and text extraction
en.what: pdf-inspector is a high-performance Rust library for PDF processing that quickly detects whether a PDF is scanned or text-based, extracts position-aware text, and converts it to clean Markdown. It features smart classification in tens of milliseconds and supports selective OCR to avoid unnecessary expensive OCR services.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core library, Python/Node.js bindings, browser WebAssembly build, and a CLI tool. It offers text extraction, Markdown conversion, table detection, multi-column layout handling, CID font support, and more.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with PDFium and ONNX Runtime for OCR, and bindings for Python, Node.js, and WebAssembly. OCR uses PP-OCRv6 Small model.
en.hot: Gained 15,341 stars this month, reaching 17,007 total, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending. Its blazing speed and smart classification solve a common pain point, backed by the reputable Firecrawl team.
uses: Developers needing fast PDF-to-Markdown conversion or text extraction for RAG or data pipelines.
Document management systems processing large volumes of PDFs, needing to distinguish scanned vs text-based for workflow optimization.
Browser or edge applications requiring local, low-latency PDF parsing without server round trips.

zh.tag: AI 代理团队级记忆中枢，沉淀对话、文档与代码为可复用资产
zh.what: TencentDB Agent Memory 是一个为 AI 代理设计的团队级记忆中枢，将对话、文档和代码转化为四种可复用的记忆资产（聊天记忆、技能、LLM 维基、代码图谱），并支持跨代理和框架的治理、共享与装备。它旨在减少重复工作，让代理在团队中持续积累知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含部署脚本（一键启动 memory-core、memory-hub 和 proxy）、核心服务代码、迁移工具，以及详细的安装文档（中英文）。提供面板用于管理记忆资产。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js >=22.16，支持 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 等代理框架，使用 TencentDB 作为存储后端。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1057 星，总星数达 16543，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。其“团队记忆”理念切中 AI 代理协作痛点，且提供一键部署，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理添加持久记忆，减少重复上下文输入。
团队协作场景：共享代理记忆，提升团队知识复用效率。
个人开发者：构建“一人公司”式的代理团队，自动化工作流。
研究爱好者：探索代理记忆管理与跨框架集成。

en.tag: Team-level memory hub for AI agents, turning conversations, docs, and code into reusable assets
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents, transforming conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks. It aims to reduce repetitive work by enabling agents to accumulate knowledge persistently.
en.content: The repo includes deployment scripts (one-click start for memory-core, memory-hub, and proxy), core service code, migration tools, and detailed installation docs (EN/CN). A panel is provided for managing memory assets.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.16, supports agent frameworks like OpenClaw and Hermes, and uses TencentDB as the storage backend.
en.hot: Gained 1,057 stars today, reaching 16,543 total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily chart. Its 'team memory' concept addresses the pain point of AI agent collaboration, and one-click deployment quickly attracts developers.
uses: AI agent developers: add persistent memory to agents, reducing repetitive context input.
Team collaboration: share agent memory to improve knowledge reuse efficiency.
Solo developers: build a 'one-person company' agent team for automated workflows.
Researchers/enthusiasts: explore agent memory management and cross-framework integration.

zh.tag: AI 驱动的逆向/渗透测试技能路由与工具链自举包
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编程客户端（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等）设计的技能路由包，当遇到 APK、二进制、前端 JS 加密、CTF 或渗透测试目标时，它会自动路由到正确的方法论，检查可用工具，并执行可重复的工作流，而不是猜测命令。它支持按需自举工具链，并拥有自动进化的知识库。
zh.content: 仓库包含主路由脚本（master-route.ps1）、规则文件（RULES.md）、场景技能模块、工具/MCP 配置、运维契约（ops）以及自动进化的经验库，并配有中文和英文文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 PowerShell 编写路由脚本，依赖 AI 客户端的技能调用机制，可能涉及 MCP 工具集成。
zh.hot: 本周新增超过 1 万 star，总 star 接近 2 万，跃居 GitHub Trending 周榜第一。它精准解决了 AI 在安全测试中缺乏结构化方法论的问题，将逆向和渗透测试流程标准化，极大提升了 AI 代理的实用性和效率。
uses: 安全研究人员：利用 AI 辅助进行逆向工程和漏洞分析，提高效率。
渗透测试人员：在授权测试中，快速引导 AI 执行标准化的渗透流程。
CTF 玩家：借助 AI 路由解决逆向和密码学挑战。
AI 工具开发者：参考其架构，为特定领域构建技能路由包。

en.tag: AI-driven skill router & toolchain bootstrapper for reverse engineering and pentesting
en.what: This is a skill router package for AI coding clients (like Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) that, upon encountering APKs, binaries, frontend JS encryption, CTF challenges, or pentesting targets, routes to the right methodology, checks available tools, and executes repeatable workflows instead of guessing commands. It supports on-demand toolchain bootstrapping and features a self-evolving knowledge base.
en.content: The repo includes a master routing script (master-route.ps1), rules file (RULES.md), scenario skill modules, tool/MCP configurations, ops contracts, and a self-evolving knowledge base, with documentation in both Chinese and English.
en.stack: Primarily written in PowerShell for routing scripts, leverages AI client skill invocation mechanisms, and may integrate with MCP tools.
en.hot: Gained over 10k stars this week, approaching 20k total, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending weekly. It precisely addresses the lack of structured methodology for AI in security testing, standardizing reverse engineering and pentesting workflows, greatly enhancing AI agents' practicality and efficiency.
uses: Security researchers: Use AI-assisted reverse engineering and vulnerability analysis to boost efficiency.
Penetration testers: Guide AI to execute standardized pentesting workflows in authorized engagements.
CTF players: Leverage AI routing to solve reverse engineering and crypto challenges.
AI tool developers: Reference its architecture to build skill routers for other domains.

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，统一记忆、知识与技能
zh.what: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的开源上下文数据库，将记忆、资源和技能统一为一个虚拟文件系统（viking:// 协议），代理可以通过 ls、tree、find 等命令浏览自己的上下文，而不是查询黑盒向量存储。内容被处理为三层（L0 摘要、L1 概览、L2 细节），并按需加载，每次检索都会留下可观察和调试的轨迹。
