zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenViking 的核心实现，包括虚拟文件系统、三层内容处理管道、检索轨迹记录，以及 OpenViking Studio 在线演示环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，可能依赖向量数据库、文件系统抽象和 AI 代理框架，具体技术栈未在摘要中详述。
zh.hot: OpenViking 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 28,893 颗星，今日新增 239 颗，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9 名。其创新的上下文管理方式（将记忆、知识和技能统一为文件系统）吸引了大量关注，解决了 AI 代理上下文管理的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要高效管理代理上下文、记忆和技能的场景。
RAG 应用构建者：希望用文件系统方式替代传统向量检索的团队。
研究与教育：用于探索代理上下文管理的新范式。

en.tag: Self-evolving context database for AI agents, unifying memory, knowledge RAG, and skills
en.what: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents, unifying memories, resources, and skills into one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so agents can browse their context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store. Content is processed into three tiers (L0 abstract, L1 overview, L2 details) and loaded on demand, with every retrieval leaving a traceable trajectory for debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of OpenViking, including the virtual filesystem, three-tier content processing pipeline, retrieval trajectory logging, and the OpenViking Studio live demo environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, likely leveraging vector databases, filesystem abstractions, and AI agent frameworks, though the exact stack is not detailed in the summary.
en.hot: OpenViking has quickly gained traction on GitHub with 28,893 stars and 239 new stars today, ranking #9 on the Python trending list. Its innovative approach to context management—unifying memory, knowledge, and skills into a filesystem—has attracted significant attention, addressing a key pain point in AI agent context handling.
uses: AI agent developers: scenarios requiring efficient management of agent context, memory, and skills.
RAG application builders: teams looking to replace traditional vector retrieval with a filesystem approach.
Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.

zh.tag: 统一 AI 开发与部署平台，含 MAX 框架与 Mojo 语言
zh.what: Modular Platform 是一个开源平台，旨在统一 AI 开发与部署流程，包含 MAX 框架（用于模型推理和部署）和 Mojo 语言（一种面向 AI 的高性能编程语言）。它提供从模型编译、优化到服务部署的完整工具链，并支持 OpenAI 兼容的端点。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Mojo 编译器、Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库、MAX 推理服务器、MAX 模型流水线以及大量代码示例。目录结构清晰，分为 /KGEN、/mojo、/max 等模块，方便开发者浏览和贡献。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Mojo 语言编写，同时涉及 Python（用于 MAX 的 Python API）和 C++（底层内核）。依赖 LLVM 等编译器基础设施，并遵循 Apache 2.0 许可证（含 LLVM 例外）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 268 星，总星数 27933，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。Mojo 语言和 MAX 框架的独特定位吸引了大量 AI 开发者，其高性能和统一平台理念备受关注。
uses: AI 开发者：使用 Mojo 语言编写高性能 AI 模型，或利用 MAX 框架进行模型部署和推理。
MLOps 工程师：通过 MAX 推理服务器快速搭建 OpenAI 兼容的模型服务。
研究人员：在 MAX 流水线中集成自定义模型架构，并利用加速器库优化性能。
开源贡献者：参与 Mojo 标准库、MAX 加速器库等模块的开发和改进。

en.tag: Unified AI development & deployment platform, including MAX framework and Mojo language
en.what: The Modular Platform is an open-source platform that unifies AI development and deployment, including the MAX framework for model inference and deployment, and the Mojo language, a high-performance programming language for AI. It provides a complete toolchain from model compilation and optimization to service deployment, with OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.content: The repo contains the Mojo compiler, Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, MAX inference server, MAX model pipelines, and numerous code examples. The directory structure is clear, with modules like /KGEN, /mojo, /max, making it easy to navigate and contribute.
en.stack: Primarily written in Mojo, with Python for MAX's Python API and C++ for low-level kernels. It relies on LLVM and other compiler infrastructure, and is licensed under Apache 2.0 with LLVM exceptions.
en.hot: With 268 stars added today and 27,933 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. The unique positioning of Mojo and MAX attracts AI developers, drawing attention to its high performance and unified platform concept.
uses: AI developers: Use Mojo to write high-performance AI models or leverage MAX for deployment and inference.
MLOps engineers: Quickly set up OpenAI-compatible model serving with the MAX inference server.
Researchers: Integrate custom model architectures in MAX pipelines and optimize performance with the accelerator library.
Open-source contributors: Contribute to the Mojo standard library, MAX accelerator library, and more.

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web 应用源码、桌面应用构建配置、CLI 工具以及文档（入门指南、远程访问、架构概览等）。支持通过 npx 快速运行或安装桌面应用。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Vite+（Vite 的增强版）构建，依赖各代理的 CLI 工具（Codex CLI、Claude Code 等）。

uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Vite+ (enhanced Vite), depends on each agent's CLI tool (Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, total 14459, ranked #18 on TypeScript weekly trending. It fills the gap for a unified multi-agent management UI, attracting many developers interested in AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want to switch between multiple AI coding assistants in one interface
Teams or individuals needing remote access to coding agents
Early adopters exploring AI-assisted programming workflows

zh.tag: 让 AI 助手直接给答案，告别啰嗦铺垫
zh.what: 这是一个用于编码助手的技能包，强制 AI 输出简洁、可操作的答案，避免冗长铺垫和无关内容。它基于 ADHD 友好原则，让回复直接给出行动步骤，适合所有希望提高效率的用户。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，定义了 10 条规则，如“先行动”“步骤编号”“结尾给出下一步”等。还提供安装说明、多语言 README 和示例对比，展示启用前后的输出差异。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Claude Code 的插件系统，使用 Markdown 定义技能规则。无复杂依赖，仅需 Python 环境（用于仓库元数据）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 20926 星，总星数 21466，登顶 GitHub Trending 月榜。它精准击中开发者对 AI 助手冗长回复的痛点，以极简方式提升效率，引发广泛共鸣。
uses: 开发者：希望 AI 编程助手直接给出可执行步骤，减少阅读负担。
团队：统一 AI 输出风格，提升代码审查和协作效率。
任何 AI 用户：厌倦了“Great question!”式开场，想要更直接的答案。

en.tag: Make coding agents answer directly, no fluff.
en.what: A skill for coding assistants that enforces concise, actionable answers, cutting out verbose preambles and tangents. Based on ADHD-friendly principles, it makes responses direct and step-by-step, benefiting anyone who wants faster, clearer outputs.
en.content: The repo contains a SKILL.md file with 10 rules like 'Lead with the next action' and 'Number multi-step tasks'. It also includes installation instructions, multilingual READMEs, and before/after examples showing the output difference.
en.stack: Built on Claude Code's plugin system, using Markdown to define skill rules. No heavy dependencies; Python is only for repo metadata.
en.hot: With 20,926 stars added this month (total 21,466), it topped the GitHub Trending monthly chart. It hits the pain point of verbose AI responses, offering a minimalist fix that resonates widely.
uses: Developers who want coding assistants to give actionable steps without extra reading.
Teams standardizing AI output style for faster code reviews and collaboration.
Any AI user tired of 'Great question!' preambles and seeking direct answers.

zh.tag: 邮箱账号关联查询 OSINT 工具
zh.what: holehe 是一个 OSINT 工具，用于检查邮箱是否在 Twitter、Instagram 等 120 多个网站上注册过账号。它利用“忘记密码”功能来获取相关信息，且不会向目标邮箱发送任何通知。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包和命令行工具，支持通过 PyPI、GitHub 或 Docker 安装。提供 CLI 和 Python API，模块化设计，每个模块返回标准化的 JSON 格式数据。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3，使用 trio 和 httpx 进行异步 HTTP 请求，依赖少量第三方库。
zh.hot: star 数达 12k+，今日新增 195，因其在 OSINT 和隐私研究领域的高效性和隐蔽性而广受欢迎。
uses: 安全研究人员进行账号枚举和足迹分析
隐私保护者检查自己的邮箱暴露范围
调查记者或社工场景下的信息收集
开发者集成到自定义 OSINT 工具链

en.tag: OSINT tool to check email registrations across sites
en.what: holehe is an OSINT tool that checks if an email is registered on over 120 websites like Twitter and Instagram. It retrieves information via the forgotten password function without alerting the target email.
en.content: The repo contains a Python package and CLI tool, installable via PyPI, GitHub, or Docker. It offers both CLI and Python API, with modular design returning standardized JSON data.
en.stack: Built on Python 3, uses trio and httpx for async HTTP requests, with minimal third-party dependencies.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and 195 new today, it's popular for its efficiency and stealth in OSINT and privacy research.
uses: Security researchers for account enumeration and footprinting
Privacy-conscious individuals checking their email exposure
Investigative journalists or social engineering info gathering
Developers integrating into custom OSINT pipelines

zh.tag: 把技术书 PDF 变成 Claude Code 技能，按需加载、即问即答
zh.what: book-to-skill 能将任何技术书籍、文档文件夹或资料集合转化为统一的代理技能（Agent Skill），供 GitHub Copilot CLI、Amp 或 Claude Code 等工具使用。它提取书中的框架、决策规则和反模式，生成按章节组织的文件，使代理能按需加载相关章节并基于真实内容回答，避免幻觉。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 命令行工具、文档（安装、使用、FAQ、性能、架构）以及示例技能输出。核心功能是三步流程：指定文件/文件夹/glob，提炼为技能，代理按需加载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，支持 PDF、EPUB、DOCX、MD、HTML、RTF、MOBI 等格式。依赖包括文档解析库和与 Claude Code 等代理的集成接口。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3903 stars，总星数达 17689，登上 GitHub 周榜第 5。它解决了 AI 代理使用技术书籍时的上下文爆炸问题，声称比直接导入书籍节省 24×–51× 的 token，并保证基于真实内容回答，因此受到开发者追捧。
uses: 开发者：将技术书籍转化为可交互的代理技能，边写代码边查阅
学习爱好者：把 PDF 书籍变成按需问答的私人导师
团队：将内部文档或规范转化为统一技能，供 AI 助手使用
AI 工具用户：在 Claude Code、Copilot CLI 等环境中增强代理能力

en.tag: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — on-demand, no hallucination
en.what: book-to-skill converts any technical book, document folder, or collection of sources into a unified agent skill for use with GitHub Copilot CLI, Amp, or Claude Code. It extracts frameworks, decision rules, and anti-patterns, generating per-chapter files so the agent can load relevant chapters on demand and answer from real content, avoiding hallucinations.
en.content: The repo includes a Python CLI tool, documentation (install, usage, FAQ, performance, architecture), and example skill outputs. Core is a 3-step flow: point to a file/folder/glob, distill into a skill, agent loads on demand.
en.stack: Primarily Python, supporting PDF, EPUB, DOCX, MD, HTML, RTF, MOBI formats. Dependencies include document parsing libraries and integration interfaces with agents like Claude Code.
en.hot: Gained 3,903 stars this week, reaching 17,689 total and #5 on GitHub weekly trending. It solves the context explosion problem when using technical books with AI agents, claiming 24×–51× fewer tokens than dumping the book, and ensures answers from real content, driving its popularity.
uses: Developers: turn technical books into interactive agent skills for on-the-fly reference while coding
Learners: convert PDF books into on-demand Q&A personal tutors
Teams: transform internal docs or standards into unified skills for AI assistants
AI tool users: enhance agent capabilities in Claude Code, Copilot CLI, etc.

zh.tag: 基于 tmux 的 AI 代理编排平台，让代理群协作如专业工程师
zh.what: SwarmForge 是一个协调多个 AI 代理的工具，通过 git worktree、tmux 会话和消息传递，让代理在同一项目上协作而不互相干扰。它提供了角色提示词、工作树分配和消息传递的共享结构，并强调纪律性开发流程。
zh.content: 主分支包含文档、共享操作脚本和默认宪法条款；可运行的工作流分支（如 two-pack、four-pack）包含项目配置、角色提示词和本地宪法条款。two-pack 是快速后端工作流，four-pack 是紧凑规范工作流，每个分支定义了特定的代理角色和流程。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Clojure，但核心依赖 tmux 和 git worktree，用于会话管理和并行开发。角色提示词和配置以文本文件形式存在，通过共享脚本组装。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1568 星，总星数 2936，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 22 名。它提供了一种纪律化的多代理协作方式，解决了代理互相干扰的问题，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 希望让多个 AI 代理协作完成同一项目的开发者，避免冲突并提高效率。
需要快速后端开发或规范驱动开发的工作流，如 two-pack 和 four-pack 分支。
对 tmux 和 git worktree 熟悉的用户，愿意采用纪律化流程管理代理。

en.tag: A disciplined tmux-based agent orchestration platform turning AI swarms into reliable engineers
en.what: SwarmForge is a tool for coordinating multiple AI agents, using git worktrees, tmux sessions, and message passing to enable agents to collaborate on the same project without stepping on each other. It provides a shared structure for role-specific prompts, worktree assignment, and message passing, emphasizing disciplined development workflows.
en.content: The main branch holds documentation, shared operational scripts, and default constitution articles; runnable workflow branches (like two-pack, four-pack) contain project-facing configurations, role prompts, and local constitution articles. two-pack is a quick backend workflow, four-pack is a compact specification workflow, each defining specific agent roles and flows.
en.stack: Primarily written in Clojure, but heavily relies on tmux and git worktree for session management and parallel development. Role prompts and configurations are stored as text files, assembled via shared scripts.
en.hot: Gained 1568 stars this month, reaching 2936 total, ranking #22 on GitHub Trending monthly. It offers a disciplined multi-agent collaboration approach, solving the problem of agents stepping on each other, attracting significant attention.
uses: Developers who want multiple AI agents to collaborate on the same project without conflicts and with higher efficiency.
Teams needing quick backend development or specification-driven workflows, as offered by the two-pack and four-pack branches.
Users familiar with tmux and git worktree, willing to adopt disciplined processes for managing agents.

zh.tag: 开源免费AI网关，单端点聚合264家模型提供商并智能压缩省token
zh.what: OmniRoute 是一个开源的免费 AI 网关，通过单一 API 端点聚合了 264+ 家模型提供商（含 90+ 免费 tier），让你能把 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等主流编程工具无缝接入免费的 Claude、GPT 或 Gemini。它内置 RTK+Caveman 双层压缩算法，可自动减少 15%–95% 的 token 消耗，并支持智能故障自动回退、MCP/A2A 协议以及多模态接口。
zh.content: 仓库包含可直接部署的网关核心、Web 管理后台（Dashboard）、PWA 与桌面端应用，以及详细的路由策略配置、免费额度文档和 Provider 接入模板。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 全栈构建，网关层采用 Node.js 高并发架构，前端提供 React 驱动的 Dashboard 与 PWA，并支持 Desktop 端封装。
zh.hot: 本周新增 3,605 Star、总星数突破 1.8 万并登上 GitHub 周榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对「零成本调用多模型」的强烈需求——聚合 90+ 免费提供商与高达 95% 的 token 压缩能力，直接切中了 AI 应用落地时的成本焦虑。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小型团队 —— 想用 Claude/GPT/Gemini 但预算有限，通过免费 tier 聚合实现零成本调用。
AI 编程工具重度用户 —— 将 Cursor、Cline、Claude Code 等 IDE 插件的底层模型切换到免费提供商。
网关/中间件自建者 —— 需要统一端点管理多模型路由、自动容灾和 token 压缩的企业内部 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Open-source AI gateway aggregating 264 providers with token compression and auto-fallback
en.what: OmniRoute is an open-source free AI gateway that aggregates 264+ providers—including 90+ free tiers—behind a single API endpoint, letting you plug Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and other tools into free Claude, GPT or Gemini instances. It features RTK+Caveman stacked compression to cut token usage by 15–95%, alongside smart auto-fallback, MCP/A2A support, and multimodal APIs.
en.content: The repo ships with a deployable gateway core, a web admin dashboard, PWA and desktop apps, plus routing strategy configs, free-tier documentation, and provider integration templates.
en.stack: Built entirely in TypeScript on a Node.js backend for high-concurrency gateway operations, with a React-based web dashboard and PWA, plus desktop packaging.
en.hot: It gained 3,605 stars this week, reaching 18.4k total and hitting #16 on GitHub Trending, as developers rush to cut AI costs—aggregating 90+ free providers and slashing token usage by up to 95% directly addresses the biggest barrier to shipping AI apps.
uses: Indie devs & small teams —— Access Claude/GPT/Gemini at zero cost by pooling 90+ free tiers instead of paid APIs.
Power users of AI coding tools —— Redirect Cursor, Cline, Claude Code and Copilot to free model backends via one endpoint.
Platform builders —— Those needing a unified gateway with auto-fallback, routing strategies, and token compression for internal AI infra.

zh.tag: 单卡4GB跑70B大模型，无需量化蒸馏剪枝
zh.what: AirLLM 通过分层流式加载大幅降低推理显存占用，让 70B 大模型能在单张 4GB 显卡上运行，无需量化、蒸馏或剪枝。它甚至支持在 8GB 显存运行 405B Llama 3.1，在 12GB 运行 DeepSeek-V3，在 4GB 以下运行 2.8T 的 Kimi K3。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 库、快速入门指南、配置文档、macOS 支持说明、示例 notebook 和 FAQ。核心是分层流式推理引擎，支持 Hugging Face 模型，并提供 PyPI 安装包。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 和 Hugging Face Transformers，利用文件映射和分层流式加载，支持稀疏 MoE 模型（如 DeepSeek-V3）的专家流式处理。
zh.hot: 本月新增 8654 星，总星数 32776，因为让普通玩家也能在低端显卡上运行超大模型，极大降低了门槛，引发社区热议。
uses: 个人开发者或学生，只有 4GB 显存显卡，想本地运行 70B 级大模型进行实验或学习。
需要部署超大模型（如 405B、671B）但 GPU 资源有限的团队，用于原型验证或小规模推理服务。
对 MoE 模型感兴趣的研究者，希望在不依赖量化的情况下探索模型性能。

en.tag: Run 70B LLMs on a single 4GB GPU, no quantization or pruning
en.what: AirLLM dramatically reduces inference memory usage by layer-wise streaming, enabling 70B LLMs to run on a single 4GB GPU without quantization, distillation, or pruning. It can even run 405B Llama 3.1 on 8GB, DeepSeek-V3 on ~12GB, and the 2.8T Kimi K3 on under 4GB.
en.content: The repo includes a Python library, quickstart guide, configuration docs, macOS support, example notebooks, and FAQ. The core is a layer-wise streaming inference engine, supporting Hugging Face models and available via PyPI.
en.stack: Built on PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, using file mapping and layer-wise streaming, with expert streaming for sparse MoE models like DeepSeek-V3.
en.hot: Gained 8,654 stars this month (total 32,776), as it enables hobbyists to run massive models on low-end GPUs, dramatically lowering the barrier and sparking community buzz.
uses: Individual developers or students with a 4GB GPU who want to run 70B-class models locally for experiments or learning.
Teams with limited GPU resources needing to deploy ultra-large models (e.g., 405B, 671B) for prototyping or small-scale inference.
Researchers interested in MoE models who want to explore performance without relying on quantization.

zh.tag: AI 智能体工具链：统一 LLM API、代理循环、TUI 与编程代理 CLI
zh.what: 提供模块化 AI 代理开发框架，整合多厂商 LLM API、代理运行时与终端交互界面。内置可自扩展的编程代理 CLI，支持工具调用、状态管理与交互式编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库采用 monorepo 结构，包含 pi-ai（统一 LLM 接口）、pi-agent-core（代理运行时）、pi-coding-agent（交互式编码 CLI）和 pi-tui（差分渲染终端 UI）四个核心包。README 还提供了容器化与沙箱隔离方案，以及面向人类和代理的协作规范。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 npm 管理 monorepo 依赖与生命周期脚本。支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流 LLM 提供商，并可通过 Docker 或 Gondolin micro-VM 进行容器化隔离。
zh.hot: 一周内新增 2,741 Star 使其冲上 TypeScript 周榜第 17 名，目前总 Star 数已突破 7.2 万。开发者对统一 LLM 接口与自扩展编程代理的结合表现出强烈兴趣。
uses: 需要构建多模型 AI 代理的开发者——统一接口降低集成成本
追求终端原生体验的 CLI 用户——内置 TUI 与差分渲染提升交互效率
关注代码安全隔离的团队——提供 Docker、micro-VM 等多种沙箱方案
希望人机与 AI 代理协作的项目维护者——贡献指南同时面向人类与 Agent

en.tag: AI agent toolkit with unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding agent CLI
en.what: A modular AI agent development framework that unifies multi-provider LLM APIs, agent runtime, and terminal UI. It features a self-extensible coding agent CLI with tool calling, state management, and interactive coding capabilities.
en.content: The monorepo houses four core packages: pi-ai (unified LLM API), pi-agent-core (agent runtime), pi-coding-agent (interactive CLI), and pi-tui (diff-rendered terminal UI). It also includes containerization guides and contribution rules for both humans and agents.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript with npm-based monorepo tooling and lifecycle scripts. Supports major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and offers containerization via Docker or Gondolin micro-VM.
en.hot: It gained 2,741 stars this week, landing at #17 on GitHub's TypeScript Weekly Trending with over 72.2k total stars. The combination of a unified LLM API and a self-extensible coding agent has drawn strong developer interest.
uses: Developers building multi-model AI agents — unified API reduces integration overhead
CLI users preferring terminal-native experiences — built-in TUI with diff rendering
Teams requiring secure isolation — supports Docker, micro-VM, and sandbox patterns
Project maintainers enabling human and AI co-contribution — guidelines cover both humans and agents

zh.tag: 开源身份认证与单点登录平台
zh.what: authentik 是一个开源的身份提供商（IdP），为现代应用提供单点登录（SSO）功能。它支持 SAML、OAuth2/OIDC、LDAP、RADIUS 等多种协议，适用于从个人实验室到大型生产集群的自托管场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 authentik 的核心服务、Outpost（用于代理和认证的组件）以及 Web 前端。提供 Docker Compose、Kubernetes Helm Chart、AWS CloudFormation 和 DigitalOcean Marketplace 等多种部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，后端基于 Django，前端使用 Web 技术（如 JavaScript/TypeScript）。依赖 PostgreSQL、Redis 等常见基础设施组件。
zh.hot: 作为开源替代 Okta、Auth0 等商业 IdP 的方案，authentik 在自托管社区中广受欢迎。今日新增 138 星，总星数达 23168，位列 GitHub 趋势榜第五。
uses: 自托管爱好者：希望完全掌控身份认证基础设施的个人或团队。
中小企业：需要替代昂贵商业 IdP 的可靠身份管理方案。
开发者：需要为应用集成 SSO 或统一认证流程的开发者。
DevOps 工程师：在 Kubernetes 或云环境中部署和管理身份服务。

en.tag: Open-source identity provider and SSO solution
en.what: authentik is an open-source Identity Provider (IdP) that provides single sign-on (SSO) for modern applications. It supports protocols like SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, RADIUS, and more, designed for self-hosting from small labs to large production clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the core server, outposts (for proxy and authentication), and web frontend. Deployment options include Docker Compose, Kubernetes Helm, AWS CloudFormation, and DigitalOcean Marketplace.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, with backend based on Django and frontend using web technologies (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript). It relies on common infrastructure components like PostgreSQL and Redis.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to commercial IdPs like Okta and Auth0, authentik is popular in the self-hosting community. With 138 stars today and 23,168 total, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: individuals or teams wanting full control over their identity infrastructure.
SMBs: seeking a reliable identity management solution to replace costly commercial IdPs.
Developers: needing to integrate SSO or unify authentication flows in their applications.
DevOps engineers: deploying and managing identity services in Kubernetes or cloud environments.

zh.tag: 系统设计面试与大规模系统学习一站式指南
zh.what: 这是一个系统设计入门与面试准备的综合性资源库，涵盖大规模系统设计的原则、案例和面试题。它提供结构化的学习路径，帮助工程师掌握构建可扩展系统的能力，并配有 Anki 闪卡辅助记忆。
zh.content: 仓库包含系统设计基础、可扩展性、可用性、一致性等主题的详细笔记，以及常见面试题和解决方案，配有图表和代码示例。还提供多语言翻译和 Anki 闪卡。

zh.hot: 作为系统设计面试的经典资源，star 数高达 36 万，今日新增 733，长期占据 GitHub 趋势榜。其全面性和实用性使其成为工程师的必备参考。
uses: 准备系统设计面试的求职者 — 提供常见问题和解决方案，助你高效备考。
希望提升系统架构能力的工程师 — 系统学习大规模系统设计原则。
技术面试官 — 参考其中问题与答案，设计面试题目。
计算机科学学生 — 作为系统设计课程的补充教材。

en.tag: One-stop guide for system design interviews and large-scale system learning
en.what: A comprehensive resource for learning system design and preparing for interviews, covering principles, case studies, and interview questions. It offers a structured learning path to help engineers master building scalable systems, with Anki flashcards for memorization.
en.content: The repo contains detailed notes on system design fundamentals, scalability, availability, consistency, etc., along with common interview questions and solutions with diagrams and code examples. It also offers multi-language translations and Anki flashcards.

en.hot: As a classic resource for system design interviews, it has 362k stars, with 733 new today, consistently trending on GitHub. Its comprehensiveness and practicality make it a must-have reference for engineers.
uses: Job seekers preparing for system design interviews — provides common questions and solutions for efficient preparation.
Engineers looking to improve system architecture skills — systematically learn large-scale system design principles.
Technical interviewers — reference questions and answers to design interview problems.
Computer science students — as supplementary material for system design courses.

zh.tag: 腾讯开源的 AI 红队全栈安全平台
zh.what: A.I.G 是一个由腾讯朱雀实验室开发的全栈 AI 红队平台，用于保护 AI 生态系统。它通过代理扫描、技能扫描、MCP 扫描、AI 基础设施扫描和 LLM 越狱评估，全面检测和缓解 AI 系统中的安全漏洞。
zh.content: 仓库包含平台的核心代码、文档、多语言 README（中英日西德法等），以及 Docker 镜像和 ClawHub 集成（如 EdgeOne ClawScan、Skill Scanner）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，提供 Docker 部署方式，并集成 ClawHub 和 EdgeOne 等云服务。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 安全需求激增，该平台在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获 4957 星，今日新增 50 星，并登上日榜第 16 名。
uses: AI 安全研究员：用于评估和加固 AI 系统的安全性
企业安全团队：扫描 AI 基础设施和代理，防范潜在攻击
开发者：集成 MCP 扫描和 LLM 越狱测试到 CI/CD 流程

en.tag: Tencent's full-stack AI red teaming security platform
en.what: A.I.G is a full-stack AI red teaming platform developed by Tencent Zhuque Lab to secure AI ecosystems. It performs agent scans, skill scans, MCP scans, AI infrastructure scans, and LLM jailbreak evaluations to detect and mitigate security vulnerabilities in AI systems.
en.content: The repository includes the platform's core code, documentation, multi-language READMEs (Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish, German, etc.), Docker images, and ClawHub integrations such as EdgeOne ClawScan and Skill Scanner.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, offers Docker deployment, and integrates with cloud services like ClawHub and EdgeOne.
en.hot: With surging demand for AI security, the platform has quickly gained popularity on GitHub, amassing 4,957 stars with 50 new stars today, ranking 16th on the daily trending list.
uses: AI security researchers: to assess and harden AI system security
Enterprise security teams: to scan AI infrastructure and agents against potential attacks
Developers: to integrate MCP scanning and LLM jailbreak testing into CI/CD pipelines

zh.tag: 开源AI自动化渗透测试工具，自主发现并修复应用漏洞
zh.what: Strix 是一个开源的 AI 渗透测试平台，通过自主 AI 代理动态运行代码，像真实黑客一样侦察、利用并验证应用漏洞。它通过生成实际的可利用 Proof-of-Concept 来确认漏洞，而非仅依赖静态分析的误报，并支持多代理协作规模化执行安全测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的渗透测试工具包，支持侦察、漏洞利用与验证开箱即用；同时提供 GitHub Actions 集成与 CI/CD 流水线插件，可自动扫描 Pull Request 并在代码合并前阻断不安全提交。
zh.stack: 项目以 Python 为主要语言构建，支持通过 PyPI 分发安装（strix-agent），并依赖现代 AI 代理编排框架实现多智能体协作；可与现有 DevOps 工具链深度集成。
zh.hot: 该项目月增 16,488 Star 跃至 GitHub 月榜第 5 名，总星数突破 42,318；其“AI + 动态 PoC 验证”模式精准击中了传统静态扫描误报率高、人工渗透测试成本高的痛点，成为安全左移趋势下的热门方案。
uses: 开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动化安全扫描，在代码合并前拦截漏洞
安全工程师 —— 利用多 AI 代理协作执行大规模渗透测试与漏洞验证
DevOps/平台团队 —— 将安全左移，无需额外基础设施即可接入现有流水线

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI pentesting agents that find and fix app vulnerabilities
en.what: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing platform where autonomous agents dynamically run code to discover and validate vulnerabilities like real hackers. It generates working proofs-of-concept rather than static-analysis false positives, and scales through multi-agent orchestration for collaborative security testing.
en.content: The repository ships with a full pentesting toolkit covering reconnaissance, exploitation, and validation out of the box. It also provides GitHub Actions integration and CI/CD pipeline plugins to auto-scan pull requests and block insecure code before it reaches production.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python and distributed via PyPI as strix-agent, it relies on modern AI agent orchestration frameworks for multi-agent collaboration and deep integration with existing DevOps toolchains.
en.hot: With 16,488 new stars this month and a #5 spot on GitHub Trending, it has climbed to 42,318 total stars. Its “AI + dynamic PoC validation” model directly addresses the high false-positive rates of legacy scanners and the cost of manual pentesting, making it a standout in the shift-left security movement.
uses: Development teams — Automate security scanning in CI/CD to intercept vulnerabilities before code merges.
Security engineers — Leverage multi-agent AI collaboration for large-scale pentesting and real exploit validation.
DevOps/platform teams — Shift security left by plugging into existing pipelines with zero additional infrastructure.

zh.tag: AI 文本去味剂，让机器写作更自然
zh.what: 一个便携的代理技能，用于去除文本中 AI 写作的痕迹，使其听起来更自然、更像人类。它基于维基百科的“AI 写作迹象”指南，并包含二次润色和防幻觉机制。

en.tag: Remove AI-generated writing signs, make text sound human
en.what: A portable agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. It is based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' guide and includes a second rewrite pass with hallucination prevention.
en.content: The repo contains a single SKILL.md file that can be installed via skills CLI or manually into any agent harness supporting skill-style instructions. Supports global or project-local install and can be used as a Claude Code plugin.
en.stack: Plain Markdown skill file with no external dependencies, runs in any harness that supports skill-style instructions.
en.hot: Gained 1504 stars this week, total 31573, ranked #16 on Python weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI-generated text being easily detectable, and is extremely easy to install and use.
uses: Content creators — polish AI drafts into natural human style to avoid detection
Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: 最强大的模块化 AI 内容创作引擎，节点式图形界面

en.stack: Primarily built with Python, relying on PyTorch and other deep learning frameworks, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS.

uses: AI artists and designers: fine-tune generation via node graphs to create high-quality images and videos.
Developers: integrate via API into production pipelines for automated content generation.
Researchers: quickly experiment with the latest open-source models like Stable Diffusion and Flux.

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上原生多 token 预测加速的本地 LLM 运行器
zh.what: MTPLX 是一个原生 Mac 应用和命令行工具，用于在 Apple Silicon 上运行本地大语言模型。它利用模型内置的多 token 预测（MTP）头，通过自推测解码和精确拒绝采样，在保持输出分布不变的情况下显著加速生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Mac 应用（DMG 下载）和命令行工具（brew/pip 安装），提供模型推荐、自动下载、引擎配置、风扇控制等功能。内置针对 Qwen 3.8 27B 等模型的优化版本，并附有详细的 README 和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，使用 MLX 框架，依赖 Apple Silicon 的 Metal 性能。应用层采用原生 Mac 技术，CLI 支持 Homebrew 和 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 本月新增 714 星，总星数 1824，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（Python）第 18 名。其宣称的 2 倍加速和无需外部草稿模型的特性，吸引了大量 Apple Silicon 用户的关注。
uses: 在 Mac 上本地运行 LLM 的开发者，希望获得更快的推理速度而不牺牲输出质量。
需要离线或隐私保护的 AI 编码助手，特别是使用 Qwen 3.8 27B 等模型的场景。
对推测解码技术感兴趣的研究者，希望参考其实现或进行二次开发。

en.tag: Native multi-token prediction LLM runner for Apple Silicon, ~2x faster
en.what: MTPLX is a native Mac app and CLI for running local LLMs on Apple Silicon. It leverages built-in multi-token prediction (MTP) heads to speculatively draft and verify multiple tokens per step, achieving up to 2.24x speedup while preserving the exact output distribution.
en.content: The repo provides a full Mac app (DMG) and CLI (brew/pip), featuring hardware checking, model recommendation, auto-download, engine setup, and fan control. It includes optimized builds for models like Qwen 3.8 27B, along with comprehensive docs.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+ with the MLX framework, leveraging Apple Silicon's Metal performance. The app uses native Mac technologies, and the CLI is installable via Homebrew or pip.
en.hot: Gained 714 stars this month (total 1824), ranking #18 on GitHub Trending (Python) monthly. Its claimed ~2x speedup and no-external-drafter design have attracted significant attention from Apple Silicon users.
uses: Developers running LLMs locally on Macs who want faster inference without compromising output quality.
AI coding assistants needing offline/private operation, especially with models like Qwen 3.8 27B.
Researchers interested in speculative decoding techniques for reference or further development.

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室：克隆、配音、转录一站式
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源、完全本地运行的语音工具套件，可作为 ElevenLabs 的替代品。它支持语音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，覆盖 646 种语言。核心工作流无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，注重隐私和离线可用性。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用（支持 macOS、Windows、Linux）、本地 REST/SSE/WebSocket API、OpenAI 兼容音频 API 和 MCP 服务器。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供模型目录和快速切换功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，支持 CUDA、Apple Silicon MPS/MLX、ROCm 和 CPU 计算，可选远程工作节点。依赖多种 TTS/ASR 引擎，并采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 凭借 12k+ 星标和月增 2781 星，VoiceStudio 在 GitHub 趋势榜上迅速走红。其本地优先、多引擎、多语言的特点吸引了注重隐私和灵活性的用户，成为商业服务的开源替代。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频、播客或有声书生成高质量配音，且希望完全离线处理。
隐私敏感用户：不愿将语音数据上传到云端，要求本地处理以保护敏感信息。
开发者：需要集成语音功能到应用中，利用 OpenAI 兼容 API 或 MCP 服务器。
多语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行语言学习、听力训练或翻译辅助。

en.tag: Local-first all-in-one voice studio: cloning, dubbing, transcription & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully local voice toolkit that serves as an ElevenLabs alternative. It supports voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. The core workflow requires no account, API key, or subscription, emphasizing privacy and offline usability.
en.content: The repository includes a desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux), local REST/SSE/WebSocket API, OpenAI-compatible audio API, and MCP server. It integrates 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, with a model catalogue and quick-switch functionality.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, supporting CUDA, Apple Silicon MPS/MLX, ROCm, and CPU compute, with optional remote workers. It leverages multiple TTS/ASR engines and is licensed under AGPL-3.0.
en.hot: With 12k+ stars and a monthly increase of 2,781, VoiceStudio is rapidly rising on GitHub Trending. Its local-first, multi-engine, multi-language approach attracts privacy-conscious and flexibility-seeking users as an open-source alternative to commercial services.
uses: Content creators: need high-quality voiceovers for videos, podcasts, or audiobooks, preferring fully offline processing.
Privacy-conscious users: avoid uploading voice data to the cloud, requiring local processing to protect sensitive information.
Developers: integrate voice capabilities into apps using OpenAI-compatible API or MCP server.
Language learners: leverage 646-language support for language practice, listening training, or translation assistance.

zh.tag: 2027暑期科技实习岗位汇总，每日更新
zh.what: 这是一个由Pitt CSC和Simplify维护的GitHub仓库，汇总了2027年夏季的科技实习岗位，涵盖软件工程、数据科学、AI/ML、量化金融、产品管理和硬件工程等领域。列表每日更新，并提供分类浏览和贡献指南。

uses: 计算机及相关专业学生寻找2027年暑期实习，快速筛选合适岗位。
求职者利用分类和筛选条件，高效定位软件工程、AI等方向的实习机会。
社区贡献者通过提交issue或PR，帮助维护和更新实习列表。

en.tag: Curated list of Summer 2027 tech internships, updated daily
en.what: This repo, maintained by Pitt CSC and Simplify, aggregates Summer 2027 tech internship postings across software engineering, data science, AI/ML, quant finance, product management, and hardware. It's updated daily and offers categorized browsing and contribution guidelines.
en.content: The repo contains 632 internship roles categorized by type (e.g., 206 software engineering, 224 data science/AI/ML), with a legend for sponsorship, citizenship, and other flags. It also links to inactive listings, off-season roles, and new-grad positions.
en.stack: Primarily uses Python for data processing and automated updates, relying on GitHub Issues and Actions to maintain the list.
en.hot: The repo is popular for providing timely and comprehensive internship info, with 46.8k stars and +1,438 this month, ranking #18 on the Python trending list.
uses: CS and related majors seeking Summer 2027 internships to quickly filter suitable roles.
Job seekers using categories and filters to efficiently locate internships in software engineering, AI, etc.
Community contributors helping maintain and update the list by submitting issues or PRs.

zh.tag: 数学视频动画引擎，3Blue1Brown 出品
zh.what: Manim 是一个用于创建精确编程动画的引擎，专为制作解释性数学视频而设计。它由 3Blue1Brown 的作者开发，用于制作其 YouTube 视频中的动画。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ManimGL 的源代码，包括核心动画模块、场景类、图形对象和渲染器。还提供了示例场景和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，依赖 FFmpeg、OpenGL 和可选的 LaTeX。Linux 系统需要 Pango。
zh.hot: 作为 3Blue1Brown 官方工具，拥有近 9 万星标，今日新增 381 星，持续受到数学教育者和视频创作者的关注。
uses: 数学教育者：制作教学视频中的动画演示
视频创作者：为科普内容添加精确的数学动画
开发者：学习或扩展动画引擎，定制自己的数学可视化

en.tag: Animation engine for explanatory math videos by 3Blue1Brown
en.what: Manim is an engine for precise programmatic animations, designed for creating explanatory math videos. It was developed by the author of 3Blue1Brown for animating those videos.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for ManimGL, including core animation modules, scene classes, mobjects, and renderers. It also includes example scenes and documentation.

Developers: learn or extend the animation engine for custom math visualizations

zh.tag: 极简开源项目管理工具，自托管、快速、界面干净
zh.what: Kaneo 是一款开源的项目管理工具，强调“少即是多”，去除多余功能，专注于实际工作。它提供简洁的界面、自托管选项和快速性能，旨在让团队自然工作流不被工具干扰。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Kaneo 应用源码，包括前端仪表盘、后端 API、文档和部署配置。主要目录有 src（源代码）、docs（文档）和配置文件，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用现代 Web 技术栈。具体依赖包括 React（前端）、Node.js（后端）、数据库（如 PostgreSQL）以及 Docker 用于部署。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4703 星，总星数达 8630，登上 GitHub 趋势榜第 9 名。其“极简”理念和自托管特性吸引了大量厌倦复杂工具的开发者和团队。
uses: 小型团队或独立开发者，希望用简单工具管理项目而不被复杂功能困扰
注重数据隐私的用户，需要自托管解决方案来掌控自己的数据
寻找开源替代品，替代 Jira、Asana 等重量级项目管理软件

en.tag: Minimalist open-source project management, self-hosted, fast, clean UI
en.what: Kaneo is an open-source project management tool that emphasizes 'less is more,' stripping away unnecessary features to focus on actual work. It offers a clean interface, self-hosting options, and fast performance, designed to let teams work naturally without tool interference.
en.content: The repository contains the full Kaneo application source code, including frontend dashboard, backend API, documentation, and deployment configs. Main directories include src (source code), docs, and configuration files, with Docker self-hosting support.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using a modern web stack. Dependencies include React (frontend), Node.js (backend), a database like PostgreSQL, and Docker for deployment.
en.hot: Gained 4,703 stars this month, reaching 8,630 total, ranking #9 on GitHub Trending. Its minimalist philosophy and self-hosting appeal attract developers and teams tired of complex tools.
uses: Small teams or indie developers who want a simple tool to manage projects without complex features
Privacy-conscious users needing self-hosted solutions to keep data under control
Those seeking open-source alternatives to heavyweight PM tools like Jira or Asana

zh.tag: 免费AI编码代理，多产品覆盖终端、桌面、网页与云端
zh.what: Freebuff 是一套免费的AI编码代理产品，包括桌面端、CLI、Web、云和聊天五种形态，无需订阅或API密钥即可使用。它通过专用代理和模型选择帮助用户编码、构建和研究。
zh.content: 仓库包含产品文档、快速入门指南、模型目录说明，以及各产品（桌面、CLI、Web、云、聊天）的详细介绍和安装链接。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，CLI 通过 npm 安装，支持多种模型（如 DeepSeek、GPT-5.6 Luna 等），桌面端可集成本地 Claude Code 和 Codex 代理。
zh.hot: 免费且无需API密钥的AI编码工具，提供多产品覆盖和多种模型选择，今日新增105星，登上GitHub趋势榜。
uses: 开发者：在终端或桌面端快速进行AI辅助编码
全栈开发者：使用Web版构建和部署完整应用
研究者：通过聊天版进行AI驱动的研究与思考
团队：在GitHub仓库上运行云端代理进行协作

en.tag: Free AI coding agent suite across terminal, desktop, web, and cloud
en.what: Freebuff is a suite of free AI coding agents available as desktop, CLI, web, cloud, and chat products, requiring no subscription or API key. It uses specialized agents and a choice of models to assist with coding, building, and research.
en.content: The repository includes product documentation, quick start guides, model catalog details, and descriptions/links for each product (Desktop, CLI, Web, Cloud, Chat).
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, CLI installable via npm, supports multiple models (DeepSeek, GPT-5.6 Luna, etc.), and Desktop can integrate local Claude Code and Codex agents.
en.hot: Free AI coding tool with no API key required, offering multi-product coverage and model variety; gained 105 stars today and hit the GitHub trending list.
uses: Developers: AI-assisted coding from terminal or desktop
Full-stack developers: build and ship apps with the Web version
Researchers: AI-driven research and thinking via Chat
Teams: run cloud agents on GitHub repositories for collaboration

zh.tag: 开源智能体操作系统，让 AI 代理自主运行
zh.what: elizaOS 是一个开源的 TypeScript 框架和产品栈，用于构建和运行自主 AI 代理。它提供核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务和原生桥接，支持从聊天、语音到设备控制等多种能力。
zh.content: 该仓库是一个 monorepo，包含核心运行时、Eliza 应用、CLI、云服务、原生桥接和第一方插件。可引导的 Linux 和 Android 发行版在单独的 elizaOS/os 仓库中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Bun 和 Node.js，使用 Turbo 进行构建，支持子模块和补丁。
zh.hot: 本周新增 115 颗星，总星数达 19064，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 19 名。其“智能体操作系统”的定位和全栈能力吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者：使用 CLI 和文档构建自定义 AI 代理或插件
企业：通过 Eliza Cloud 部署和管理 AI 代理
个人用户：下载 Eliza 应用用于个人助理、自动化等场景
研究者：探索自主代理和操作系统级集成的可能性

en.tag: Open-source agentic operating system for autonomous AI agents
en.what: elizaOS is an open-source TypeScript framework and product stack for building and running autonomous AI agents. It provides a core runtime, the Eliza app, CLI, cloud services, and native bridges, enabling capabilities from chat and voice to device control.
en.content: This repository is a monorepo containing the core runtime, the Eliza app, the CLI, cloud services, native bridges, and first-party plugins. Bootable Linux and Android distributions live in a separate elizaOS/os repository.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Bun and Node.js dependencies, built using Turbo, supporting submodules and patches.
en.hot: Gained 115 stars this week, reaching 19,064 total, ranking #19 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) weekly. Its positioning as an 'agentic operating system' with full-stack capabilities attracts many developers.
uses: Developers: build custom AI agents or plugins using the CLI and docs
Enterprises: deploy and manage AI agents via Eliza Cloud
Individuals: download the Eliza app for personal assistant, automation, etc.
Researchers: explore autonomous agents and OS-level integration

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面端应用源码（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、移动端配套应用（iOS/Android），以及用于多代理并行执行、git worktree 管理与结果对比合并的核心模块。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 隐私优先的开源简历生成器
zh.what: Reactive Resume 是一款免费开源的简历生成器，简化了创建、更新和分享简历的流程。它提供多种模板，用户填写信息后即可导出为 PDF，无需注册账户即可使用基本功能。该应用以隐私为核心，用户完全拥有自己的数据，且支持自托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用（apps/web）、后端服务（apps/server）以及相关文档，采用 monorepo 结构。支持 Docker 部署，提供多语言界面，并集成了赞助商展示。

zh.hot: 该项目拥有超过 4 万星标，今日新增 255 星，位列 GitHub 趋势榜（TypeScript）第 5 名。其隐私保护、开源免费和自托管特性吸引了大量用户，且持续更新维护。
uses: 求职者：快速制作专业简历并导出 PDF，无需注册。
注重隐私的用户：希望完全掌控个人数据，可自托管部署。
开发者：可定制和扩展简历生成器，或贡献代码。

en.tag: Privacy-first open-source resume builder
en.what: Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder that simplifies creating, updating, and sharing resumes. It offers templates, lets you fill in details and export to PDF, no account required for basic use. Built with privacy as a core principle, it gives users complete ownership of their data and can be self-hosted.
en.content: The repository contains a frontend app (apps/web), backend server (apps/server), and documentation, structured as a monorepo. It supports Docker deployment, offers multi-language UI, and includes sponsor showcases.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, frontend built with React (Next.js), backend with NestJS, databases support PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and Docker for containerized deployment.
en.hot: With over 40k stars and 255 new stars today, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its privacy-first, open-source, free, and self-hostable features attract many users, and it is actively maintained.
uses: Job seekers: quickly create professional resumes and export to PDF without registration.
Privacy-conscious users: want full control over personal data and can self-host.
Developers: can customize and extend the resume builder or contribute code.

zh.tag: 终端里的开源 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Qwen Code 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，直接在终端中运行，提供交互式 UI 和代理功能。它支持自动记忆、自动技能、子代理、代理团队和 MCP，无需配置即可动态工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的核心框架，提供 CLI 工具、交互式终端 UI、IDE 插件、桌面应用、守护进程模式、SDK 以及 IM 机器人（Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu）。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（>=22），支持多种 API 协议（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen），可接入第三方或本地模型（Ollama/vLLM）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 389 星，总星数达 26.9k，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（TypeScript）第 8 名。其开箱即用的代理特性和多协议支持吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中直接使用 AI 编程代理，无需离开命令行。
团队需要支持多种模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen）的灵活工具。
希望利用 MCP 和子代理构建复杂自动化工作流的用户。
对开源、可定制、无供应商锁定的 AI 工具感兴趣的人。

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal
en.what: Qwen Code is an open-source AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, offering an interactive UI and agentic capabilities. It features auto-memory, auto-skills, subagents, agent teams, and MCP, enabling dynamic workflows with zero setup.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based core framework, providing a CLI tool, interactive terminal UI, IDE plugins, desktop app, daemon mode, SDKs, and IM bots (Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu).
en.stack: Built on Node.js (>=22), supports multiple API protocols (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen), and can integrate third-party or local models (Ollama/vLLM).
en.hot: Gained 389 stars this week, reaching 26.9k total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) this week. Its out-of-the-box agentic features and multi-protocol support attract many developers.
uses: Developers who want an AI coding agent directly in the terminal without leaving the command line.
Teams needing a flexible tool that supports multiple model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen).
Users who want to build complex automated workflows with MCP and subagents.
Those interested in open-source, customizable, vendor-lock-in-free AI tools.

zh.tag: AI 代理数据抓取服务器，连接数千现成爬虫工具
zh.what: Apify MCP 服务器是一个模型上下文协议（MCP）实现，让 AI 代理能够从社交媒体、搜索引擎、地图、电商等网站提取数据。它利用 Apify Store 中数千个现成的抓取器、爬虫和自动化工具，支持 OAuth 认证，可轻松从 Claude.ai 或 VS Code 等客户端连接。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器的源代码、文档、配置示例，以及用于构建和测试的脚本。它提供托管服务器（https://mcp.apify.com）和本地运行选项，并支持代理支付功能。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 MCP SDK 实现协议，依赖 Apify 平台 API。支持 Streamable HTTP 传输，兼容多种 MCP 客户端。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3065 星，总星数达 5443，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜。其核心价值在于将 AI 代理与海量现成爬虫工具无缝连接，极大简化了数据获取流程，且支持托管服务，开箱即用。
uses: 开发者构建 AI 代理时，需要从网页或社交媒体提取数据，可快速集成现成爬虫。
数据分析师使用 AI 助手从电商、地图等网站抓取结构化数据，用于市场研究或监控。
自动化爱好者希望利用 MCP 协议，让 AI 代理执行复杂的网络数据采集任务。

en.tag: MCP server enabling AI agents to scrape any website via thousands of ready-made tools
en.what: The Apify MCP server is a Model Context Protocol implementation that enables AI agents to extract data from social media, search engines, maps, e-commerce sites, and any other website. It leverages thousands of ready-made scrapers, crawlers, and automation tools from the Apify Store, supports OAuth, and can be connected from clients like Claude.ai or VS Code.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, configuration examples, and build/test scripts for the MCP server. It offers a hosted server (https://mcp.apify.com) and local running options, with support for agentic payments.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses the MCP SDK to implement the protocol, and relies on the Apify platform API. Supports Streamable HTTP transport and is compatible with various MCP clients.
en.hot: Gained 3,065 stars this month, reaching 5,443 total, and hit #15 on the monthly TypeScript trending list. Its core value lies in seamlessly connecting AI agents with thousands of ready-made scrapers, simplifying data extraction, and offering a hosted service for instant use.
uses: Developers building AI agents that need to extract data from web pages or social media can quickly integrate ready-made scrapers.
Data analysts use AI assistants to scrape structured data from e-commerce, maps, etc., for market research or monitoring.
Automation enthusiasts want to leverage the MCP protocol to have AI agents perform complex web data collection tasks.

zh.tag: 本地 GPU 驱动的图像/文字转 3D 模型桌面应用
zh.what: Modly 是一款开源的桌面应用，利用本地 AI 模型将照片或文字提示转换为 3D 网格模型。它完全在 GPU 上运行，无需云端服务，支持 Windows、Linux 和 Apple Silicon macOS。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 前端（TypeScript）和 Python 后端（API），并提供扩展系统，支持多种模型如 Hunyuan3D 和 TripoSG。用户可通过 Releases 下载安装包，或克隆仓库直接运行。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 和 Electron 构建桌面应用，后端使用 Python（FastAPI 等），依赖 npm 和 pip 管理，支持 GPU 加速推理。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2564 星，总星数达 7330，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜。因其将 AI 3D 生成本地化，保护隐私且免费，吸引了大量创作者和开发者。
uses: 3D 设计师和游戏开发者，快速从照片或文字生成原型模型。
隐私敏感用户，希望在本地处理数据，避免上传到云端。
AI 爱好者，探索本地运行 3D 生成模型的技术实践。

en.tag: Desktop app for local GPU-powered image/prompt to 3D mesh generation
en.what: Modly is an open-source desktop app that converts photos or text prompts into 3D mesh models using local AI models. It runs entirely on your GPU, no cloud needed, supporting Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon macOS.
en.content: The repo includes an Electron frontend (TypeScript) and a Python backend (API), with an extension system supporting models like Hunyuan3D and TripoSG. Users can download installers from Releases or clone and run directly.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Electron for the desktop app, with a Python backend (e.g., FastAPI), managed via npm and pip, leveraging GPU-accelerated inference.
en.hot: Gained 2,564 stars this month, reaching 7,330 total, trending on GitHub. Its local-first approach to AI 3D generation, ensuring privacy and zero cost, attracts creators and developers.
uses: 3D designers and game developers quickly prototyping models from photos or text.
Privacy-conscious users who prefer local processing over cloud uploads.
AI enthusiasts exploring local 3D generation models.

zh.tag: AI 生产力工作室：智能对话、自主代理与 300+ 助手
zh.what: Cherry Studio 是一个集智能对话、自主代理和 300+ 预设助手于一体的 AI 生产力工具，提供对前沿大模型的统一访问。它支持多语言界面，并可通过桌面应用或 Web 方式使用。

开发者可利用其 300+ 助手和自主代理功能，快速构建 AI 工作流。
团队可将其作为统一的 AI 生产力平台，提升协作效率。

en.tag: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants
en.what: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity tool that integrates smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ preset assistants, offering unified access to frontier LLMs. It supports multiple languages and can be used as a desktop app or via web.

zh.tag: 开源可观测性平台，替代 Datadog/Splunk，成本降低 140 倍
zh.what: OpenObserve 是一个云原生的可观测性平台，统一处理日志、指标、追踪、前端监控和 LLM 可观测性。它旨在以极低的存储成本和简单的部署方式，替代 Datadog、Splunk 和 Elasticsearch 等传统工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源码，包括前端界面、后端服务、文档、架构说明和快速入门指南。支持单二进制部署，并集成了 OpenTelemetry 原生支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，后端基于 Rust 构建，利用 Parquet 列式存储和 S3 原生架构实现高性能和低成本。
zh.hot: 凭借 140 倍存储成本降低和单二进制部署的卖点，吸引了大量关注，本月新增 1100 星，总星数突破 2.1 万，成为可观测性领域的热门开源项目。
uses: 寻求替代昂贵商业可观测性工具的中小团队，希望降低成本而不牺牲功能。
需要统一管理日志、指标、追踪和前端监控的 DevOps 或 SRE 团队。
对 LLM 应用进行可观测性监控的 AI 工程师，需要追踪模型调用和性能。
希望快速部署自托管可观测性平台，且要求简单运维的开发者。

en.tag: Open-source observability platform, a cost-effective alternative to Datadog/Splunk with 140x lower storage cost
en.what: OpenObserve is a cloud-native observability platform that unifies logs, metrics, traces, frontend monitoring, and LLM observability. It aims to replace traditional tools like Datadog, Splunk, and Elasticsearch with dramatically lower storage costs and simple deployment.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, including frontend UI, backend services, documentation, architecture overview, and quickstart guides. It supports single-binary deployment and has native OpenTelemetry integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, with a Rust-based backend. It leverages Parquet columnar storage and an S3-native architecture for high performance and low cost.
en.hot: With its 140x storage cost reduction and single-binary deployment, it has gained significant traction, adding 1,100 stars this month and surpassing 21,000 total stars, making it a hot open-source project in the observability space.
uses: Small to medium teams looking for a cost-effective alternative to expensive commercial observability tools without sacrificing features.
DevOps or SRE teams needing to unify logs, metrics, traces, and frontend monitoring in one platform.
AI engineers monitoring LLM applications, requiring tracing of model calls and performance.
Developers who want a self-hosted observability platform with simple deployment and low operational overhead.

zh.tag: 为AI代理设计的极速共享浏览器，零配置
zh.what: ego lite 是一款专为 AI 代理设计的浏览器，允许用户和 AI 代理并行工作。代理可以在独立空间中运行多个浏览器任务，同时用户保留自己的标签页，且无需额外配置即可共享登录状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 macOS 应用安装包（Apple Silicon 和 Intel）、文档链接、Discord 社区、X 账号以及演示视频。核心功能是通过 `ego-browser` 技能让代理访问真实登录状态和标签页。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，基于浏览器技术构建，支持 macOS 平台，Windows 和 Linux 在路线图中。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2288 星，总星数 11863，因解决 AI 浏览器自动化中登录状态共享的痛点而迅速走红。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理执行浏览器任务并访问真实登录状态。
自动化测试工程师：希望在不干扰用户标签页的情况下并行运行测试。
个人用户：想用 AI 代理处理日常网页操作，同时保留自己的浏览会话。

en.tag: Fastest shared browser for AI agents, zero config
en.what: ego lite is a browser designed for AI agents to run browser automation in parallel with users. Agents operate in their own Spaces, while users keep their tabs, and logins are shared seamlessly without extra setup.
en.content: The repo provides macOS app downloads (Apple Silicon and Intel), docs, Discord, X handle, and demo video. Core feature is the `ego-browser` skill enabling agents to access real logins and tabs.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, leveraging browser technologies, currently supports macOS, with Windows and Linux on roadmap.
en.hot: Gained 2288 stars this week, total 11863, popular for solving login-sharing pain in AI browser automation.
uses: AI agent developers: need agents to run browser tasks with real logins.
Automation testers: want parallel test runs without disturbing user tabs.
Personal users: want AI agents to handle web tasks while keeping their own session.

zh.tag: 开源低代码平台，构建内部工具与AI代理
zh.what: ToolJet 是一个开源的低代码平台，用于快速构建内部工具、仪表盘、业务应用和工作流。它提供可视化拖拽界面，支持连接数据库、API 和 SaaS 应用，并集成了 AI 能力，可生成应用和智能代理。

需要快速搭建业务应用的非技术用户

en.tag: Open-source low-code platform for building internal tools and AI agents
en.what: ToolJet is an open-source low-code platform for rapidly building internal tools, dashboards, business applications, and workflows. It offers a visual drag-and-drop interface, connects to databases, APIs, and SaaS apps, and integrates AI capabilities for app generation and intelligent agents.

en.hot: Popular among developers for its powerful low-code capabilities and AI integration. Gained 241 stars today, reaching 38.5k total, ranking 5th on the JavaScript trending list.

Non-technical users needing to quickly create business apps
Developers looking to leverage AI for app generation and workflow automation
Enterprises seeking self-hosted low-code solutions

zh.tag: 免费在线数据库 ER 图编辑器与 SQL 生成器

软件架构师：在项目初期设计 ER 图，便于团队协作和沟通。

全栈开发者：在开发过程中快速原型化数据库模型，并导出为 SQL 语句。

en.tag: Free, simple, intuitive online database ER diagram editor and SQL generator
en.what: drawDB is a free, browser-based database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor that lets users quickly build diagrams, import/export SQL scripts, generate migrations, and customize the editor without creating an account. It simplifies database design by providing an intuitive visual interface for structuring and manipulating database schemas.

en.hot: drawDB has gained popularity for being free, requiring no sign-up, and working directly in the browser, amassing 38k+ stars with 48 new stars today, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending for JavaScript. It addresses common pain points in database design with a clean, intuitive interface and powerful SQL generation capabilities.
uses: Database developers: quickly visualize database schemas and generate SQL scripts and migrations.
Software architects: design ER diagrams in early project phases for team collaboration and communication.
Educational settings: demonstrate database design concepts without installing complex software.
Full-stack developers: prototype database models quickly during development and export to SQL statements.

Open-source users looking to replace commercial Kanban tools

zh.tag: 高效开源广告拦截器，专注隐私与性能
zh.what: uBlock Origin 是一款轻量级、高效的浏览器扩展，用于拦截广告、跟踪器和恶意域名。它通过 CPU 和内存占用极低的方式，为用户提供更干净、更快的网页浏览体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含扩展的完整源代码，包括核心拦截引擎、过滤列表管理、用户界面（如弹出面板和设置页）、以及针对不同浏览器的构建配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，结合 HTML/CSS 构建界面，并利用浏览器扩展 API（如 webRequest 和 declarativeNetRequest）实现网络请求拦截。
zh.hot: 随着主流浏览器逐步淘汰 Manifest V2，uBlock Origin 成为用户对抗广告和跟踪的重要工具，其高效性和可靠性使其在 GitHub 上持续受到关注，本月新增 890 星。
uses: 注重隐私的普通用户，希望拦截广告和跟踪器以加快浏览速度并保护隐私。
技术爱好者，希望自定义过滤规则或研究广告拦截技术。
开发者和维护者，需要参考或贡献于开源广告拦截解决方案。

en.tag: Efficient open-source ad blocker focused on privacy and performance
en.what: uBlock Origin is a lightweight and efficient browser extension that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains. It provides a cleaner and faster browsing experience with minimal CPU and memory usage.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the extension, including the core blocking engine, filter list management, user interface (popup panel and settings pages), and build configurations for various browsers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with HTML/CSS for the UI, and leverages browser extension APIs like webRequest and declarativeNetRequest for network request blocking.
en.hot: As major browsers phase out Manifest V2, uBlock Origin remains a crucial tool for users to fight ads and tracking. Its efficiency and reliability keep it popular on GitHub, gaining 890 stars this month.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to block ads and trackers for faster browsing and privacy protection.
Tech enthusiasts who want to customize filter rules or study ad-blocking techniques.
Developers and maintainers looking to reference or contribute to an open-source ad-blocking solution.

zh.tag: 微软官方 Power Platform 开发插件市场
zh.what: 这是一个插件市场，为 Claude Code 和 GitHub Copilot 提供 Power Platform 开发插件。包含可复用的技能、代理和命令，帮助开发者构建和部署 Power Platform 解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个插件，如 Power Pages、Model Apps、MCP Apps、Code Apps、Mobile Apps、Canvas Apps 和 Power Automate。每个插件都有独立的 README 和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Claude Code 或 GitHub Copilot CLI。部分插件使用 React、TypeScript、Expo、.NET 等技术栈。
zh.hot: 本周新增 49 颗星，位列 JavaScript 周榜第 3。作为微软官方项目，它填补了 AI 编码助手与 Power Platform 之间的空白，吸引大量低代码开发者。
uses: Power Platform 开发者 —— 使用 AI 助手快速构建和部署应用
低代码/无代码爱好者 —— 结合 Claude Code 或 Copilot 提升开发效率
企业 IT 团队 —— 标准化 Power Platform 开发流程

en.tag: Official Microsoft plugin marketplace for Power Platform development
en.what: This is a plugin marketplace providing Power Platform development plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot. It includes reusable skills, agents, and commands to help developers build and deploy Power Platform solutions.
en.content: The repository contains multiple plugins such as Power Pages, Model Apps, MCP Apps, Code Apps, Mobile Apps, Canvas Apps, and Power Automate. Each plugin has its own README and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, relying on Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI. Some plugins use React, TypeScript, Expo, .NET, etc.
en.hot: Gained 49 stars this week, ranking 3rd in JavaScript weekly trending. As an official Microsoft project, it bridges AI coding assistants and Power Platform, attracting many low-code developers.
uses: Power Platform developers — quickly build and deploy apps using AI assistants
Low-code/no-code enthusiasts — boost development efficiency with Claude Code or Copilot
Enterprise IT teams — standardize Power Platform development workflows

zh.tag: 自托管有声书与播客服务器
zh.what: Audiobookshelf 是一个自托管的有声书和播客服务器，支持流式播放所有音频格式，自动下载播客，多用户权限管理，跨设备同步播放进度。它提供 Web 应用、Android 和 iOS 应用（测试版），并支持 Chromecast。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器端代码、Vue 前端（正在迁移到 React）、REST API、数据库迁移、Docker 部署文件，以及文档和示例配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Node.js，前端使用 Vue（迁移至 React），数据库使用 SQLite，支持 Docker 部署，集成 Audnexus API 用于章节查找。
zh.hot: 随着自托管和数字隐私意识的增强，Audiobookshelf 提供了开源、功能丰富的替代方案，本月新增 460 星，总星数达 14006，在 JavaScript 趋势榜排名第 18。
uses: 自托管爱好者：希望完全掌控自己的有声书和播客库，避免依赖商业服务。
播客重度用户：需要自动下载和管理播客订阅，并支持多设备同步。
家庭或小团体：多用户权限和独立进度，适合共享媒体库。
开发者：可定制和扩展，前端正在迁移到 React，适合贡献代码。

en.tag: Self-hosted audiobook and podcast server
en.what: Audiobookshelf is a self-hosted audiobook and podcast server that streams all audio formats, auto-downloads podcasts, supports multi-user permissions, and syncs progress across devices. It offers a web app, Android and iOS apps (beta), and Chromecast support.
en.content: The repository contains the full server-side code, a Vue frontend (being migrated to React), REST API, database migrations, Docker deployment files, and documentation with sample configurations.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Node.js, frontend in Vue (migrating to React), SQLite database, Docker deployment, integrates Audnexus API for chapter lookup.
en.hot: With rising self-hosting and digital privacy awareness, Audiobookshelf offers an open-source, feature-rich alternative, gaining 460 stars this month and reaching 14,006 total, ranking #18 on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: Self-hosters: Want full control over their audiobook and podcast library without relying on commercial services.
Podcast power users: Need automatic downloads and management of subscriptions with multi-device sync.
Families or small groups: Multi-user permissions and per-user progress for shared media libraries.
Developers: Customizable and extensible, frontend migrating to React, suitable for contributing code.

zh.tag: 开源模块化智能魔镜平台，把镜子变成个人助理
zh.what: MagicMirror² 是一个开源的模块化智能镜子平台，允许用户将普通镜子（如玄关镜或浴室镜）改造成个人助理。它基于 Electron 封装，无需额外安装 Web 服务器或浏览器即可运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心平台代码、模块系统、安装文档和贡献指南。核心采用模块化插件架构，支持大量可安装的第三方模块来扩展功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，基于 Electron 框架，利用 Node.js 生态。依赖包括 npm 包管理、GitHub Actions 用于自动化测试。
zh.hot: 本月新增 129 星，总星数达 23.8k，位列 JavaScript 月榜第 19。作为智能家居和 DIY 项目的热门选择，社区活跃且贡献者众多。
uses: DIY 爱好者：想自制智能镜子，展示天气、日历、新闻等信息的个人项目。
智能家居玩家：将魔镜集成到家庭自动化系统中，作为信息中心或控制面板。
开发者：学习模块化架构和 Electron 应用开发，或贡献自己的模块。

en.tag: Open-source modular smart mirror platform turning mirrors into personal assistants
en.what: MagicMirror² is an open-source modular smart mirror platform that lets you turn a regular mirror (e.g., in a hallway or bathroom) into a personal assistant. It is built on Electron as an application wrapper, so no separate web server or browser installation is needed.
en.content: The repository contains the core platform code, a modular plugin system, installation documentation, and contribution guidelines. The core uses a modular plugin architecture, supporting a growing list of installable third-party modules to extend functionality.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, built on Electron, leveraging the Node.js ecosystem. Dependencies include npm for package management and GitHub Actions for automated testing.
en.hot: Gained 129 stars this month, reaching 23.8k total, ranking 19th on the JavaScript monthly trending. It's a popular choice for smart home and DIY projects, with an active community and many contributors.
uses: DIY enthusiasts: personal projects to build a smart mirror displaying weather, calendar, news, etc.
Smart home hobbyists: integrating the mirror into home automation as an info hub or control panel.
Developers: learning modular architecture and Electron app development, or contributing custom modules.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

zh.tag: 轻量跨浏览器 JavaScript 3D 库，WebGL/WebGPU 渲染
zh.what: three.js 是一个易于使用、轻量级的跨浏览器通用 3D 库，用于在网页上创建和展示 3D 图形。它提供了场景、相机、几何体、材质、渲染器等核心组件，支持 WebGL 和 WebGPU 渲染，并可通过附加组件扩展 SVG 和 CSS3D 渲染。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 JavaScript 源码、示例（examples）、文档（docs）、手册（manual）和 Wiki，以及构建配置和测试。核心模块包括渲染器、场景图、相机、几何体、材质、动画和加载器等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 WebGL 和 WebGPU API，通过 npm 分发，支持 ES6 模块导入。构建工具包括 Rollup 等，测试使用 Puppeteer 和 playwright。
zh.hot: three.js 是 Web 3D 的事实标准，拥有超过 11 万 star，本月新增近千 star，持续活跃。其易用性和强大的功能使其成为开发者创建 3D 网页的首选。
uses: Web 开发者：在网页中快速实现 3D 可视化、产品展示或交互式动画。
游戏开发者：使用 three.js 构建浏览器游戏或原型，无需安装插件。
数据可视化工程师：将复杂数据以 3D 形式呈现，增强理解与交互。
教育领域：用于教学演示、虚拟实验室或在线课程中的 3D 内容。

en.tag: Lightweight, cross-browser JavaScript 3D library with WebGL and WebGPU renderers
en.what: three.js is an easy-to-use, lightweight, cross-browser, general-purpose 3D library for creating and displaying 3D graphics on the web. It provides core components like scenes, cameras, geometries, materials, and renderers, supporting WebGL and WebGPU rendering, with SVG and CSS3D renderers available as addons.
en.content: The repository contains complete JavaScript source code, examples, docs, manual, and Wiki, along with build configurations and tests. Core modules include renderers, scene graph, cameras, geometries, materials, animation, and loaders.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, relying on WebGL and WebGPU APIs, distributed via npm, supporting ES6 module imports. Build tools include Rollup, and tests use Puppeteer and Playwright.
en.hot: three.js is the de facto standard for Web 3D, with over 110k stars and nearly 1k new stars this month, remaining highly active. Its ease of use and powerful features make it the go-to choice for developers creating 3D web experiences.
uses: Web developers: quickly implement 3D visualizations, product showcases, or interactive animations in web pages.
Game developers: build browser games or prototypes with three.js without needing plugins.
Data visualization engineers: present complex data in 3D to enhance understanding and interaction.
Education: use for teaching demonstrations, virtual labs, or 3D content in online courses.

zh.tag: 微软出品的12周Web开发入门课程
zh.what: 这是一个面向初学者的Web开发课程，为期12周，共24节课，涵盖JavaScript、CSS和HTML。课程通过实践项目（如制作玻璃容器、浏览器扩展和太空游戏）来教授基础知识，并配有测验、讨论和作业。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的课程材料，包括每课的README、代码示例、测验和作业，以及多语言翻译版本（通过GitHub Action自动更新）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript、CSS和HTML，课程本身基于Markdown和GitHub，支持多语言翻译。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方课程，凭借系统化的项目驱动教学和免费开源，吸引了近10万星标，本月新增610星，持续受到初学者和教育工作者的欢迎。
uses: 零基础想转行Web开发的初学者，通过12周系统学习掌握HTML/CSS/JS基础
教育工作者或培训师，可直接使用或改编课程材料进行教学
自学爱好者，通过动手项目巩固知识并构建作品集

en.tag: Microsoft's 12-week web dev beginner curriculum
en.what: A 12-week, 24-lesson curriculum for beginners to learn web development fundamentals, covering JavaScript, CSS, and HTML through hands-on projects like terrariums, browser extensions, and space games, with quizzes, discussions, and assignments.
en.content: The repository contains complete course materials including lesson READMEs, code samples, quizzes, and assignments, plus multi-language translations (auto-updated via GitHub Action).
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, CSS, and HTML; the curriculum is built with Markdown and GitHub, supporting multi-language translations.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft curriculum, its systematic project-based pedagogy and free open-source nature have attracted nearly 100k stars, with 610 added this month, remaining popular among beginners and educators.
uses: Absolute beginners aiming to switch to web development, learn HTML/CSS/JS basics in 12 weeks
Educators or trainers who can directly use or adapt the curriculum for teaching
Self-learners who reinforce knowledge through hands-on projects and build portfolios

zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢思维协作平台
zh.what: Buzz是一个自托管的团队协作空间，人类和AI代理可以在同一频道中共同工作。所有消息、操作和事件都记录在Nostr中继上，形成统一的审计日志。它让代理像人类队友一样参与代码审查、工作流运行和项目管理。
zh.content: 仓库包含Rust实现的核心中继、客户端界面、文档（愿景、架构等）以及截图示例。提供频道、画布、工作流、语音会议等功能，并支持代理自主操作。
zh.stack: 主要使用Rust编写，基于Nostr协议，依赖大量Rust crate。前端可能使用Web技术，但核心是Rust后端。
zh.hot: 在GitHub Trending月榜排名第一，28.7k星，本月新增301星。它解决了AI代理协作中的信任和审计问题，提供统一的事件日志，吸引了开发者和团队。
uses: 团队希望让AI代理参与开发流程，同时保持完整审计记录。
开发者需要自托管的协作平台，数据完全掌控。
对Nostr协议感兴趣，想探索去中心化社交与工作结合。
研究AI代理安全与权限管理的场景。

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate on a Nostr relay
en.what: Buzz is a self-hosted team workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate in shared channels. Every message, action, and event is recorded on a Nostr relay, creating a unified audit trail. Agents can participate in code review, workflow runs, and project management like human teammates.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-implemented core relay, client UI, documentation (vision, architecture, etc.), and screenshot examples. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and agent autonomy.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on the Nostr protocol, with a suspicious number of Rust crates. The frontend may use web technologies, but the core is Rust backend.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending monthly with 28.7k stars and +301 this month. It addresses trust and audit in AI agent collaboration with a unified event log, attracting developers and teams.
uses: Teams wanting AI agents in dev workflows with full audit trails.
Developers needing self-hosted collaboration with data ownership.
Those interested in Nostr and decentralized social-work integration.
Researchers exploring AI agent security and permissioning.

zh.tag: 一站式开发环境管理工具
zh.what: mise 是一个开发工具、环境变量和任务运行器的统一 CLI。它通过一个 mise.toml 文件管理项目工具、环境变量和任务，确保新 shell、检出和 CI 作业从相同的设置开始。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、演示 GIF 和配置文件。核心功能包括安装和切换数百种开发工具、按项目目录加载环境变量（包括 .env 文件），以及定义和运行构建、测试、lint 和部署任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。支持多种后端，如 npm、pip、go 等，用于安装工具。
zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。
uses: 开发者：需要管理多个项目工具版本和环境的个人开发者
团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files. Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.
en.hot: mise is trending in the Rust community with 258 stars today and 31,926 total. It solves the pain point of dev environment setup by consolidating multiple tools into one CLI, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers: individuals managing multiple project tool versions and environments
Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost
CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: 本地优先的极速微虚拟机运行时，秒级启动隔离环境
zh.what: Microsandbox 是一个用 Rust 编写的轻量级微虚拟机运行时，能在本地快速启动隔离环境，用于运行不可信代码，如 AI 代理、用户脚本、CI 任务等。它提供硬件级隔离，同时保持 Docker 类似的工作流，启动时间平均低于 100 毫秒。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、文档、示例、Agent Skills 和 MCP 服务器集成，以及用于构建和发布的配置。核心是一个可嵌入的库，允许在代码中直接生成虚拟机，无需守护进程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编程语言，依赖微虚拟机技术（如 Firecracker 或类似），支持 OCI 容器镜像，跨平台（Linux、macOS、Windows）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和不可信代码执行需求的增长，开发者需要快速、安全的隔离方案。Microsandbox 提供了低于 100 毫秒的启动时间和硬件级隔离，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，本月新增 959 星，总星数达 8021。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供安全的沙箱环境，执行用户代码或插件。
CI/CD 工程师：在隔离环境中运行测试或构建任务，防止恶意代码影响主机。
安全研究人员：分析不可信二进制或脚本，利用硬件隔离降低风险。
平台工程师：将微虚拟机嵌入应用，实现多租户隔离或动态代码执行。

en.tag: Fast, local-first microVM runtime for untrusted workloads

en.what: A Go-based CLI for the App Store Connect API, enabling automation of release workflows for iOS, macOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps from terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipelines, including TestFlight, builds, submissions, signing, analytics, screenshots, and subscriptions.

Developers interested in agent skills to automate release tasks with AI assistance.

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 3，今日新增 26 颗星，总星数达 1270。其核心卖点——亚秒级挂起/恢复和高密度多路复用——解决了 Agent 部署中的关键痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要大规模运行 AI Agent 的团队，希望降低基础设施成本并提高资源利用率
构建 Agent 编排平台的开发者，需要底层生命周期管理和流量路由
从事强化学习（RL）场景的工程师，需要统一管理 Agent、推理和训练基础设施

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime environment for large-scale agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared compute infrastructure. It is not an SDK for building agents but a system for running them at scale.
en.content: The repository contains the core control plane implementation, supporting multiple sandbox technologies (e.g., microVMs and gVisor), and leverages Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. It includes a demo video and detailed documentation showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and autoscaling) for infrastructure management and integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily, gaining 26 stars today to reach 1270 total. Its key selling points—sub-second suspend/resume and high-density multiplexing—address critical pain points in agent deployment, driving significant interest.
uses: Teams deploying AI agents at scale, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization
Developers building agent orchestration platforms that require underlying lifecycle management and traffic routing
Engineers working on reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios needing unified management of agentic, inference, and training infrastructure

zh.tag: 为AI编码代理提供持久化结构化记忆的分布式图式问题追踪器
zh.what: Beads 是一个为 AI 编码代理设计的分布式图式问题追踪器，提供持久化、结构化的记忆。它用依赖感知的图取代混乱的 Markdown 计划，帮助代理处理长周期任务而不丢失上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Beads CLI 工具源码、安装脚本、文档以及多种代理集成（如 Codex CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等）。用户通过 `bd` 命令初始化项目、创建/关闭问题、同步远程代理。

zh.hot: GitHub 日增 95 星，总星数 25601，位列 Go 语言日榜第 11。AI 编码代理的持久记忆需求旺盛，Beads 以轻量 CLI 和分布式图方案解决痛点。
uses: AI 编码代理开发者 —— 为代理提供持久化记忆和任务管理
使用 Codex CLI、Claude Code 等工具的开发者 —— 集成 Beads 以提升长周期任务处理能力
团队协作场景 —— 多代理通过 Dolt 同步工作状态和依赖图

en.tag: A distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents with persistent structured memory
en.what: Beads is a distributed graph issue tracker for AI coding agents, providing persistent structured memory. It replaces messy markdown plans with a dependency-aware graph, helping agents handle long-horizon tasks without losing context.
en.content: The repo contains the Beads CLI tool source code, installation scripts, documentation, and integrations for various agents (Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Users interact via `bd` commands to init projects, create/close issues, and sync with remote agents.
en.stack: Built with Go, leveraging Dolt (distributed versioned database) for graph storage and sync. Also provides npm and PyPI packages for MCP integration.
en.hot: Gaining 95 stars daily, total 25601, ranking #11 on Go daily trending. The demand for persistent memory in AI coding agents is high, and Beads addresses it with a lightweight CLI and distributed graph approach.
uses: AI coding agent developers — provide persistent memory and task management for agents
Developers using Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc. — integrate Beads to improve long-horizon task handling
Team collaboration — multiple agents sync work status and dependency graph via Dolt

AI 应用开发者：为代理添加人工审批和策略检查，确保可控执行。

en.tag: Open-source control plane for agentic engineering, orchestrating workflows across your stack
en.what: SuperPlane is an open-source automation engine for AI-driven engineering, orchestrating workflows across tools like Git, LLMs, CI/CD, observability, and more. It provides durable execution, approvals, and an operational UI to ensure safe human-AI interaction.

zh.tag: Git 仓库密钥扫描与泄露检测工具
zh.what: Gitleaks 是一个用于检测 Git 仓库、文件或标准输入中是否存在密码、API 密钥、令牌等敏感信息的工具。它通过正则表达式和熵分析来识别潜在的泄露，并输出详细的报告，包括文件、行号、提交等信息。
